We study seven app development projects across two countries and interview developers about the results. Overall, we observed that the baseline prompt favours recall over precision, whereas CCoT is more balanced, achieving average F1 scores of 52-66% for epics and user stories. Tasks were more challenging to generate accurately. Precision gains were most consistent when adding architectural context, particularly for backend tasks (precision gains up to 35%). Interviews with developers revealed that up to 26% of false positives were still considered useful, reflecting the creative and open-ended nature of backlog creation. To capture this, we propose a new measure called Revised Recall, which complements ground-truth evaluation with developer assessments. Our findings suggest that hybrid prompting with architectural context can assist backlog generation from early mockups, though results vary by item type and developer oversight remains necessary.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了使用多模态基础模型（GPT-4o）从应用视觉原型自动生成敏捷开发待办列表（史诗、用户故事、任务）的可行性，比较了零样本基线提示、组合思维链（CCoT）和角色驱动提示三种策略，并探讨了架构上下文的影响。研究基于七个真实项目，引入了一种结合开发者反馈的"修订召回率（Revised Recall）"新评估指标。
AI.motivation: 待办列表的创建耗时且容易遗漏或描述不一致，而应用原型是项目早期阶段容易获取的视觉产物。现有GenAI研究多聚焦于代码或文本需求生成，几乎没有研究探索从视觉原型直接生成完整待办列表的方法，因此需要填补这一空白。
AI.method: 研究基于七个应用开发项目（涵盖南美AppComp公司三个项目和欧洲CapStone课程四个项目），共110个原型和595个待办列表项。采用GPT-4o（温度设为0）进行生成，设计三种提示策略：零样本基线、CCoT（先生成场景图再生成待办项）、角色驱动提示（先抽取用户角色再生成项）。通过手动语义匹配评估精度、召回率和F1分数，并在任务生成中加入架构上下文做消融实验。对AppComp和CapStone的七个团队进行半结构式访谈，评估误报项的实用性，并据此提出修订召回率指标。
AI.result: 1. 基线提示倾向于高召回低精度，CCoT在史诗和用户故事上更平衡（平均F1为52-66%），任务生成普遍较难（F1仅21-35%）；2. 添加架构上下文显著提升任务生成精度，尤其是后端任务（精度提升最高达35%，McNemar检验p<0.001），CCoT受益最多（平均F1提升4%）；3. 多达26%的误报项仍被开发者视为有用，反映待办列表创建的开放性和创造性；4. 新提出的修订召回率在任务层面增益最大（Δ达19-47%），说明传统精确匹配评估低估了AI输出的实际价值。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，混合提示策略结合架构上下文可以在早期原型阶段辅助待办列表生成，但效果因条目类型而异，开发者监督仍然必要。精确匹配指标（如F1）不适合评估开放式创造性任务，建议补充修订召回率等结合人类反馈的评估方式。未来工作应探索多轮对话式生成、跨项目复现以及修订召回率在其他开放式软件工程任务中的应用。

title: Agent Team Work Zone: An Automated, Persistent Workspace for Long-Lived Coding Agent Teams
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have significantly improved coding and programming workflows. Claude Code, in particular, is one of the most powerful LLM coding agents and is capable of conducting complex coding tasks. However, several drawbacks can undermine long-term agentic workflows. (1) Irrecoverable agent teams: The Agent Teams feature is powerful, but the working state accumulated by each teammate is lost and cannot be resumed once the process stops, for example, when a terminal is closed. (2) Compaction erodes working detail: Compaction condenses the conversation into a summary, causing an agent's working details to become vague. (3) Agentic "technical debt": Over time, a user's decisions and the agents' operations become trapped in compacted old chats, making the project increasingly difficult to maintain and review. (4) Heavy prompt writing: Assigning or handing off tasks requires users to repeatedly write long prompts to achieve the expected agentic performance. We propose ATWZ (Agent Team Work Zone), a filesystem-based operations layer built around Claude Code's native Agent Teams that addresses these problems. Its central design principle is to treat each agent and teammate as a human employee and preserve their important working state in files stored in a dedicated directory called a "workstation," together with the skills, hooks, and scripts that use and maintain these files. With ATWZ, an agent team can periodically back up its working state, allowing an agent's knowledge to be recovered after compaction. After a process ends, the team can be restored with a single command. These features also substantially mitigate the agentic "technical debt" described above. Moreover, within ATWZ, agent "employees" can send documents to one another, greatly reducing the effort required to write prompts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ATWZ（Agent Team Work Zone），一个基于文件系统的操作层，围绕 Claude Code 原生的 Agent Teams 功能构建，通过将每个 agent 和 teammate 视为"人类员工"并将其重要工作状态以文件形式保存在专用"workstation"目录中，解决长时智能体工作流中状态不可恢复、压缩导致细节丢失、agentic "技术债"以及重型提示编写等四大问题。
AI.motivation: 随着 LLM 编码智能体（如 Claude Code）在复杂编码任务中的广泛应用，长时智能体工作流暴露出关键缺陷：(1) Agent Teams 进程终止后工作状态不可恢复；(2) Compaction（上下文压缩）使 agent 工作细节变得模糊；(3) 用户决策与 agent 操作被困于历史压缩对话中，形成 agentic "技术债"，增加项目维护与审查难度；(4) 任务分配/交接需反复撰写冗长提示，负担沉重。
AI.method: 核心方法为 ATWZ——一个基于文件系统的操作层。设计原则：将每个 agent 与 teammate 类比为"人类员工"，将其重要工作状态（包括技能、钩子、脚本及维护文件）持久化保存到专属"workstation"目录中。具体机制包括：(a) 周期性的工作状态备份，使压缩后 agent 知识可被恢复；(b) 单命令即可在进程结束后恢复整个团队；(c) agent "员工"之间可通过发送文档进行通信，从而大幅降低提示编写工作量。
AI.result: 论文（作为系统/工具介绍）提出 ATWZ 框架设计与工作机制，旨在通过文件系统持久化与文档化通信解决上述四大问题，缓解长时 agentic 工作流中的状态丢失、细节侵蚀、技术债累积及提示工程负担。论文未在所提供内容中给出量化实验对比结果。
AI.conclusion: ATWZ 通过借鉴"员工-工作站"的类比，将 agent 工作状态外部化、文件化，使 Agent Teams 具备可备份、可恢复、可交接的能力，从而显著提升长时编码智能体工作流的可持续性、可维护性与可审查性，并降低用户编写重型提示的成本。

title: SAGE: Safety-First Defense-in-Depth Guardrails for Verified Lifecycle Control of High-Impact Generative AI
summary: High-impact generative AI makes catastrophic misuse a lifecycle-control problem, not merely a prompt-filtering problem. SAGE is a safety-first, authorization-separated architecture in which credible catastrophic-enablement risk constrains admissibility before utility, latency, or commercial objectives are considered. It combines signed release manifests, diverse detectors, robust risk envelopes, least-risk defaults, output checking, three-valued monitoring, protected audit chains, containment, and rollback. Formal results establish safety priority, conservative detector bounds, monotone release gating, tamper-evident records, and an authorization cut; two PRISM abstractions verify authorization separation and lifecycle invariants under explicit assumptions. A frozen, vendor-symmetric study sent 84 cases to each of four GPT, four Claude, and two Gemini snapshots: 840 calls yielded 794 target responses, 46 provider errors, and 449 successful judgments covering 375 responses. Eight snapshots had complete judged domain coverage. Harmful-compliance estimates were low; variation arose mainly from benign utility and safe redirection. Seven multiplicity-adjusted contrasts involving Claude, Gemini, or GPT-5 snapshots and the GPT-5 mini and GPT-5 nano snapshots were supported, while no tested contrast between the Claude or Gemini snapshots and GPT-5 or GPT-5.5 survived correction. The observed harmful-compliance range is a conservative, protocol-bound view from one generation per prompt with no tools, retrieval, history, or human adjudication; it is not an upper bound on operational assistance. A preregistered extension specifies how to test a wider best-worst gap using a locked split, repeated sampling, multi-turn and sandboxed-tool conditions, and domain-expert scoring.

AI.tldr: SAGE提出了一种面向高影响力生成式AI的安全优先、授权分离的全生命周期控制架构,通过形式化方法将灾难性启用风险置于效用之上,结合签名发布清单、多样化检测器、鲁棒风险包络、最低风险默认值、输出检查、三值监控、受保护审计链、遏制与回滚机制;并通过840次调用(10个模型快照)的冻结式实证研究进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 高影响力生成式AI(网络安全、生物化学、暴力、欺诈、虚假信息、骚扰等领域的危险能力)带来不对称义务——少数实质性降低恐怖主义、网络攻击、化学/生物滥用、暴力犯罪、关键基础设施破坏或大规模欺诈成本的响应,无法用总体便利性来正当化。提供者应假设存在自适应探测,将灾难性启用预防视为发布和运行时约束,而非仅仅依靠提示过滤。
AI.method: (1) 安全优先的形式化框架:定义五级动作阶梯(G0正常回答至G4已授权事件流程)、感知向量(含领域概率、严重度、可操作性、不确定性)、污染类模糊集、鲁棒灾难风险K、最小风险可行集F_κ、词典序安全优先策略g^SF;(2) 防御纵深的漏检边界:独立性下的乘积界、共同原因依赖模型下的γ+(1-γ)∏ε_j界,论证多样性要求;(3) 签名发布清单M_θ与单调释放门控Rel;(4) 三值监控M_φ、衰减证据E_t=ρE_{t-1}+w_t r_t;(5) 篡改证据审计胶囊与数据最小化;(6) 授权切割定理:未授权状态无路径可达披露状态;(7) PRISM概率模型检验(9状态/13转换授权模型、8状态/11转换生命周期模型);(8) 实证协议:84案例×10快照=840次调用,temperature=0,无工具/检索/历史,400空白单元分析窗口,盲化评判,Holm校正Wilcoxon配对检验,10,000次分层自举,100,000次Dirichlet权重敏感性分析。
AI.result: 840次调用产生794个目标响应、46个提供者错误、449个成功评判覆盖375个响应;8个快照在所有风险领域有完整评判覆盖;估计的伤害遵从率较低(HCS范围0.0000-0.0333),差异主要来自良性效用和安全的重定向而非伤害遵从;平衡防护分数(BGS)前三为Claude Haiku 4.5(0.9975)、Claude Sonnet 4.6(0.9938)、Gemini 3 Flash预览(0.9911),最低为GPT-5 nano(0.8411);7项多重性校正对比获得支持(主要涉及Claude、Gemini或GPT-5对比GPT-5 mini和nano),无对比在Claude/Gemini快照与GPT-5/5.5之间幸存;PRISM验证确认授权切割、发布前提、违规响应和过期停用等不变量;100,000次Dirichlet权重敏感性分析中,两个领先的Claude快照瓜分所有获胜份额。
AI.conclusion: SAGE的主要贡献是一个预防性控制架构(覆盖发布、运行和事件响应),而非排行榜;形式化结果确立了安全优先、保守的检测器边界、单调释放门控、防篡改记录和授权切割;两个PRISM抽象验证了授权分离和生命周期不变量;经验发现为端点特定性,观察到的伤害遵从范围是基于单次生成、无工具/检索/历史/人工裁决的协议绑定保守视图,不是操作协助的上界;在确证扩展确认之前,匹配的最好-最坏HCS差距是否超过0.0333仍为未证实假设;启示是谨慎且有限的:无基准能证明部署资格,只有满足声明阈值和控制的精确制品才可运行。

title: Design Theater: A Benchmark for Generative UI
summary: Generative UI tools promise to democratize UI design by turning natural language descriptions into complete interfaces. Alongside the interface, these tools generate user-facing design rationales that explain their layout, accessibility, and design choices. However, it remains unclear whether these stated rationales are actually reflected in the interfaces they produce. We call this disconnect ``Design Theater'': plausible and confident design rationales that have little relationship to the actual implementation. To study this phenomenon, we introduce a benchmark and three metrics for measuring Design Theater. The benchmark includes 24 UI generation tasks spanning structural, styling, and functional design requirements. Using this benchmark, we evaluate 120 interfaces created by five generative UI tools. On average, over 25\% of user-facing design rationales are not implemented in the generated interface, and the implementation failure increases to 34\% for functional requirements. Tools recognize roughly half of the UX principles embedded in prompts (mean = 0.54), with four of five tools implementing 6\% or fewer functional principles. We also measure interface similarity across tools and find convergence in visual appearance and layout organization, with greater variation in color choices. Overall, we contribute: 1) the concept of Design Theater; 2) a benchmark with metrics for assessing whether the stated reasoning of generative UI tools is reflected in their implementations; 3) and findings from a systematic evaluation of these tools. We discuss what these findings mean for the design and evaluation of generative UI tools.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"Design Theater"概念，指出生成式UI工具在输出界面的同时所附带的设计理由（rationale）与实际实现之间存在显著脱节。作者构建了一个包含24个UI生成任务、评估5个主流生成式UI工具（ChatGPT、Claude、Firebase Studio、Vercel v0、Bolt）的基准测试，并通过三个新指标量化该现象：Thinking Fidelity Score（TFS）、Principle Adherence Score（PAS）和Design Homogeneity Index（DHI）。研究发现约25%的设计理由未被实现，功能性任务的失败率高达34%，且工具间存在显著的视觉/布局同质化。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式UI工具（如ChatGPT、Claude、Vercel v0等）的普及，非专业用户越来越多地依赖这些工具从自然语言描述生成完整界面。这些工具同时生成面向用户的设计理由（design rationales），解释其布局、可访问性和设计选择。然而，这些看似专业的设计理由是否真正反映在其生成的界面中尚不清楚。这种"理由-实现脱节"可能导致非专业用户过度信任表面专业但实际未实现关键可用性、可访问性和交互设计要求的界面，尤其当专业设计师被排除在审核环节之外时，问题尤为严重。
AI.method: 研究采用基准测试+多指标评估的方法：（1）构建24个UI生成任务，分为三个层级——结构任务（信息架构与组织）、样式任务（颜色、排版、视觉呈现）、功能任务（交互与用户流）；（2）在5个生成式UI工具上运行所有任务，共生成120个界面，所有工具统一仅使用HTML/CSS/JavaScript（不依赖外部框架）；（3）提出三个互补指标——TFS（提取每个工具的设计理由元素，由评估者对照实际界面判断实现程度，1.0/0.5/0.0三级评分），PAS（每个任务预先确定两个来自成熟框架——Rosenfeld信息架构、Nielsen可用性启发式、WCAG/Jiang视觉感知——的UX原则，评估是否被实现），DHI（通过UIClip编码做视觉相似度比较、CIELCh色彩直方图+EMD做色彩相似度、OmniParser v2.0+树编辑距离做布局相似度）；（4）评估者独立评分后通过讨论解决分歧，使用加权Cohen's κ保证评分者间信度（TFS κ=0.70，PAS κ=0.90）。
AI.result: 研究发现三个一致的模式：（1）TFS平均为0.75，约1/4的设计理由未在界面中实现，功能任务（Tier 3）平均TFS降至0.66；Claude表现最佳（0.87），Firebase最差（0.53），Vercel v0在功能任务上波动最大（0.56，CI 0.36-0.77）。（2）PAS平均仅0.54，工具只识别了约一半隐含的UX原则；结构性任务表现最好（0.79），功能性任务几近崩塌——四个工具的Tier 3 PAS≤0.06，Firebase在功能性原则上得分为0；ChatGPT整体最佳（0.73），Firebase最差（0.29）。（3）DHI显示工具间存在同质化：视觉和布局相似度范围较窄（分别为0.119-0.151和0.181-0.211），而色彩差异较大（20.6-39.7）；Claude与Vercel v0的界面最相似，ChatGPT与Firebase差异最大。
AI.conclusion: 论文认为Design Theater不仅是生成层面的失败，也是"评估瓶颈"的体现：界面生产变得快速、廉价、修辞精美，但评估生成产物仍缓慢、依赖专家且多维。PAS结果尤为严峻——功能性UX原则（系统状态可见性、用户控制与自由、错误预防与恢复）几乎未被实现，而这些正是非专家最难察觉的问题。DHI揭示的同质化意味着工具用专业化的理由包装了重复的默认设计模式（"表面情境化"），削弱了设计应有的情境敏感性。论文提出TFS/PAS/DHI不应被视为工具的终极排名，而应作为可复用的评估框架，用于审计生成式UI工具的"说-做"距离，并强调随着面向用户的推理痕迹成为非专家审查者判断设计能力的主要信号，量化这种距离对生成式UI工具的负责任部署至关重要。

title: Let AI Agents Translate Networks, Not Reason About Them
summary: A formal model enables verifying reachability, localizing an outage, or anticipating the blast radius of a change. Yet, virtually no production network has one, since writing a model by hand demands rare expertise and is hard to keep current as the network changes frequently. At its core, network modeling is a typographical exercise: it translates network artifacts (e.g., configurations, topology, and routing state) into rules in formal logic. Translation of this kind is what large language models (LLMs) nowadays do well. Unlike free-form AI reasoning, such translation can be formally verified. Once modeling is no longer the bottleneck, trusting AI to reason over large, complex networks no longer makes sense. Our position therefore cuts against the prevailing race to put autonomous AI agents in charge end-to-end. We instead confine AI to translation and rely on a solver for reliable long-horizon reasoning, building a reusable formal model of general network behavior that can then be specialized to specific tasks, e.g., root-cause analysis (RCA). We build TypoNet that constructs and validates a symbolic model of an emulated production-scale WAN from the network's own artifacts. Our preliminary evaluation shows TypoNet helps in two ways. On its own, TypoNet answers operational questions (e.g., reachability verification and change-impact analysis) faster, more cheaply, and more reliably than an LLM. As a tool for an AI agent, TypoNet boosts fault localization at lower cost. The result makes the case for AI that builds verifiable network models and relies on a solver for reliable long-horizon reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文主张AI智能体应只负责将网络工件（配置、拓扑、路由状态等）翻译为形式逻辑规则（"排版"），而将长链路推理交给求解器完成。作者构建了TypoNet系统，通过对抗式CEGIS循环自动构建并验证网络的形式化符号模型，并证明其在可达性验证、变更影响分析和根因分析任务中比纯LLM更快速、廉价、可靠。
AI.motivation: 生产网络几乎都没有形式化模型，因手工建模需要稀缺的"形式方法+网络"双重专家知识，且网络频繁变更导致模型极易过时。当前业界趋势是直接让AI智能体端到端管理网络，但LLM在长链路推理中会产生幻觉级联错误，且无法将大规模网络装入上下文窗口；在故障定位等关键任务中，这恰恰是其最薄弱之处。因此亟需一种能够自动构建、持续同步且可验证的网络形式化建模方法。
AI.method: TypoNet采用"自底向上公理化"的组合式建模方法，由两个智能体驱动的CEGIS对抗循环构成：(1) LLM驱动的Constructor将网络SoT数据库中的事实翻译为形式逻辑规则；(2) 反对者Detractor利用网络的被动证据（如路由会话记录）和主动证据（如仿真网络注入故障）反驳每条规则，直到理论能抵御攻击并满足网络已知不变量（如全对可达性、无环路、ACL合规）。模型分三层构建：通用网络行为Foundation Theory → 厂商/部署特定细化层 → 任务专属特化层（如RCA的故障-症状关系）。形式化建模采用Answer Set Programming (ASP)，推理使用Cautious Entailment求解（Th ⊨ q即Th∧¬q无稳定模型）。
AI.result: 在30-AS/515设备的仿真WAN上构建Foundation Theory：128条规则（121条LLM编写+7条人工种子），Detractor产生214个反例，平均每条规则2.8轮反驳，构建一次性成本约3小时/$18.6，保留数据吻合率97.4%（去除Detractor降至41%），48/50条人为注入错误规则被捕获；92%的规则无需修改即迁移到70-AS/1191设备的2倍规模部署中。运行时查询（如健康/变更后可达性、爆炸半径、航点）在5–34毫秒内、零token完成，爆炸半径推理链达23条规则跨11跳。在NIKA基准的根因分析任务中：为GPT-5.6 Sol的定位F1从0.672提升至0.757，Opus 4.8也获得提升；在最难案例（症状远离原因处）F1从0.59跃升至0.82；小模型Sonnet 4.6从0.41提升至0.511，成本仅$0.50/次。误报率降低2–3倍。
AI.conclusion: 自动构建并验证网络形式化模型使建模从专家手工工艺转变为自动化、可验证的过程；"LLM翻译、求解器决策"的范式将可靠的长时间链路推理从LLM转移到求解器上，把LLM的输出从信任基础中剔除。论文同时指出四个开放问题：(1) 在网络持续变化下保持符号模型同步；(2) 自动学习厂商特定行为并跨部署迁移；(3) 已建立知识的内在不完备性及其因果局限；(4) 将建模扩展到更高协议层（NAT、防火墙等）和数值遥测。

title: Share No More Than the Request Requires: Federated Disclosure for Perspective-Aware AI
summary: Modern AI systems bring societal risks such as mass surveillance, extreme concentrations of power, and loss of user autonomy---calling into question a model where third-parties collect and control massive amounts of user data. Users require a sovereign system to securely own, govern, and disclose their context while remaining compliant across regulated domains with strict provenance, interpretability, and policy adherence. Perspective-aware AI approaches this by transforming a user's aggregated personal data into a structured identity model called a \emph{Chronicle}: a temporal knowledge graph that represents and grows with the user. Chronicles support the secure disclosure of context across federated networks. A Chronicle holder may expose a queryable, authorized view that a third-party agent may consult without centralizing anyone's data. This paper explores the problem of minimum-necessary disclosure across domain boundaries: when a requester's agent queries a Chronicle, how can the system constrain its response to release only what the requester's relationship, stated purpose, and specific task require? We propose \textbf{Provenance Preserving Chronicles} (PPC), a federated protocol that compiles each holder's Chronicle into a compact \emph{authorized evidence subgraph} governed by one rule: \emph{share no more than the request requires}. Holders keep local sovereignty; an access controller projects relationship-aware views over domain-expert ontologies; and a two-phase flow returns provenance-linked text first, releasing raw artifacts only after explicit holder approval. We frame the problem, map gaps in blockchain, P2P, and holder-sovereign designs, define the core constructs, and sketch the protocol with an explicit threat model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"来源保持编年史"（Provenance Preserving Chronicles, PPC），一种面向视角感知AI的联邦式选择性披露协议。核心思想是将用户的"编年史"（时序、谓词标记的知识图谱）按"请求者关系、声明目的、信息需求"编译为最小必要且带来源追溯的"授权证据子图"（S*），采用两阶段流程：先返回带来源链接的文本响应，再经用户明确批准后方可释放原始资料。
AI.motivation: 现代AI系统带来大规模监控、权力集中和用户自主性丧失等社会风险；第三方平台聚合并控制海量个人数据，使用户丧失数字身份主权。现有方案（区块链访问管理、联邦持有者主权平台、P2P覆盖网络）均未能同时回答交换时的三个核心问题：(1)请求者为何需要该数据（目的）；(2)请求者与数据主体是何关系；(3)满足任务所需的最小授权片段是什么。GDPR数据最小化原则和HIPAA最小必要标准要求按请求定制"最小充分"释放，但缺乏相应编译层。视角感知AI（PAi）将身份建模为可携带、可选择性披露的时序知识图谱"编年史"，但其跨域联邦披露缺乏最小必要约束机制。
AI.method: PPC协议的核心构造包括：(1) **授权函数 𝒜**：基于领域专家本体，对（关系r, 目的p, 节点/边x）三元组判定permit/deny，受目的限制（GDPR Art. 5(1)(b)、HIPAA TPO）和基于关系（ReBAC）的访问约束双重驱动。(2) **授权证据子图 S***：在约束（i）S⊆G_Cu、（ii）∀x∈V_S∪E_S: 𝒜(r,p,x)=permit、（iii）Sufficient(S,Q)下最小化|S|的子图。(3) **充分性校验器（Algorithm 1）**：非搜索型验证器，逐项检查节点/边授权、路径覆盖（PathCov，含本体包含匹配）、谓词类型完整性（PredComplete）、连通性和来源完整性（ProvComplete）；当LLM消费者可用时附加分布性细化（D(π_S‖π_a)≤ε）。(4) **两阶段联邦协议**：Phase 1授权证据编译（请求→规划→本地编译三步：授权过滤→相关性检索→最小化剪枝，采用Prize-Collecting Steiner Tree近似→装配→交付带来源引用的S*）；Phase 2原始资料释放（重新评估𝒜、更高用户类型门槛、逐项持有人明确批准）。(5) **威胁模型**：明确范围（恶意请求者超限、消费方推理推断、LLM提示注入）与假设外范围（拜占庭协调者、伪造凭证、持有人合谋、来源引用泄漏、规划器提示注入）。通过医疗域（药物相互作用评估）和诉讼域（证据开示）实例化，验证同一协议可通过替换本体、用户类型分类和披露策略三个旋钮适配不同监管领域。
AI.result: (1) **能力对比（Table 1）**：PPC是唯一同时满足持有人主权（Hold.Sov. ✓）、无账本（Ledger-free ✓）、编年史语义（Chronicle ✓）、目的（Purpose ✓）、关系（Relation ✓）和最小子图（Min.Sub. ✓）六项指标的系统；Solid仅满足前两项，MedRec为偏，其余均不支持。(2) **医疗案例**：患者Alice的Hospital A编年史片段共10条三元组，经R2-R6策略（拒账单R2、拒诊疗记录R3、拒精神诊断R4、允许处方/过敏R5、允许心脏诊断R6）后授权视图保留7条边；再经相关性检索和最小化剪枝后，S*仅含6条三元组（两条处方链+一条过敏边+一个上下文锚点），精神诊断、诊疗笔记和账单均不越界。(3) **诉讼案例**：同一协议通过诉讼本体（合同条款、通信、内部备忘录、财务记录、律师-客户特权）和策略适配证据开示需求，特权通过推理闭包处理。(4) **充分性四层次**的辨析：结构充分性（协议保证）、任务充分性、临床/法律充分性（含AFib指征等临床负重上下文）、LLM答案充分性（分布性细化）；揭示AFib案例中结构充分但临床不足的张力，最小化目标本身仍是开放问题。(5) **架构图（Figure 2）**：分层展示联邦对等网络→本地访问控制器（含提示队列、安全通道、LLM代理）→编年史结构（情境图→原始资料配对）。
AI.conclusion: PPC将编年史披露形式化为"时序谓词标记情境图上受策略约束的最小必要子图编译"问题，技术贡献在于：定义核心构造（授权函数、最小化目标、结构充分性条件）、将充分性校验器与编译搜索解耦、给出显式威胁模型、并通过医疗和诉讼两域实例化证明协议可适配不同监管领域。核心原则为"按请求所需的最小量共享"，两阶段流程确保文本先于原始资料释放。局限性：编年史编译的最优性无法全局证明（采用近似求解器）；隐私保护的跨持有人实体对齐仍依赖外部基元；规划器提示注入威胁尚未解决；最小化与效用（临床/法律充分性）之间存在张力。未来工作：形式化编译问题、实现高效近似、在PAi栈上原型化、构建带目的标注的编年史基准进行评估。本文为立场与协议设计论文，未报告实现或实证评估。

title: ConsistencyGate: Preventing Memory Contamination in LLM Agents via Self-Consistency Admission Control
comment: 24 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables, 1 algorithm; includes appendices
summary: LLM agents that operate over many turns accumulate facts in an external memory store and reuse them as premises for downstream reasoning. A hallucinated fact written at one step therefore persists as a false premise for every subsequent step, a failure mode we call memory contamination. Existing memory management addresses retrieval and capacity but not write-time correctness; this admission problem cannot be solved by utility- or recency-based criteria, and uncontrolled contamination compounds across long trajectories. We propose ConsistencyGate, a write-time admission gate that, before committing a candidate fact m extracted from context c, queries the LLM K times for a soft support score and admits m only when the average exceeds a threshold. The mechanism is model-agnostic, requires no fine-tuning, and reduces to a single forward pass in a log-probability variant for latency-sensitive deployments. To measure the effect on natural data, we construct two real-conversation benchmarks (LoCoMo-Contam and MSC-Contam) by planting controlled single-detail corruptions in long-term conversations from LoCoMo and MSC, and complement them with a structured synthetic corpus (MemContam) that isolates a near-oracle upper bound. Across four LLM backbones, ConsistencyGate reduces contamination on every benchmark relative to a write-everything baseline, with the cost concentrated on facts that are stated only implicitly in the source context. We release all three benchmarks together with the gate implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ConsistencyGate,一种在写入时刻基于自一致性(Self-Consistency)的"准入门控",通过 K 次采样查询 LLM 对候选事实在源上下文中的支持度,仅在平均得分超过阈值 τ 时才将其写入外部记忆,从而防止幻觉事实污染 LLM 智能体的长期记忆存储。
AI.motivation: 长程 LLM 智能体依赖外部记忆存储累积事实并在后续推理中复用;然而写入时产生的幻觉事实会作为错误前提持续影响后续所有步骤,作者将此失败模式定义为"记忆污染(memory contamination)"。现有的记忆管理方法仅关注检索质量与容量控制,无法解决"写入时刻正确性"这一准入(admission)问题;基于效用(相关性、新颖性、时效性)的准入准则对正确事实与其幻觉变体无法区分,因此结构性失明,污染会在长轨迹上逐级放大形成"污染级联"。
AI.method: ConsistencyGate 包装任意记忆写入器:对从上下文 c 抽取的候选事实 m,以软验证提示词向同一 LLM 进行 K 次采样,获得 0–1 区间的支持度 s_k,取均值 p̂(m|c)=(1/K)Σ s_k 作为一致性分数;当 p̂≥τ 时准入,否则拒绝。默认 τ=0.7、K=5,无需微调、与模型无关。另提供 LogProb 单次前向近似变体(读出 yes/no token 的 softmax 概率),以及基于记忆占用率 |M|/C 在 τ_min 与 τ_max 间线性调度的自适应阈值作为零调参后备。作者构建三个基准:结构化合成 MemContam(5 个固定上下文,200 样本,1000 正/1000 负),以及基于 LoCoMo 和 MSC 的真实对话基准 LoCoMo-Contam(50 探测对)和 MSC-Contam(41 探测对),均注入受控 50% 单细节污染。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 上,MemContam 将污染率由 50.0% 降至 1.2%,召回率保持 1.00,QA F1 由 0.474 提升至 0.840(近预言机上限);LoCoMo-Contam 污染率由 50.0% 降至 34.1%,准入精度由 0.500 提升至 0.659;MSC-Contam 污染率由 50.0% 降至 36.7%,精度由 0.500 提升至 0.633;干净 LoCoMo 上 QA F1 仅下降 1.5%(0.271→0.267)。跨四个骨干(Qwen2.5-32B、Gemma4-31B-IT、Llama4-Scout-17B-16E、Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct)均稳定降低污染,真实对话基准降幅 20%–62%;Llama-3.3-70B 验证能力最强(LogProb 与各 K/τ 下精度均接近 1.0)。消融显示 τ=0.7 为自然决策边界,K 从 1 增至 10 边际收益有限;LogProb 变体在结构化 MemContam 上达到 0.00%–1.57% 污染,延迟 23–28 ms/事实(较 K=5 提速 12–14 倍),但在长对话 LoCoMo-Contam 上每骨架均劣于软评分,呈现"yes/no 双峰性不对称"现象。
AI.conclusion: ConsistencyGate 将正确性引入记忆准入维度,与现有基于效用/容量的记忆管理形成互补而非竞争;跨模型一致的污染下降表明验证器能力是决定跨模型性能的主导因素,但并非硬性门槛。主要局限为隐式事实召回不足(LoCoMo-Contam 上 Recall=0.58,42% 正确事实被误拒,原因在于事实跨多轮分布且验证提示要求显式支持),因此更适合文档/工具输出类结构化写入场景,而不适用于多轮对话中涌现式记忆。

title: Reason Popper-ly: Patching In-Context Reasoning with Inductive Logic Programming
comment: Accepted at the 20th Conference on Neurosymbolic Learning and Reasoning
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting enables large language models (LLMs) to tackle multi-step reasoning tasks, yet the generated intermediate steps are not guaranteed to be logically sound. We present Reason Popper-ly, a neurosymbolic framework that uses inductive logic programming (ILP) to learn relation composition rules from reasoning traces and deploys them as an online verifier for step-level correction. Given an LLM-generated trace, the method checks each inferred step against the learned rule table, diagnoses the violation type, rewrites incorrect steps with symbolically derived repairs, and regenerates the remaining suffix so that the model can produce its final answer conditioned on a verified trace. We evaluate on CLUTRR, a multi-hop kinship reasoning benchmark, using five language models over reasoning chains of 2 to 10 hops. Across all models, Reason Popper-ly consistently improves terminal accuracy over standard CoT, with gains of up to 48 percentage points for small models and 15 points for frontier models on the longest chains. Compared with a fully exogenous symbolic pipeline, our method performs better on harder instances by preserving the model's successful grounding while correcting only verifiable reasoning failures. In addition, step-level ILP verification yields a fine-grained error taxonomy that provides diagnostic insight beyond final-answer accuracy.

AI.tldr: Reason Popper-ly 是一个神经符号框架,利用归纳逻辑编程(ILP)从思维链推理轨迹中学习关系组合规则,并将其作为在线验证器对大语言模型的推理步骤进行细粒度修正。在 CLUTRR 多跳亲缘推理基准上,该方法在所有测试模型上均持续提升终端准确率,小型模型在长链推理中提升最高达 48 个百分点,前沿模型提升最高达 15 个百分点。
AI.motivation: CoT 提示虽能激发 LLM 进行多步推理,但生成的中间步骤未必逻辑正确,且组合推理质量随推理深度增加而显著退化。现有神经符号方法存在四大局限:(1)规则获取依赖人工编写或重训练;(2)自然语言到形式谓词的接地瓶颈导致误差累积;(3)验证多为整条轨迹的二值判断,缺乏步骤级错误归因;(4)基于重试的修正方法丢弃正确中间步骤,缺乏针对性局部修正。论文旨在以学习到的符号规则作为模型自身推理轨迹的"在线护栏",实现步骤级干预。
AI.method: 框架分两阶段:(1)离线阶段——以 LLM 生成的 CoT 轨迹作为输入,通过方向规范化提取组合三元组 (r₁, r₂, r₃),并以正负样本形式馈入 Popper ILP 系统,诱导出关系组合表 R;(2)在线阶段——对新生成的轨迹逐步骤验证:将每条推断步骤解析为组合三元组并与 R 比对,识别违反项;按四类错误诊断(wrong_rule、missing_inv、direction_rev、hallucinated)分类;以符号化方式修补被违反步骤,丢弃后续受影响的后缀并基于修补后的前缀重新生成下游推理,迭代直至所有可验证违规消除,最终基于已验证轨迹生成答案。
AI.result: 在 CLUTRR 基准上对 5 个 LLM(Qwen-3.5:4B、Gemma-4:E4B、LLaMA-3.2:3B、Claude Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5.4)在 2–10 跳推理链上的实验显示:(1)Reason Popper-ly 在所有模型、所有深度上均优于标准 CoT,8–10 跳时小型模型提升 23.76–48.35 个百分点,前沿模型提升 4.59–15.18 个百分点;(2)随深度增加,Reason Popper-ly 相对于完全外生符号管道的优势扩大,8–10 跳时领先 4.59(Claude)至 20.52(Gemma)个百分点,说明其更好地保留了模型自身成功的接地;(3)错误分类揭示模型特有的失效画像——小型模型以 wrong_rule 为主(43–49%),前沿模型则以 missing_inv 占绝对主导(75–78%),表明规模扩大减少了核心组合错误但未能消除结构化推理失误,且几乎不存在 hallucinated 错误(0–2%)。
AI.conclusion: Reason Popper-ly 证明了在 CoT 推理中,符号推理支持不必完全取代模型生成推理——一个选择性修补无效步骤的轻量级验证器即可在无约束 CoT 与完全符号委派之间提供实用的中间地带。规模提升虽减少了核心组合错误,但并未消除结构化推理失败,反而将主要失效模式转向关系方向规范化错误;因此,即便对前沿模型,符号验证护栏仍具实用价值。论文同时指出,该方法的可靠性依赖于 CoT 轨迹对最终答案具有因果相关性的前提,且当前评估局限于亲缘推理等结构化领域。

title: Stress-testing large language model agents in a robotic chemistry laboratory
summary: AI is evaluated through knowledge, reasoning and plan generation, yet scientific agency requires reliable physical action and adaptation to evidence. Here, we use a robotic chemistry laboratory as a physical-world testbed to make scientific agency measurable. Its 45 modular workstations exposed as machine-readable skills enabled 4,608 trials. Only 3.3% of trials produced expert-assessed executable workflows under laboratory constraints; even the best system achieved 28.1%. Long-horizon planning remained a challenge: only three executable workflows exceeded 30 operations, although the longest contained 44. Across five rounds, experimental feedback prompted local adjustments but no workflow-level replanning or analytical-method redesign. By making physical executability and evidence-driven replanning measurable, our study provides an evidence-based assessment of deployment readiness and a diagnostic framework to guide closed-loop improvements towards physically grounded autonomous research.

AI.tldr: 本文以模块化机器人化学实验室作为物理世界测试平台，量化评估AI的科学代理能力。研究涉及45个可机器读取的化学技能工作站，共执行4,608次试验，结果显示仅3.3%的试验能生成实验室约束下的可执行工作流，最佳系统也仅达28.1%，且长程规划与证据驱动的全局重规划仍是关键瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有AI评估主要聚焦于知识、推理与计划生成等认知层面，但科学研究的真实价值在于可靠的物理执行与基于实验证据的自适应调整能力。论文旨在将"科学代理"(scientific agency)从抽象能力转化为可度量的物理执行指标，弥补AI评估中物理具身性与闭环验证的空白。
AI.method: 构建一个模块化机器人化学实验室，部署45个以机器可读技能接口暴露的工作站，形成物理世界测试床。系统要求AI生成完整的工作流，并在实验室约束下执行。通过大规模试验（4,608次）评估：(1) 工作流的可执行性；(2) 长程规划能力（操作步骤数）；(3) 基于实验反馈的自适应重规划与重新设计能力（多轮迭代）。采用专家评估作为可执行性的判定标准。
AI.result: 关键结果包括：(1) 仅3.3%的试验生成专家认可的可执行工作流，最佳系统达28.1%；(2) 长程规划能力薄弱——只有3个工作流超过30个操作步骤，最长为44步；(3) 经过5轮实验反馈，系统仅进行局部参数调整，未出现工作流级别的重规划或分析方法重新设计，说明闭环自适应能力严重不足。
AI.conclusion: 研究将物理可执行性与证据驱动重规划转化为可量化指标，提供了基于证据的AI部署就绪度评估方法，并构建了诊断框架，为迈向物理具身的闭环自主科学研究指明了改进方向。当前AI在长程规划与全局重规划上的显著短板，揭示了从"认知智能"到"具身科学代理"之间的关键差距。

title: SymStep: Symbolic Step Verification for Logical Reasoning
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting can fail severely on constraint-dense logical reasoning tasks, where unverified errors accumulate silently across steps. We introduce SymStep: an LLM makes one atomic claim at a time (DEDUCE: Alice, pet, Cat), then a lightweight constraint propagator checks the claim for consistency with prior accepted deductions, rejects contradictions, and cascades implied facts automatically. SymStep+G additionally provides MRV guidance after each accepted step, directing the LLM toward the most constrained unresolved variable. On a 35-puzzle retained subset of ZebraLogicBench, a benchmark of 1,000 Einstein-style logic puzzles, Direct and CoT both achieve 0%, while SymStep+G reaches 97%. On AR-LSAT analytical reasoning problems, SymStep achieves 100% vs. CoT's 87%. On LGP-14, SymStep+G achieves 100% vs. 0% for CoT and Logic-LM, the strongest prior symbolic+LLM baseline we compare against. Ablation studies reveal that MRV guidance is a key mechanism for reducing directionless cycling, while consistency checking provides a safety net against explicit contradictions. Across six benchmarks spanning five task domains, SymStep variants match or exceed every baseline on constraint-dense and arithmetic tasks. Experiments on AQUA-RAT algebra confirm the advantage is constraint-density-specific.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SymStep 框架，通过让 LLM 每次输出一个原子断言，并配合轻量级约束传播器进行逐步验证，并可选地加入 MRV（最小剩余值）启发式引导，来解决 LLM 在约束密集型逻辑推理任务中因未验证错误累积而失败的问题。在六个基准测试中（涵盖网格谜题、排程、算术、金融推理等形式约束任务），SymStep 系列方法均匹配或超越包括 Logic-LM 在内的所有基线，尤其在 ZebraLogicBench（97% vs CoT 0%）、LGP-14（100% vs CoT 0%）和 AR-LSAT（100% vs CoT 87%）上表现突出。消融实验表明 MRV 引导是性能提升的主要驱动力，约束一致性检查则作为安全网防止显式矛盾。该方法的优势具有"约束密度特异性"，在 AQUA-RAT 代数等非约束密集任务中并不带来增益。
AI.motivation: LLM 在多步逻辑推理任务（尤其是约束密集型任务，如爱因斯坦式逻辑网格谜题）上表现极差，CoT 和 Direct 在 ZebraLogicBench、LGP-14 上均为 0%。作者识别出两种主要失败模式：(1) 未验证的步骤累积（unverified step accumulation）——推理链条中的错误未被检测，后续步骤基于错误前提继续推理；(2) 演绎死锁（deductive deadlock）——LLM 在没有外部引导的情况下循环推理而无进展。现有方法存在局限：Logic-LM、LINC 等采用一次性将整个问题翻译为形式逻辑再交给求解器，对翻译错误毫无抵抗力；DVCOTR、Self-Refine 等用 LLM 自身做验证器，无法发现 LLM 自身的错误和偏差。
AI.method: SymStep 框架的核心是 Deduce 协议：LLM 每次仅输出一个原子断言，格式为 DEDUCE: Entity, attribute, Value 或 NOT Value，正则表达式即可解析。约束传播器维护一个可能性矩阵 Π(p,a) ⊆ V_a，接受每个断言后执行：(1) 检查一致性（若 v ∉ Π(p,a) 则返回 contradiction）；(2) 通过正向更新从其他实体的同属性中消除该值；(3) 执行单元传播（弧一致性级联），若某单元收缩为单值则自动级联推导。SymStep+G 在每次接受后附加 MRV 提示，指向剩余候选值最少的未确定变量 (p*, a*) = argmin|Π(p,a)|，以自然语言形式反馈给 LLM。该方法不需形式逻辑训练，传播器每次调用时间复杂度 O(n²k)。
AI.result: 主要结果（在 Claude Haiku 上）：(1) LGP-14 上 SymStep+G 达 100%（14/14），而 CoT 与 Logic-LM 均为 0%；(2) ZebraLogicBench 35 题保留子集上 SymStep+G 达 97%，Direct 与 CoT 均为 0%；(3) AR-LSAT 15 题上 SymStep 达 100%（CoT 为 87%）；(4) MWP-8（算术）和 FIN-6（金融推理）上 SymStep 变体达 100%；(5) SP-6（排程）上 SymStep 达 83%，SymStep+G 为 67%（差异在 n=6 时统计上不显著，因为 MRV 引导有时会打乱自然推理顺序）。消融研究（表 9）显示：仅引导达 100%（σ=0），仅验证达 72%（σ=9.6%），证明引导是主要驱动因素，验证是安全网。在 Sonnet 上 SymStep 也达 90%（LGP-10 子集），证明架构与模型无关。AQUA-RAT 代数测试确认该优势具约束密度特异性（SymStep+G 与 CoT 同为 89%）。整个 LGP-14 基准测试成本约 0.0013 美元/题，总成本不到两美分。
AI.conclusion: SymStep 通过"每次一个声明、一次确定性检查"的细粒度验证有效解决了 LLM 在约束密集型逻辑推理任务中的核心失败模式。在六个跨领域基准上达到 83–100% 准确率，Wilson 置信区间证实 SymStep+G 在 LGP-14 和 ZebraLogicBench 上的下界严格超过所有基线的上界，具有统计显著性。研究表明：(1) 引导（MRV）是性能提升的主要驱动因素，LLM 的瓶颈不在于错误推断而在于无方向搜索；(2) 验证提供形式化的一致性保证，防止不一致事实进入 LLM 上下文；(3) 该方法的优势具约束密度特异性，仅在双射约束传播有用的任务上有效。该工作通过发布 LGP-20 基准（20 道经过验证的谜题）和开源代码推动后续研究。局限：仅在 119 个实例和两个模型家族上验证，未来工作可扩展至 ProofWriter、FOLIO 等基准及 GPT-4、o1、DeepSeek-R1 等更强模型；自适应引导（基于约束密度调整提示强度）是潜在改进方向。

title: Structure over Depth: A Single-Block Spatio-Temporal Transformer for Multi-Entity Reasoning
summary: Modeling multi-entity temporal data requires capturing dependencies across entities, time, and their interactions. Transformer-based approaches perform well but often rely on deep stacks of layers to learn these heterogeneous dependencies implicitly, increasing computational cost. We revisit this problem from a structural perspective and decompose multi-entity temporal dynamics into three interaction types: spatial interactions among entities, temporal interactions across time, and cross interactions coupling the two domains. We propose a structured spatio-temporal transformer block that explicitly models all three within a single stage. It uses parallel spatial and temporal self-attention, followed by bidirectional cross-attention, and combines the outputs through learnable gated fusion. By directly encoding these complementary views, the model reduces the need for deep stacking. We evaluate the approach on video-based group activity recognition, skeleton-based human interaction analysis, and wearable sensor-based activity recognition. Despite its simplicity, the single structured Transformer block matches or outperforms deeper architectures with only 1.76M parameters. The results suggest that depth in prior models partly compensates for implicit and entangled interaction modeling, whereas explicit factorization offers a more efficient and transparent alternative. More broadly, this work supports a structure-first design principle: expressive multi-entity temporal reasoning can emerge by exposing interaction structure rather than relying on depth.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种"结构优先"的设计理念，用单个结构化的时空Transformer块（通过并行空间/时间自注意力+双向交叉注意力+门控融合）显式建模空间、时间与跨域交互，仅1.76M参数即可在视频群体活动识别、骨架交互识别和可穿戴传感器活动识别三大类任务上匹配或超越更深的Transformer架构。
AI.motivation: 现有基于Transformer的时空模型依赖深层堆叠来隐式学习实体间、时序间及二者耦合的异构依赖关系，导致参数量、计算量和延迟较高，难以部署于边缘设备。作者提出核心问题：多实体时空推理真正需要多少深度？多少可以被显式的交互结构替代？作者假设深度在很大程度上是为了弥补隐式且纠缠的交互建模，因而显式分解可作为更高效透明的替代方案。
AI.method: 1) 统一多实体时空表示：将视频裁剪、骨架序列、传感器流编码为统一的实体-时间张量 Z₀∈R^{T×M×D}，并融合边界框/轨迹ID/位置ID等结构线索；2) 全局组令牌拼接：为每帧附加可学习令牌以保留帧级全局状态；3) 结构化时空交互块——单阶段显式分解三种交互：a) 空间自注意力（帧内实体间）；b) 时间自注意力（实体跨帧演化）；c) 双向交叉注意力（时空特征互为QKV后平均）；d) 可学习门控融合三路输出，并配合残差+LayerNorm+FFN；4) 注意力池化+MLP分类头。整体仅用单个结构化块即可。
AI.result: 在Volleyball上达到MCA 94.6%/MMCA 95.3%，Collective Activity MPCA 97.47%（均为最佳/次佳）；骨架任务NTU60跨主体93.62%、NTU120跨主体88.94%，参数1.76M、0.49GFLOPs（远低于多数对比方法）；传感器HAR在PAMAP2/Opportunity/UCI-HAR上准确率分别达99.76%/99.71%/99.02%，均刷新最优。深度敏感性实验显示首个块贡献最大，额外堆叠增益有限甚至下降；消融实验证实空间、时间、跨域三路互补，且空间分支影响最大；门控权重可视化显示模型在不同模态下自适应调整各交互的相对重要性。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明：显式分解空间-时间-跨域三种交互并通过单结构化块融合，可在多模态多实体任务上以极小参数量获得强性能，计算量较先前模型降低约17-19倍，支持边缘/实时部署；揭示了先前深度模型的"深度"部分是在补偿隐式纠缠建模；提出"结构优先"的设计原则——让交互结构显式暴露出来，而非依赖深度堆叠。局限：缺乏对此现象的形式化理论分析，性能仍依赖模态特定的实体表示质量。

title: Compiler-Grounded Hierarchical Diagnosis for LLM-Based Triton Kernel Optimization
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled automated kernel generation and optimization, but most existing approaches rely on surface signals such as compilation feedback and profiling metrics. These signals reveal that a kernel is slow, but not why the backend compiler fails to realize a profitable optimization, especially on emerging accelerators such as NPUs. We therefore formulate kernel optimization as a progressive cross-layer diagnosis problem that links runtime symptoms to IR structure and compiler behavior before rewriting source. Based on this insight, we present our system, a compiler-grounded and hierarchical optimization framework for Triton kernels. the system escalates from lightweight pattern triage and profiling diagnosis to IR attribution and compiler-grounded analysis only when deeper evidence is needed, then proposes evidence-backed source-level rewrites. We implement the system on Triton for Ascend NPUs and evaluate it on 37 successfully converted entries from a standardized NPUKernelBench-derived Ascend 950 benchmark. Across these entries, the system attains a geometric-mean speedup of 4.35$\times$ and a median speedup of 2.73$\times$ from the initial to optimized Triton kernel; 22/37 exceed 2$\times$ and 13/37 exceed 5$\times$. The complete distribution ranges from near-baseline entries to large wins, motivating transparent reporting of the current system's scope and limitations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向Triton内核优化的"编译器接地（compiler-grounded）+ 分层诊断"LLM优化框架，将内核优化重构为跨层诊断问题，从轻量级模式分类逐步升级到性能分析、IR归因和编译器源级分析，最终提出有证据支持的源码改写。在基于Ascend 950 NPU的NPUKernelBench衍生基准上，37个成功转换条目获得4.35×几何均值加速和2.73×中位数加速。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动的内核优化方法主要依赖编译反馈和运行时性能指标等"浅层信号"，只能揭示"内核慢"，却无法解释"为何编译器未能实现有利的优化"。在新兴加速器（如Ascend NPU）上，Triton-Ascend栈仍在演进，后端行为对开发者而言相对不透明，导致LLM智能体退化为试错式优化器。本文以MoE group-score内核为运行示例，指出性能剖析可定位标量密集的"症状"，但无法判断其根源位于源码控制流、IR层降级还是后端实现约束，这一语义鸿沟正是源码级试错不可靠的根本原因。
AI.method: 系统采用四层分级诊断工作流：(L1) 模式分类——查询策划模式索引，结合Triton惯用模式、自动调优、块指针、编译器提示以及从历史优化回合提炼的内部模式，若已有低风险改写则停止；(L2) 性能剖析诊断——收集延迟、吞吐、硬件计数器等运行时证据，定位瓶颈类别（内存、流水重叠、调度开销）；(L3) IR归因——重建Triton到下游编译器的IR轨迹，识别非单位步长加载、错失融合、布局诱导向量化失败等结构问题；(L4) 编译器源升级——调用编译器接地分析，解释IR模式阻塞后端优化的具体约束。系统采用三条升级规则（瓶颈定位、改写家族收敛、证据自洽），并配套跨算子回顾性综合循环，将已验证机制回写至模式指导层。实现上采用智能体-中心架构，集成至CannBot技能仓库，由执行支撑层（管理回合状态机、验证门）与分级技能层协同工作。
AI.result: 在NPUKernelBench衍生的Ascend 950基准上，使用OpenCode+DeepSeek V4 Pro作为智能体，15轮优化后，37个成功转换条目获得几何均值4.35×、中位数2.73×的初始到优化Triton加速；22/37超过2×，13/37超过5×；分布从近基线到大幅提升呈现长尾分布。Level 1组19个算子几何均值7.29×，Level 2组18个算子2.51×。与Torch NPU后优化对比（35个算子，1678个案例）几何均值2.60×、中位数1.46×。优化过程统计显示：最佳验证轮次中位数=10，22/37在第8轮后才达到最佳；获胜轮次归属——33个模式分类、4个剖析诊断、0个IR归因、0个编译器源级；但完整轨迹中32条到达剖析诊断、3条到达IR归因、4条到达编译器源级。Hyena FFT填充算子被选为代表性跨层诊断轨迹，最终达到2.08×加速。
AI.conclusion: 本文论证了编译器接地、分层诊断式内核优化的可行性，将内核优化从一次性源码改写重构为渐进式跨层诊断问题。当前的NPUKernelBench衍生评估达到4.35×几何均值加速且分布广泛，表明该方法在子集算子上具有可观收益空间，但也存在显著异质性。论文坦承当前局限：缺乏与剖析专用或始终深度推理策略的受控消融实验、未冻结工具链对比、token成本或墙钟时间报告，以及未分离回顾性综合循环与种子模式指导的贡献。未来工作将围绕更强的系统评估、成本核算与层级消融展开。

title: SQBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Task Delivery by Language-Model Agents in Production-Oriented Workflows
comment: 17 pages, 8 figures. Code and aggregate results: this https URL
summary: Existing evaluations of large language models cover knowledge, reasoning, coding, and tool use, but they rarely treat a verifiable deliverable produced within a constrained workflow as the unit of evaluation. We introduce SQBench, a benchmark for evaluating production-oriented task delivery by language-model agents. SQBench v1.0 contains 220 standardized tasks organized into L1 atomic capabilities, L2 composite skills, and L3 business scenarios. Each task requires an agent to process input assets, use available tools, and produce an explicitly specified deliverable. The evaluation first computes functional Completion and then derives Risk Penalty and Performance from independently evidenced triggers in a 10D Risk Matrix. A Strict Pass requires Completion = 1 and Risk Penalty = 0. We evaluate 27 model configurations under a common protocol, with one run per configuration-task pair. The highest prespecified Weighted Pass@1 is 60.5%. Mean Strict Pass@1 on L3 is 18.5%, and every configuration performs worse on L3 than on both L1 and L2, indicating that delivery under domain constraints is a shared weakness within the current task set. Of 2,348 results with Completion = 1, 113 (4.8%) fail the Strict Pass criterion because of risks such as unverifiable citations, inappropriate resource use, or format violations. These results show that functional completion alone does not fully characterize delivery quality and that risk determinations should be reported separately.

AI.tldr: SQBench 是一个面向"生产导向任务交付"的大语言模型智能体评测基准，包含 220 个版本化任务（L1 原子能力 100、L2 复合技能 60、L3 业务场景 60），通过"完成度 + 10 维风险矩阵 + Strict Pass"的联合评判框架，对 27 个模型配置进行单次运行评测；最高 Weighted Pass@1 为 60.5%（Kimi K3），L3 平均仅 18.5%，且 4.8% 的功能性完成结果因风险触发而无法通过 Strict Pass。
AI.motivation: 现有评测（MMLU、GAIA、SWE-bench、GDPval 等）多以"答案正确性"或"环境终态"为评估单元，难以覆盖生产场景中的文件、格式、路径、合规、可审计等约束。一个语义上正确的回答可能因缺少文件、不可解析、工具状态误读或证据不可追溯而无法被下游流程消费。SQBench 将"在受限工作流中产出可验证交付物"作为独立的评估对象，补足现有基准在交付质量与审计维度上的空白。
AI.method: 四原则设计：工作流抽象、可验证交付物、风险评估、任务内可比性。任务层分为 L1（指令遵循、长上下文、动态代码、边界处理）、L2（办公协作、数据分析、深度研究、软件工程）、L3（金融、工业、医疗、政务四个行业 × 复杂业务/定量审计/合规风控三类）。评分采用确定性自动检查（113 个任务）与 LLM 法官（107 个任务，权重预设）加权合成得到 Completion（0–1）；10D 风险矩阵涵盖事实与出处幻觉、格式违规、合规越界、资源滥用、工具状态幻觉、过早终止、知识边界、谄媚欺骗、过程不透明、上下文污染，每维有预设罚分；Performance = max(0, Completion − Risk Penalty)，Strict Pass ⇔ Completion=1 且 Risk Penalty=0。主聚合指标 Weighted Pass@1 = 0.2·L1 + 0.6·L2 + 0.2·L3。所有 27 配置在统一任务版本、初始资产、工具权限与评分规则下对 220 任务各运行一次，不做重采样或择优。
AI.result: （1）整体表现有限：最高 Weighted Pass@1 为 Kimi K3 的 60.5%，Simple Pass@1 54.5%；Claude Opus 4.8 (Max) 57.6%、GLM-5.2 (Max) 52.7% 居前列；最低 Nemotron 3 Ultra 仅 14.7%。（2）L3 是普遍短板：L1/L2/L3 平均 Strict Pass@1 分别为 39.8%/53.1%/18.5%，27 个配置无一例外在 L3 弱于 L1 与 L2；L3 四个行业（金融 13.8%、工业 17.8%、医疗 20.7%、政务 21.7%）均低于 22%，定量审计类任务均值仅 10.7%。（3）风险调节使交付质量进一步下降：Performance 较 Completion 平均低 7.5 个百分点（区间 4.2–11.3）；2348 个 Completion=1 的结果中 113 个（4.8%）因风险未通过 Strict Pass，集中在 L2（10.0%），主因为 D4 资源滥用、D1 出处幻觉、D6 过早终止、D2 格式违规、D9 过程不透明。案例显示某 L2 市场调研任务虽 Completion=1.00，却因引用链接不可验证触发 D1（罚分 0.80），Performance 仅 0.20。（4）权重敏感性分析显示，L1/L2/L3 = 0.2/0.6/0.2 的主聚合与其他四种方案 Spearman 相关性均 ≥0.936，Kimi K3 在所有方案下均位列第一。
AI.conclusion: SQBench 证明：（1）生产导向交付是独立且有意义的评估维度，不能被功能性完成度替代；（2）当前 LLM 智能体在领域受限交付（L3）上存在系统性短板，且跨行业普遍存在；（3）将"完成度"与"风险"分离报告能揭示功能性成功背后的可审计性问题，4.8% 的"完成但未通过"比例说明 Strict Pass 指标在 v1.0 任务集上具备区分度。论文同时坦承局限：v1.0 任务为工作模式抽象而非统计抽样；LLM 法官存在已知偏差且未报告人评一致性；风险维度与罚分未经实证校准；单次运行不估计不确定性；官方任务隐藏以防泄露，限制了外部直接审计。论文将 SQBench 定位为知识/智能体/工作类基准的补充，呼吁未来扩展任务与行业覆盖、引入人评与多法官验证、并提供可控的评测访问机制。

title: AgentOmnia: Scaling Agentic Models for Full-Scenario Applications
summary: Large language model agents have advanced rapidly, yet progress remains fragmented across domains, capabilities, task difficulty, and interaction settings. We frame this as full-scenario agentic scaling and present AgentOmnia, a framework coordinating task-space definition, data synthesis, post-training, evaluation, and improvement across To-Consumer (ToC), To-Business (ToB), and To-Employee (ToE) applications. An extensible Domain x Capability x Atomic Difficulty taxonomy aligns these stages and enables fine-grained diagnosis with OmniaBench. AgentOmnia combines bidirectional environment-task synthesis with tool-dependency, program-structured, and solver-based pipelines, constructing 5,018 stateful environments with 255,375 tools and 52,361 tasks. Programs, solvers, and verifiers provide correctness signals, while supervised fine-tuning, online agentic reinforcement learning, and a rollback curriculum support post-training. Evaluation failures translate into Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) for targeted self-evolution. Starting from Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507, AgentOmnia raises the pass rate on the OmniaBench challenging subset from 9.16% to 37.11% and the macro-average across OmniaBench, $\tau^2$-Bench, DeepPlanning, and VitaBench from 22.86% to 41.69%. Under a unified protocol,it leads the evaluated agentic post-trained baselines on OmniaBench and retains the highest four-benchmark macro-average. It also surpasses Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507 on all four benchmarks and exceeds Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on the macro-average. Gains span three application splits, ten capability dimensions, eight atomic-difficulty factors, and 76 of 90 level-1 domains, indicating broad rather than category-specific improvement. A one-round study provides initial evidence for PRD-guided self-evolution, motivating validation at larger scales and in industrial settings.

AI.tldr: AgentOmnia 是一个面向"全场景智能体扩展"的统一框架,通过任务空间定义、数据合成、后训练、评估与改进的协同,在 ToC、ToB、ToE 三类应用中系统提升大语言模型智能体的能力。基于 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507,其将 OmniaBench 困难子集通过率从 9.16% 提升至 37.11%,并在四个基准上取得领先。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型智能体研究在不同领域、能力、任务难度和交互设置上高度碎片化,缺乏统一的扩展框架。作者将这一现状概括为"全场景智能体扩展"问题,旨在打通任务定义、数据合成、后训练、评估与改进的全流程,实现跨场景的泛化提升。
AI.method: 1) 提出可扩展的 Domain × Capability × Atomic Difficulty 三维分类法,并据此构建 OmniaBench 细粒度诊断基准;2) 双向环境-任务合成结合工具依赖、程序结构化与求解器三类流水线,构建 5,018 个有状态环境、255,375 个工具与 52,361 个任务;3) 由程序、求解器与验证器提供正确性信号;4) 后训练结合监督微调、在线智能体强化学习与回滚课程;5) 评估失败转化为产品需求文档(PRD),驱动针对性自进化。
AI.result: 从 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 出发,OmniaBench 挑战子集通过率从 9.16% 提升到 37.11%;OmniaBench、τ²-Bench、DeepPlanning、VitaBench 的宏平均从 22.86% 提升到 41.69%。在统一协议下,其在 OmniaBench 上领先所有评估的智能体后训练基线,并保持四基准最高宏平均;同时在四个基准上均超越 Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507,宏平均超过 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B。提升覆盖三类应用、十项能力维度、八项原子难度因子及 90 个一级领域中的 76 个,体现广泛而非类别特定的改进。一轮 PRD 引导自进化研究提供了初步证据。
AI.conclusion: AgentOmnia 验证了"全场景统一框架"在智能体扩展中的可行性,通过闭环的任务合成、监督微调、强化学习、评估与 PRD 驱动的自进化实现了跨领域、跨能力的广泛性能提升,并展示了以小模型超越更大基线的潜力,为工业级智能体自进化研究提供了方向。

title: CachedSearch: Training-Free Cached Exploration for Test-Time Search in Video Diffusion
summary: Test-time search lets small video diffusion models rival larger ones, but costs 2-10x more. All candidates are fully denoised, although most are discarded. Training-free caching makes each rollout 2-3x faster at near-lossless quality. Composition is safe only if lossy caching preserves verifier rankings. We present the first study of whether caching corrupts candidate ranking in video test-time search. On Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B with an adaptive caching wrapper (~2x per-candidate speedup), ImageReward scores seed-matched cached and full rollouts. Median per-prompt Spearman rank correlation is 0.905, with 72% top-1 agreement on the VBench suite. VBench-2.0 replicates this result on a harder suite. Recomputing the cached winner at full compute retains 90-94% of the full-search gain. Errors cluster among near-tied candidates, making corruption self-limiting. This finding leads to CachedSearch. It explores every candidate with aggressive caching, then re-generates only the winner at full compute. At N=8, it captures 94.7% of best-of-N's gain at 63% of the cost. Capture rises with width. At matched budget, it searches twice as wide for 38% more gain. The result holds from 1.3B-14B across six models and four families: Wan, LTX, CogVideoX, and Hunyuan. Wan2.1-14B matches the 1.3B model's fidelity. Mid-trajectory pruning multiplies the exploration saving to 3.11x at 88.6% capture. Ports to other model families require recalibrating a single parameter, showing that fidelity tracks architecture rather than parameter count. CachedSearch is training-free, verifier-agnostic, and orthogonal to the search algorithm, making it a plug-in multiplier for test-time scaling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CachedSearch，一种训练免费的"探索廉价、提交完整"框架，通过对视频扩散模型测试时搜索的所有候选使用激进缓存来加速排序，仅对获胜种子以全计算重新生成。在N=8时，仅以63%的成本捕获了94.7%的best-of-N收益。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散模型的测试时搜索需要2-10倍于单样本的计算成本（生成N个候选并选择最佳），而训练免费的缓存加速虽能将单次推出加速2-3倍，但其研究仅关注种子匹配的保真度（PSNR/SSIM），而非是否保留验证器对候选的相对排序。将缓存与搜索组合的关键问题是：有损缓存是否会扰乱验证器的排序，从而破坏搜索的有效性。
AI.method: 1) 使用基于变换向量（transformation vector）的自适应缓存包装器（EasyCache风格），通过累积输入漂移指标a与阈值τ控制跳过。2) CachedSearch算法：所有N个候选以激进缓存生成（成本NC_c），用验证器评分（ImageReward），选出获胜种子后以全计算重新生成该单个种子（成本C_f）。3) 在CFG下为条件与非条件分支维护独立的缓存状态。4) 推导高斯秩相关模型（Proposition 1-5）量化排序噪声如何转化为搜索遗憾（regret）与收益捕获（capture）。
AI.result: 1) 在Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B上，缓存与全计算推出的中位每提示Spearman秩相关ρ=0.905，72% top-1一致。2) 在N=8时，CachedSearch-commit以63.3%的成本捕获94.7%的best-of-8收益；在等预算下搜索宽度翻倍，收益提升38%。3) 排序错误集中在候选得分接近平局的提示上（corr(spread, ρ)=+0.31），是自限制的。4) 该结论在六个模型、四个架构家族（Wan、LTX、CogVideoX、Hunyuan）1.3B-14B范围均成立；通过每家族阈值τ重新校准可转移到CogVideoX和Hunyuan。5) 与中途剪枝组合实现3.11×探索加速（88.6%捕获）。6) Wan2.1-14B与1.3B模型达到相同的中位ρ=0.905，表明保真度跟随架构而非参数量。
AI.conclusion: 任何有损加速器都可以用于探索阶段，只要它能通过排序加遗憾审计（ranking-plus-regret audit）。被丢弃的候选无需像素保真，只需保留诚实排序。论文结果将测试时缓存从"保真度问题"重新定义为"排序问题"，证明缓存可作为测试时缩放的插件式乘法器，与搜索算法正交、与验证器无关。

title: Characterisation of Density-based FM generation methods in the context of Information Fusion
summary: Fuzzy Integral (FI) based aggregation provides a powerful mechanism for nuanced aggregation, for example, in ensemble approaches or decision-level fusion more generally. The main challenge of this approach is the appropriate parametrization of the Fuzzy Measure (FM), which captures the worths of the individual components--and their combinations--which are being fused. Here, widely used approaches including the Sugeno-$\lambda$ and Decomposable FMs, parametrize the FM by extrapolating from the densities, i.e. the weights associated with individual sources, while respecting the FM's monotonicity constraint. This paper articulates that this information is, in general, insufficient to uniquely identify a discrete FM; but shows how an interval-valued FM can indeed be determined uniquely. We proceed to show how the incorporation of additional information beyond the above, such as the choice of a specific FI and a dataset, then allows for obtaining even more specific interval-valued FMs. In practice, establishing the quality of an empirically determined FM is not trivial. To help address this, we show how the likelihood with which a resulting interval FM encompasses the `ideal', i.e. the commonly intangible, best, or ground-truth numeric FM, can be determined, producing a confidence interval at a given confidence level. Finally, based on a series of experiments, we demonstrate empirically that the Choquet FI output based on this FM can also be regarded as the confidence interval for the `ideal' information fusion result, providing a novel means to characterize FI fusion outcomes a priori and charting a pathway for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文针对基于密度（densities）生成模糊测度（FM）的方法进行系统性表征，提出一种由粗到精的三层区间值模糊测度框架（FM_CA → FM_CS → FM_CI），从理论上证明密度与单调性约束信息不足以唯一确定离散FM，但足以确定区间值FM，并首次实现了对模糊积分（FI）融合结果的先验置信区间表征。
AI.motivation: 基于模糊积分（FI）的信息融合中，传统方法（如Sugeno-λ FM、⊥-分解FM）仅利用各信息源的密度值与FM的单调性约束来生成离散数值FM。然而：(1) 此类信息是否足以唯一确定FM尚不明确；(2) 实际中"理想FM"通常不可获得且具有不确定性，传统方法缺乏对融合结果质量的置信度刻画能力。本文旨在解决这两个根本问题。
AI.method:
1. **FM_CA（上下文无关区间值FM）**：基于密度与单调性约束，推导出每个子集组合的取值区间下界为子集中最大密度，上界为1（或k=I时为1），并证明其满足单调性约束。

2. **FM_CS（上下文相关区间值FM）**：利用蒙特卡洛（MC）从FM_CA中采样s个离散FM，针对特定FI（如Choquet积分）和数据集计算每个FM的MAE性能，选取前l%最优FM，取其最小/最大值分别作为各组合的下/上界。

3. **FM_CI（置信区间值FM）**：在FM_CS基础上，采用Bootstrap方法（重采样次数1000，百分位数法）对下界和上界分别构建双侧1-α置信区间，取下界α/2分位数与上界1-α/2分位数组成FM_CI，并强制修正以维持单调性。

4. **置信水平验证**：通过重复生成过程，统计"理想FM"或真值落入FM_CI的频率，测试实际置信水平是否与1-α一致；并以Choquet积分输出对真值的覆盖率作为代理指标。
AI.result:
1. **理论结果**：证明传统Sλ-FM、DFM（bounded sum与max形式）虽均落于FM_CA内，但位置差异显著（详见Fig.3）；FM_CA、FM_CI均满足单调性约束（定理1、2）；FM_CI覆盖FM_CS的置信水平为1-α+α²/4（定理3）。

2. **合成实验（3源融合）**：当阈值l=0.004时，FM_CI可作为"理想FM"的99%与95%置信区间；Choquet积分输出对真值的覆盖率与FM_CI的覆盖率呈正相关，可作为后者的代理检验指标。

3. **真实案例（Li等人的17号客户评价案例，4属性15样本）**：当α=0.05、l=0.01时，FM_CI为"理想FM"的95%置信区间；第9个样本的Choquet积分输出[0.4438, 0.5711]即为总体评价值的95%置信区间。

4. **首次提出**：Choquet FI输出可直接解释为"理想"融合结果的先验置信区间。
AI.conclusion: 本文系统表征了基于密度的FM生成方法，核心贡献在于：(1) 阐明密度+单调性约束仅足以确定区间值FM（FM_CA），不足以确定离散FM；(2) 提出基于MC的FM_CS构建方法以引入FI与数据集信息；(3) 通过Bootstrap方法将FM_CS升级为具有置信度量的FM_CI；(4) 首次实现对FI融合结果的先验置信区间表征。局限性包括：密度被视为精确值（未考虑区间或模糊值情形）、MC计算开销较大、置信水平保证基于经验而非严格理论。后续研究方向包括：区间值密度的拓展、降低计算复杂度、应用于集成分类任务、超参数l的自适应选择方法。

title: CAPT: A Multi-task Continuous Autoregressive Transformer enabling Cross-dataset and Cross-species Transfer for Calcium Population Dynamics
summary: Large-scale calcium imaging has created an opportunity to build foundation-style models for neural population dynamics, but a central question remains unresolved: \textbf{whether a model pretrained on one collection of recordings can generalize to new datasets, experimental paradigms, and even species.} Existing approaches are often designed for specific tasks and evaluated on a single dataset, making it unclear whether their learned representations are reusable for new calcium trace datasets. To tackle this gap, we present \textbf{CAPT}, a \textbf{C}ontinuous \textbf{A}utoregressive \textbf{P}opulation \textbf{T}ransformer for calcium population dynamics. CAPT models continuous calcium traces directly through a continuous patch tokenization strategy and is trained autoregressively, enabling end-to-end pretraining and adaptation to diverse downstream tasks. We first pretrain CAPT on a large-scale mouse calcium imaging dataset and evaluate its transferability across independent mouse, larval zebrafish, and \textit{C. elegans} datasets collected by different laboratories. In these transfer settings, the pretrained backbone is frozen and only adaptation modules are updated. Across neural population forecasting and behavior decoding tasks, CAPT consistently outperforms specialized and general-purpose baselines. Alongside predictive performance, multimodal analyses using NeuroPAL annotations in \textit{C. elegans} datasets show that CAPT embeddings form a shared functional space across datasets and capture anatomical cell-identity-related structure. These results suggest that the continuous autoregressive modeling opens up possibilities for a simple route towards general-purpose neural foundation models for calcium imaging, which can generalize across datasets, experimental paradigms, and species.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CAPT（Continuous Autoregressive Population Transformer），一种面向钙成像神经群体动力学的连续自回归 Transformer 模型。该模型通过连续 patch 标记化策略直接在连续信号空间进行自回归预训练，仅在大规模小鼠数据集上预训练一次后冻结骨干网络，仅更新神经元/会话嵌入或任务解码头，即可在小鼠、斑马鱼和秀丽隐杆线虫三类物种的 8 个独立数据集上实现跨数据集、跨物种的迁移，并在神经群体预测和行为解码任务上一致优于 POCO、POYO+ 和 CalM 等专用与通用基线。同时，CAPT 学习到的嵌入空间在 C. elegans 数据集上能够捕捉与 NeuroPAL 神经细胞身份标注相关的结构。
AI.motivation: 大规模钙成像数据的快速积累呼唤"基础模型"式的神经动力学建模方法，但核心问题仍未解决：在一个数据集上预训练的模型能否泛化到新的数据集、实验范式乃至物种？现有方法（如 POCO、POYO+、CalM）多为任务专用或基于单一数据集评估，其所学表征是否可复用尚不清楚。钙成像数据在不同物种、脑区、成像条件、采样率和神经元数量上存在显著分布差异，给跨数据集和跨物种迁移带来巨大挑战，使得构建真正通用的神经基础模型成为亟待突破的关键问题。
AI.method: CAPT 的核心方法包含三个关键设计：(1) **连续 patch 标记化**：将每个单神经元时间序列划分为长度为 L 的非重叠时序 patch，通过线性投影 W_in 映射到模型空间，并叠加神经元嵌入 e_n 和会话嵌入 g_s，从而直接在连续信号空间进行标记化，无需 VQ 离散化。(2) **基于 Dual-axis Transformer (DAT) 的连续自回归预训练**：采用因果时间注意力建模单神经元历史，并采用神经元轴注意力建模群体交互，以 MSE 损失在教师强制下并行预测下一连续 patch；同时引入伪计划采样（pseudo scheduled sampling）和时间邻域替换（temporal neighborhood replacement）两种轻量扰动以缓解暴露偏差。(3) **参数高效迁移协议**：在大规模小鼠数据集预训练后冻结全部骨干网络，迁移到新数据集时仅扩展并优化目标数据集的神经元/会话嵌入（用于预测任务），或仅训练低秩门控行为解码头（用于行为解码），从而严格测试冻结骨干的可复用性。
AI.result: 实验在 9 个数据集上系统验证 CAPT：(1) **预训练数据集（Tseng 小鼠）**：在 held-in 和 held-out session 上预测和行为解码均优于 POCO、POYO+ 和 CalM。(2) **跨实验室小鼠迁移**（Sun、CaLiAli、Park 数据集）：CAPT 在三个数据集上一致优于可适用基线，验证了跨数据集泛化能力。(3) **跨物种迁移**（斑马鱼 Lavian、Brysch、Palieri 及 C. elegans Atanas、Copper 数据集）：即便存在物种、规模、采样率和实验范式的显著差异，CAPT 仍稳定优于基线；尤其在 C. elegans 行为解码上，POYO+ 和 CalM 出现严重退化（表 11 显示这并非超参数问题，域内预训练 POYO+ 性能显著更佳）。(4) **生物学可解释嵌入分析**：在 C. elegans 上利用 NeuroPAL 细胞身份标注，UMAP 可视化显示 CAPT 嵌入按细胞身份形成聚类结构，线性 SVM 分类任务上 CAPT 显著优于 POCO；跨数据集细胞身份分类（在一个 C. elegans 数据集训练 SVM，在另一个数据集测试）中 CAPT 仍保持高性能，而 POCO 接近随机水平，表明 CAPT 学到了跨数据集共享的功能嵌入空间。(5) **消融实验**：patch 长度从 2 增至 8 显著提升性能（L=8 最佳），计划采样和邻域替换策略均对性能有正向贡献。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明连续自回归建模为钙成像神经基础模型提供了一条简洁而有效的路径：单一冻结预训练骨干可通过轻量适配模块迁移到不同物种、实验室和实验范式的数据集，并在预测性能之外提供与生物细胞身份对齐的功能嵌入空间，有望成为连接功能钙活动与回路连接组、分子细胞类型的"功能坐标系"。局限性包括：(1) 预训练仍基于单一小鼠数据集，未来应扩展到多实验室、多物种的异构数据进行预训练；(2) 迁移性能相对预训练域仍有差距，提示当前骨干受源域分布约束；(3) 在无清晰试次结构的自发活动记录上表现较弱，需引入更精细的多模态设计；(4) 跨物种迁移机制尚不完全清楚，需进一步分析注意力结构、嵌入几何与生物模态之间的关系。总体而言，CAPT 为构建真正通用的神经群体动力学基础模型提供了有意义的实证基础和方法框架。

title: SeekJudge: A Practical Reward Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Computer-Use Agents
summary: Deciding whether a trajectory actually fulfills its instruction governs how we measure computer-use agents on long-horizon graphical-user-interface tasks and how we train them with reinforcement learning. This judgment has long relied on rule-based evaluation, which struggles to align with human intention and goes stale when an app updates or its online content drifts. Existing model-based judges attempt to address these problems but still leave a performance gap to the rule-based evaluation. We propose the \textbf{SeekJudge} framework, in which four role-specialized agents, a Condense, a Ground, a Seek and an Analyze agent, reach a verdict through a Seek--Analyze loop over the trajectory. A seed-calibrated distillation pipeline trains one specialized $9$B model to serve as the shared backbone for all four agents. Measured by downstream success rate on held-out RL test goals, SeekJudge is the first practical model-based reward to match or surpass native rule-based supervision in online RL. Beyond accuracy, SeekJudge provides step-level judgments, runs far cheaper than a closed-source large model, and keeps a small per-call context that scales to much longer trajectories. We further contribute a general architectural improvement to the reward server that speeds up judging in RL. Together these make model-based reward a practical drop-in for rule-based supervision in CUA reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: SeekJudge 提出了一种用于计算机使用代理(CUA)的实用模型化奖励框架，通过四个角色专精的智能体(Condense、Ground、Seek、Analyze)实现长轨迹评判。该框架将评判任务解耦为定位(找出关键证据图像)和提取(从图像中精确读取关键细节)两个子任务，是首个在在线强化学习测试成功率上匹配或超越原生基于规则监督的模型化奖励方案。
AI.motivation: 评判计算机使用代理的长轨迹执行结果面临两大核心问题：(1) 传统基于规则的评估存在三大缺陷——难以对齐人类意图、应用程序更新后规则易失效、在线内容漂移导致答案过时；(2) 现有模型化评判框架(CUAJudge、OS-Themis等)在单次前向传播中输入多张图像时，会"稀释"关键证据，导致幻觉或过度信任轨迹；且从未在在线强化学习中与基于规则的监督进行过正面比较。作者由此将轨迹评判重新定义为定位与提取两个子任务的组合，并提出同时兼顾质量、成本与延迟的实用奖励模型需求。
AI.method: SeekJudge 框架包含四个共享同一9B骨干网络的角色专精智能体：(1) Condense 智能体读取每步前后两张截图，将整条轨迹压缩为紧凑的文本时间线(T条目)；(2) Ground 智能体识别动作坐标实际命中的界面元素(A条目)；(3) Seek 智能体作为控制器，运行 Seek-Analyze 循环——基于累积证据判定是否结束，否则命名特定步骤与图像 ID 向 Analyze 提问；(4) Analyze 智能体以无状态方式单图回答关键问题。此外，作者采用种子标定蒸馏(seed-calibrated distillation)流程训练专精9B模型，并提出 Rollout-overlapped、Zero-client-state 的奖励服务器架构——将不依赖后续动作的计算(Condense/Ground)调度到 rollout 空闲的 GPU 时间窗口内执行，降低延迟。
AI.result: (1) 在三种任务域(Chrome、Impress、OS)的在线 RL 中，SeekJudge 是首个测试成功率匹配或超越基于规则监督的模型化奖励(UI-TARS 1.5 7B 上 Impress 测试成功率 36.81% vs Rule 30.43%；OS 测试成功率 28.89% vs Rule 25.56%)；(2) 在 CUAStepBench、AgentRewardBench、OmniGUIRewardBench 三个离线基准上，SeekJudge-9B 以单一9B开源模型超越使用 GPT-5-mini 与 o4-mini 的闭源方案(CUAJudge、WebJudge)；(3) 单次调用上下文比 OSThemis、CUAJudge 小 4-6 倍(约 12K vs 48K/80K tokens)，单轨迹评判成本远低于闭源大模型；(4) 提供步级九分类细粒度信号，连续分数+步级分数的组合奖励粒度使测试成功率最优；(5) 构建 CUAStepBench——首个同时含有人类轨迹级判定与同轨迹执行后步级密集标注的 CUA 奖励基准，覆盖 177 个应用与 iOS 平台。
AI.conclusion: SeekJudge 通过将长轨迹评判解耦为定位与提取两个子任务，证明了多图像单次前向传播会"稀释"关键证据。作者以单一9B开源骨干网络实现了首个在在线强化学习中匹配或超越基于规则监督的模型化奖励，使模型化奖励成为计算机使用代理强化学习中规则监督的实用替代方案。配合 CUAStepBench 与 Rollout-overlapped 奖励服务器，模型化奖励能够扩展至规则难以覆盖的环境，为 CUA 的强化学习训练提供更通用、可扩展的奖励信号。

title: TopoFE: topology-aware LLM-guided Automated Feature Engineering
summary: Automatic feature engineering (AutoFE) for tabular learning can be naturally formulated as a program synthesis problem, where the objective is to discover predictive feature transformations from an exponentially large search space. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have expanded the expressiveness of AutoFE by enabling feature program generation beyond predefined operator libraries. However, existing LLM-based approaches remain fundamentally limited by stateless generation and homogeneous search: feature proposals are produced from static prompts without accumulating search experience, while single-population exploration quickly converges to dominant transformation patterns and rarely discovers complementary feature compositions across transformation families. We propose TOPOFE, a topology-aware multi-island evolutionary framework for LLM-guided feature engineering. TOPOFE combines family-specialized exploration, adaptive prompt memory, and topology-guided knowledge transfer to efficiently discover diverse and compositional feature programs. Experiments on 29 public tabular datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art AutoFE methods across classification and regression tasks. Beyond predictive performance, TOPOFE discovers more diverse and transferable feature programs that generalize across multiple downstream predictors and LLM backbones.

AI.tldr: TopoFE提出了一种拓扑感知的LLM引导自动特征工程框架，通过多岛屿进化搜索解决现有方法中无状态生成和同质化搜索的局限性。它将特征程序空间按变换家族分解，由专门的岛屿并行探索，并通过饱和度触发的LLM介导混合合成实现跨家族组合。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM引导的AutoFE方法存在三大根本局限：(1) 同质化搜索动力学——单种群进化会过早收敛到单一变换家族的主导模式；(2) 无状态LLM查询——特征生成缺乏对历史探索的累积记忆；(3) 刚性迁移结构——现有方法使用周期性或随机迁移，无法识别何时迁移以及哪个源家族对停滞岛屿最互补。这导致跨家族组合特征（通常最具表达力）结构上不可达。
AI.method: TopoFE基于三个核心原则：(1) 归纳偏置分解——将程序空间划分为5个语义一致的变换家族（算术交互、统计聚合、时间特征、关系编码、非线性单变量映射），每个家族由专门的岛屿独立进化；(2) 自适应拓扑学习——维护一个有向加权拓扑图，边权重通过bandit式EMA规则从观察到的跨家族迁移增益在线更新；(3) 语义迁移通过LLM合成——通过LLM介导的混合合成实现跨岛屿知识转移，而非直接复制程序。三个组件协同工作：岛内进化（LLM驱动的变异和交叉）、提示自适应记忆（PAM，每岛屿维护接受/拒绝历史并生成自然语言偏好的避免信号）、以及拓扑感知跨岛屿迁移（饱和度检测触发、前驱选择和混合合成）。
AI.result: 在29个公开表格数据集（19个分类+10个回归）上，TopoFE在分类任务中15/19获得最佳准确率，回归任务中9/10获得最低RMSE。三个专为评估目的设计的指标显示：MPOC（平均成对输出相关性）最低、EffRank（有效秩）最高，TGSS（拓扑图特化分数）随搜索单调增长，证明拓扑图习得了任务特定的跨家族迁移知识。特征程序可在XGBoost/CatBoost/MLP/TabPFN四种不同架构的下游预测器间有效迁移，并在Qwen2.5-Coder-7B、Qwen3-8B、GPT-4o-mini三种LLM骨干上保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: TopoFE证实了跨家族互补性是可学习且可利用的量，现有AutoFE方法完全未利用这一点。家族专门化岛屿通过构造保持变换多样性；习得的有向拓扑图将跨家族迁移路由到经验上高产的岛屿对；饱和度触发的LLM介导混合合成仅在局部搜索耗尽时实现组合式程序生成。这为自动家族模式归纳、任务类型特定的迁移调度以及多模态表格设置的扩展开辟了新方向。

title: RareLens: Towards End-to-End Rare Disease Care via Aligning Divergent Large Language Model Reasoning
summary: Rare diseases collectively affect an estimated 3.5% to 5.9% of the population, yet more than 70% of patients are misdiagnosed and many endure years of evaluation before a diagnosis is reached, because early presentations are nonspecific and relevant expertise is scarce and unevenly distributed. Artificial intelligence could provide support, but existing systems address isolated stages of care, overwhelmingly diagnosis. They typically depend on the results of downstream investigations, and they treat the variability between models as noise to be eliminated. Here we present RareLens, a system that supports clinical decision-making across the entire rare disease trajectory by exploiting this variability. When heterogeneous large language models evaluate the same case, they generate divergent but complementary reasoning, which RareLens aligns and calibrates into a single convergent, actionable decision at each stage. Four coordinated modules perform primary-visit risk screening, diagnosis, treatment planning and prognosis. Developed and evaluated on RareBench, a real-world dataset of 157,525 cases spanning all 33 Orphanet categories and more than 7,000 conditions, RareLens outperformed every frontier model tested, including GPT-5, DeepSeek-R1, Claude-3.7-Sonnet and Gemini-2.5-Pro, at each stage. It achieved an area under the curve of 0.917 for screening and top-1 accuracies of 65.5% and 89.8% for diagnosis and treatment. In an external study spanning 1,287 cases and 23 physicians, autonomous RareLens and physicians assisted by RareLens both substantially outperformed unaided physicians. These findings indicate that aligning divergent model reasoning, rather than scaling a single model, offers a generalizable strategy for high-uncertainty clinical decision-making.

AI.tldr: RareLens是一个针对罕见病全病程临床决策支持的AI系统，通过对齐和校准多个异构大语言模型（LLM）的差异化推理，在筛查、诊断、治疗规划和预后四个阶段提供统一可执行的决策建议。该系统在RareBench数据集（157,525个病例）上全面超越GPT-5、DeepSeek-R1、Claude-3.7-Sonnet和Gemini-2.5-Pro等前沿模型，并在涉及1,287个病例和23位医生的外部研究中验证了其优于未辅助医生的临床价值。
AI.motivation: 罕见病影响3.5%–5.9%的人口，但超过70%的患者被误诊，需经历漫长评估周期。原因在于早期症状非特异、专业知识稀缺且分布不均。现有AI系统存在两大局限：仅覆盖孤立诊疗环节（多集中于诊断）、依赖下游检查结果，并将模型间差异视为需消除的"噪声"。论文认为这种模型差异实为可利用的互补信号。
AI.method: 核心方法：将多个异构LLM视为"虚拟临床委员会"，利用其推理差异而非消除之。RareLens由四个协调模块组成，覆盖罕见病全程：① 初诊风险筛查；② 诊断；③ 治疗规划；④ 预后判断。系统对齐并校准各模型的多样化、互补性推理，在每个阶段输出收敛且可执行的单一决策。基准数据集RareBench涵盖157,525个真实病例，覆盖全部33个Orphanet罕见病分类及7,000余种疾病。评估包括模型对比和外部临床研究（1,287个病例，23位医生）。
AI.result: 主要结果：① 筛查阶段AUC达0.917；② 诊断top-1准确率65.5%；③ 治疗规划top-1准确率89.8%。在每一阶段均超越GPT-5、DeepSeek-R1、Claude-3.7-Sonnet、Gemini-2.5-Pro等前沿模型。外部研究中，无论自主运行的RareLens还是辅助医生的RareLens，都显著优于无辅助医生。结果验证了"对齐差异化推理"策略相对于"扩大单一模型规模"在高不确定性临床决策中的优势。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明，与其扩大单一模型规模，不如对齐多个模型的差异化推理，这为高不确定性临床决策提供了一种可推广的通用策略。RareLens在罕见病全程管理中展现出卓越性能，提示多模型集成对齐范式在复杂临床场景中具有重要价值。

title: Ordered Network Analysis of Epistemic Emotions during Collaborative Problem Solving
summary: Investigating how affective states such as confusion and frustration persist and transition during co-situated collaborative problem solving (CPS) is important for understanding the dynamics of epistemic emotions. However, the accurate identification of affective states remain challenging as there is no gold-standard truth in this space. Here, we analyze affective states collected through retrospective cued-recall during an in-person CPS task. Using ordered network analysis (ONA), we examine (1) the overall ordered structure of affective states and how this structure differs across self-caught and probe-caught reporting methods, and (2) what aspects of this ordered structure are emphasized differently in slower and faster groups. We find that ONA reveals differences in persistence and transition patterns that are not apparent from descriptive summaries alone. In particular, we observe a stable epistemic core linking curiosity, optimism, and confusion, with different reporting methods emphasizing different connections among states. An analysis between faster and slower groups show that roles of confusion and disengagement also shift significantly during collaboration, particularly in their relationship to conflict. We interpret our findings in the context of collaboration and discuss their implications in developing AI systems that support CPS.

AI.tldr: 本文使用有序网络分析（ONA）研究协作问题解决（CPS）中认知情绪（如好奇、乐观、困惑）的持续性与转换模式，比较了自我报告与探针报告两种回溯性提示回忆方法，以及不同任务完成速度组别之间的差异。
AI.motivation: 协作问题解决中情感状态（如困惑、挫败）的持续与转换对理解认知情绪动态至关重要。然而，由于缺乏金标准，情感状态的准确识别仍是挑战。现有研究多依赖描述性统计，将情感状态视为独立变量，忽略了局部时间序列中情感状态的共现与顺序转换结构。此外，短时、同处一地的协作场景中密集测量方法有限，需要超越汇总统计的方法来探索小规模、时间粗粒度教育数据中的情感转换。
AI.method: 研究招募27名参与者组成9个三人小组，完成"Weights Task"协作问题解决任务，并进行视频记录。事后采用回溯性提示回忆（RCR）程序收集情感状态自报数据，包括自我主动报告（self-caught）和60秒无活动后探针触发报告（probe-caught）两种机制，涵盖7种情感标签（困惑、好奇、挫败、脱离、乐观、惊讶、冲突）。采用有序网络分析（ONA），使用移动窗口大小为2来构建有向网络，捕捉情感状态的有序连接，通过SVD降维可视化，并构建差分网络模型比较速度组（中位数划分）与报告机制的差异。
AI.result: 1）所有条件下均发现好奇心、乐观和困惑构成稳定的"认知核心"，自我转换连接最强，反映情感呈短程持续而非频繁切换。2）速度差异：快速组以好奇-乐观之间的连接为主，脱离状态频繁但短暂；慢速组在困惑-冲突、好奇-冲突之间表现出更强的双向转换，且困惑更倾向于转向冲突而非脱离。3）报告机制差异：探针报告在核心认知状态间呈现更强的自我循环（持续性），而自我报告分布更分散，涉及更多高唤醒状态（挫败、惊讶、冲突），反映学生在感受到情感变化时更倾向于主动报告。horizontal维度区分了"前进性"认知状态与"困难/挣扎"状态。
AI.conclusion: 本研究展示了ONA在分析小型、粗粒度协作学习数据中情感动力学的适用性，揭示了协作问题解决中情感组织比简单性能指标更为复杂。核心发现是协作速度反映的是情感与认知组织差异而非简单的表现质量，困惑与脱离在协作中扮演不同角色。对AI教育系统的启示是：应基于局部情感轨迹而非孤立信号进行干预，区分"生产性挣扎"（值得保持沉默）与"脱离性挣扎"（需要干预）。未来研究需扩大样本规模、纳入生理或行为信号三角验证，并探索ONA表征与学习成果的关系。

title: ESF-Bench: Benchmarking Challenging Slot-Filling Scenarios for Real-World Enterprise Applications
summary: The rapid rise of large language models (LLMs) has driven transformative adoption across enterprises. However, deploying these models in real-world settings presents unique challenges due to complex system constraints and unexpected user behaviors. Among these applications, slot filling is essential for converting unstructured input into structured, actionable data. In this work, we introduce ESF-Bench, a challenging Enterprise Slot Filling benchmark consisting of 810 multi-turn samples and 6530 slots over 8 unique domains. Curated using a taxonomy of the 57 most challenging slot-filling scenarios observed during real-world enterprise deployments, ESF-Bench exposes notable limitations in current state-of-the-art LLMs, with GPT-OSS-120b low successfully extracting slots for only 20.7% of benchmark samples. To support continued research in this area, we publicly release the benchmark dataset, taxonomy, and accompanying evaluation code on GitHub.

AI.tldr: ESF-Bench 是 ServiceNow 提出的企业级槽位填充（Slot Filling）基准测试，包含 810 个多轮对话样本、6530 个槽位，覆盖 8 个企业领域，基于 57 种真实生产环境中观察到的挑战性场景的人工标注分类法构建。该基准揭示了当前最先进 LLM 在企业槽位填充任务上的显著局限性，最佳模型 Gemini 2.5 Flash Dynamic-Thinking 的 F-JGA 仅 33.3%，远低于人类基线的 73.33%。
AI.motivation: 1. 现有槽位填充基准（如 MultiWOZ、SGD、ATIS、SNIPS 等）主要侧重抽取式槽位，无法反映真实企业部署中的复杂性，包括多源上下文依赖、抽象式归一化、意外用户行为等场景。2. 企业场景中常出现多源信息冲突、相对值引用、纠正/重置、条件依赖、个性化需求等复杂情况，现有基准缺乏对这些真实挑战的系统性评估。3. 真实部署中槽位填充往往需要结合用户画像、知识库、会话元数据、用户表单等多种上下文信息，要求模型具备多跳推理能力。4. 当前 LLM 在企业场景下的实际能力缺乏系统性评估，需要一个能反映生产环境复杂性的基准来指导模型改进。
AI.method: 1. 构建包含 57 种挑战性场景、12 个高层类别的人工标注分类法（Selection、Conditionals、Reasoning、Multi-Source、Long/Multi-Value、Conversation Understanding、Personalization、Schema Constraints、Unexpected User Behavior、Relative、Corrections、Slot Reset）。2. 使用基于 LLM 的合成数据生成流水线（GPT-5 生成数据、GPT-4.1 标注场景、GPT-5 作为评判模型验证标签），从分类法中随机采样场景生成多轮对话样本。3. 每个样本包含任务导向模式、用户-助手对话、知识库文章、用户画像、会话信息、用户表单等多源上下文。4. 引入 Final Joint Goal Accuracy（F-JGA）指标，评估最终完整对话状态而非逐轮准确率；并按分类法对每个槽位打标，支持细粒度分析。5. 评估 5 个模型家族（GPT-5.1、Gemini 2.5 Flash、GPT-OSS-120b、Qwen3-32b、Ministral3 14b）的高能力（推理增强）和低延迟两种配置。6. 在 122 个槽位的人工标注子集上建立人类基线进行对比。
AI.result: 1. 最佳模型 Gemini 2.5 Flash Dynamic-Thinking 在 F-JGA 上仅达到 33.3%，Tagged Slot Accuracy 80.9%；GPT-OSS-120b Low 仅为 20.7%。2. 人类基线达到 73.33% F-JGA 和 93.83% Tagged Slot Accuracy，最佳模型与人类之间存在 33.33 个百分点的 F-JGA 差距，表明该基准对当前 SOTA LLM 仍具有显著挑战性。3. 高能力模型平均比低延迟模型在 F-JGA 上高出 16.3%，在 Tagged Slot Accuracy 上高出 13.4%；最显著的提升出现在数学推理（+44.0%）、时序推理（+33.2%）和计数（+32.0%）等需要多步推理的场景。4. 推理（REA, 59.4%）和个性化（PER, 55.9%）是高能力模型表现最差的两个类别；对话理解（CU, 89.4%）表现最佳。5. 开源模型表现具有竞争力：GPT-OSS-120b High 在 Tagged Slot Accuracy 上接近最佳专有模型（-4.4%），并在长/多值和模式约束上领先；Qwen3-32b-Think 在多源、个性化、相对值槽位上领先所有模型。6. 高能力模型在对抗性场景下仍有失败，包括第三方实体引用未识别、讽刺/夸张语气被字面理解、双重否定混淆、用户画像不匹配场景下的错误填充。
AI.conclusion: ESF-Bench 揭示了当前 LLM 在企业级槽位填充任务上仍存在显著能力差距，特别是在多步推理、个性化、相对值引用和意外用户行为处理方面。推理增强的高能力模型虽然性能更优，但代价是 token 消耗大幅增加（高能力组中位数 5774 tokens vs 低延迟组 321 tokens），存在明显的性能-延迟权衡。开源模型在特定类别可与专有模型竞争，表明企业部署可根据具体场景灵活选型。该基准及配套分类法、评估代码的公开发布，为社区提供了系统推进企业级槽位填充能力的基础资源。局限性包括：错误的因果归因仍需人工审查、合成数据可能存在模型家族偏见、当前仅支持英语单模态。

title: Confidently Wrong: Exception Chain Collapse in Frontier LLM Rule Evaluation
comment: 43 pages, 9 figures. Working paper v3.13.0. Benchmark data, rule encodings and per-case result artefacts: this https URL
summary: We document a failure class in frontier large language models -- exception chain collapse -- observed in eligibility evaluation under nested conditional rules of the form "A is required UNLESS B applies, UNLESS C overrides B". The failure reproduces at first observation, but its empirical surface is unstable: between March and April 2026 several failure cells closed silently under the same model alias, with no version bump (GPT-5.4 on construction insurance moved from 96.6% to 100%, same prompt and harness). For regulated workflows, frontier-model accuracy is a moving compliance boundary that shifts without notice. We present the Aethis Eligibility Module, a neuro-symbolic architecture in which LLMs author rules from authoritative sources and an SMT-based layer executes them deterministically, consistent with the authored specification regardless of model drift, reasoning-effort defaults, or prompt format. Three evidence bases: (i) a controlled benchmark of 225 scenarios across four regulatory domains documents the pattern and, in replication, the drift that partially closed it; (ii) a 20-scenario adversarial extension on construction insurance, where the engine scores 20/20, as does one of four frontier configurations (GPT-5.4 at low reasoning effort), while the other three, including Anthropic's strongest model at evaluation time, fail the same coverage-gap edge case; (iii) external validation on nine peer-reviewed LegalBench tasks, 949 held-out cases, where the engine is significantly more accurate than all three frontier models (combined McNemar's p <= 0.003), with margins up to +41 points on the curated multi-prong tasks against the Anthropic models. The contribution is to relocate uncertainty from the inference boundary, where it is silent, to the specification boundary, where it is deliberate and audited. All scenarios, rule encodings, and results are public and reproducible.

AI.tldr: 本文系统记录了前沿大语言模型在"嵌套例外链"(exception chain collapse)任务上的失败模式——即处理"A is required UNLESS B applies, UNLESS C overrides B"这类多层级条件规则时出现的系统性错误，并提出了一种神经符号架构(Aethis Eligibility Module)以LLM负责规则编写、SMT求解器负责确定性执行来解决该问题。在225场景的四领域基准测试和949案例的LegalBench外部验证中，确定性引擎在多层级例外链任务上显著优于所有前沿LLM(McNemar's p ≤ 0.003)，在精选多支任务上对Anthropic模型的领先优势最高达+41个百分点。
AI.motivation: 前沿LLM正被部署到高风险决策场景(移民资格、保险理赔、福利认定等)。作者受Sergot等(1986)将《英国国籍法》形式化为Prolog逻辑程序的启发，重新审视在LLM时代形式化编码是否仍有必要。论文聚焦的核心问题是：对于具有"材料后果、可审计性、OR分支逻辑"三重属性的高风险决策，前沿模型的准确率是一个会无预警漂移的合规边界(GPT-5.4在建筑保险任务上3月到4月在同一模型别名、无版本变更下从96.6%漂移到100%)，这与监管要求存在结构性冲突。
AI.method: 1) 构建225场景的受控基准测试，覆盖四个领域：英国移民life_uk(56场景)、英语语言(43)、合成航天器认证法(68，含三级例外链)、合成建筑保险CAR(58，含五级例外链)；2) 测试8个LLM(Anthropic和OpenAI两大家族的前沿与生产级模型)在通用提示、温度0/0.3、N=3/10等条件下的表现；3) 识别两类失败模式——"豁免锚定"(exemption anchoring)和"例外链崩塌"(exception chain collapse)；4) 设计神经符号架构Aethis Eligibility Module：阶段1由LLM从权威源编写结构化规则(含溯源链)，阶段2将DSL解析并编译为SMT约束进行确定性执行；5) 进行稳健性分析测试增强提示、温度、多次采样的影响；6) 在9项LegalBench任务(949保留案例)上进行外部验证，并采用6项预注册随机采样任务控制选择偏差；7) 在v3.8中加入20场景的对抗性扩展测试深度组合下的失败。
AI.result: 主要结果：1) 在简单多路由逻辑(英语语言任务)上所有前沿模型达100%；2) 在三级例外链(航天器任务)上失败显著：Claude Opus 4.6三月89.7%→四月98.5%(三月70次试验中0/70正确，单次成功率95%上界4.19%)、GPT-5-mini 75%；3) Aethis Eligibility Module在全部225场景上与形式化基准100%一致，评估延迟<1ms，编译后边际成本近零；4) 增强提示将假阴性从7降至4，但引入20个假阳性，净准确率从90%降至65%；5) GPT-5.4在建筑保险任务上96.6%→100%的无声漂移构成"移动合规边界"问题的具体证据；6) LegalBench验证：引擎在949案例上显著优于三个前沿模型(综合McNemar's p ≤ 0.003)，精选多支任务对Anthropic模型领先最高+41pp；7) v3.8对抗性扩展：引擎20/20，GPT-5.4低推理20/20，Sonnet 4.6 19/20，GPT-5.4默认19/20，Opus 4.7 18/20；8) 跨提取器验证(Opus 4.7作为运行时提取器)证实结构性优势非提取器特异性。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心架构贡献是将不确定性从推理边界(无声且连续)重新定位到规范边界(显式且可审计)：Level 3执行层由SMT确定性求解保证正确性，Level 1检索与Level 2规则形式化通过专家测试套件和版本化规则束(bundle)进行管理。论文不声称LLM普遍不可靠，而是界定了特定的边界条件——"嵌套例外下的多支组合式规则评估"——在该条件下确定性执行是必要前提。对于受监管工作流而言，这一分离使得认证对象从会漂移的模型快照变为固定的规则束制品。然而Level 2规则形式化质量仍依赖SME测试套件的完备性，且静默模型漂移能否通过巧合通过测试套件仍是待解决的开放问题。所有基准场景、规则编码和结果均已开源可复现。

title: Key-Interval A*: Accelerating Grid Pathfinding via Structural Abstraction
summary: Existing exact methods for 4-connected grid pathfinding reduce online search, but often either retain fine-grained search states or require substantial preprocessing. This paper presents Key-Interval A* (KIA*), an optimal pathfinding algorithm that uses lightweight preprocessing to construct and search over a compact interval-level abstraction of free space. KIA* represents free space using intervals: maximal contiguous runs of traversable cells. It extracts key intervals that capture structural boundary changes and connects them through contiguous non-key regions. KIA* then performs A*-style search on the resulting key-interval graph and constructively reconstructs grid paths from interval chains, without cell-level local search. We prove the completeness and optimality of KIA* on 4-connected grids. Experiments on standard benchmarks show that KIA* preserves exact shortest-path lengths and achieves the fastest runtime on seven of eight benchmark groups, with the largest gains on structured and game maps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Key-Interval A* (KIA*)，一种基于结构化区间抽象的最优 4 联通栅格寻路算法。该算法通过轻量级预处理提取关键区间，构建关键区间图，并在其上进行 A* 风格搜索，无需单元级局部搜索即可构造性地重建栅格路径。
AI.motivation: 经典 A* 算法以单元为基本搜索状态，在大规模或结构化环境中忽略了自由空间的连续性，导致大量结构性等价的状态被探索，计算开销大。现有加速方法（JPS、矩形分解、子目标图、HPA*、CPD、Block A* 等）要么仍基于单元级剪枝，要么依赖大量离线预处理与内存开销，无法兼顾最优性、轻量级预处理与紧凑搜索表示。
AI.method: 1) **预处理阶段**：将自由空间表示为"区间"（沿行/列最大连续可通行单元），通过纵向与横向扫描计算边界趋势（UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT），识别捕捉结构变化的关键点，并将包含关键点的垂直区间标记为**关键区间**；2) **关键区间图**：非关键区间构成无分支链，构造由关键区间通过水平单调区间链相连的有向多重图；3) **搜索算法**：在关键区间图上执行 A* 风格搜索，引入路径点（waypoint）序列与关键点/过渡顶点更新规则，以及基于"投影顶点"的支配性剪枝，采用 Manhattan 距离作为可采纳启发；4) **路径重建**：利用 Lemma 1 中的"交叉行"构造法，无需单元级搜索即可在线性时间内重构精确最短路径；5) 证明算法的完整性与最优性。
AI.result: 在 MovingAI 2D 标准基准上的实验表明：KIA* 在 8 组基准中的 7 组（非 Random 类）上取得最快在线运行时间，相对最快基线的加速比在 1.8×（Maze）至 4.7×（BG512）之间，最大提升出现在结构化与游戏地图（含房间、走廊与大块规则区域）。KIA*、JPS4、RSR 在所有场景下均匹配 A* 的精确最短路径长度，而 HPA* 存在轻微路径长度膨胀（HPA*/A* 比值 1.010–1.053）。在 Random 地图上，HPA* 在所有密度下最快；KIA* 在障碍密度 ≥25% 时开始优于 A* 与 RSR，≥35% 时亦优于 JPS4，但仍逊于 HPA*。预处理开销方面，在 Street、BG512、BGMaps、Dragon Age、StarCraft 上，KIA* 仅需 0.12–2.35 MB 内存；而 Random 地图预处理成本较高（10%–25% 密度下内存达 20–33 MB）。
AI.conclusion: KIA* 是一种结合轻量预处理、关键区间图 A* 搜索与无单元局部搜索的构造性路径重建的最优栅格寻路算法，能保持 4 联通最短路径的精确最优性，并在结构化与游戏地图上实现显著的在线加速。未来工作方向包括：提升在高度碎片化随机地图上的效率、扩展至 8 联通与任意角寻路、以及利用预处理结构支持动态环境下的局部修复与部分重规划。

title: Inference-Time Consensus for Mitigating Hidden Behaviors from LLM Fine-Tuning
comment: 21 pages, 4 figures. Code: this https URL
summary: Recent work shows that fine-tuning language models on even a small amount of poisoned data can install targeted misbehavior, and ostensibly benign data can transmit hidden preferences that generalize broadly. Standard defenses, such as data filtering, mixing in harmless data, and regularization, attenuate these effects but do not eliminate them. We instead pursue robustness through redundancy: collecting multiple datasets from different sources and only learning what is common between them. Thus, if only a subset of sources are malicious, the misbehavior will be blocked. In order to implement this defense strategy, we fine-tune a separate reference model on each source's dataset and aggregate their next-token distributions at decoding time. We introduce two consensus decoders: a token-wise minimum, which caps each token at the lowest probability any source assigns, and a base-relative variant, which reverts to the base probability on any token the sources move in opposing directions. We further relax exact agreement to tolerate partial support across sources and different surface expressions of the same intention. Across controlled poisoning tasks, subliminal learning, and emergent misalignment, consensus decoding suppresses source-specific misbehavior while preserving shared desirable behavior, including cases where union training and weight averaging retain the unwanted behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种推理时共识解码（inference-time consensus decoding）防御策略，通过对来自不同数据源的多个参考模型进行下一词元分布聚合，从而在保留跨源共享的有益行为的同时，抑制由单源投毒引入的隐藏有害行为。
AI.motivation: 现有针对大语言模型微调数据投毒的防御手段（如数据过滤、混入良性数据、正则化等）只能削弱而不能消除由投毒或潜意识学习（subliminal learning）植入的隐藏恶意行为。本文作者指出，KL 正则化本质上是对参考模型分布的几何或算术池化（Lemma 1），无法对单一投毒源的行为形成结构性否决。因此需要一种不依赖具体投毒标签、仅凭"源身份"信息就能在解码阶段将共享行为与源特定有害行为分离的防御方法。
AI.method: 方法核心是为每个数据源独立微调一个参考模型 π_i，并在解码时聚合其下一词元分布：（1）**最小聚合（π_min）**：取所有参考模型中每个 token 的最小概率后归一化，构成 token 级的"否决"；（2）**基相对最小聚合（π_Δ）**：以共享基模型 π_0 为参考，当源对某 token 的变化方向不一致时回退到基概率，仅保留同向变化中的最弱幅度。此外，作者进一步放宽严格一致性约束：（3）**法定人数聚合（quorum）**：用第 q 大的概率替代最小值，允许部分源不共享有益行为；（4）**语义平滑（semantic smoothing）**：通过 BGE 嵌入比较短 rollout 的语义相似度，使不同表面表达（如 "Joke:" 与 "Humor:"）可以相互支持。
AI.result: 在三类场景的实验中——显式前缀投毒（Setting 1）、潜意识学习（Setting 2）以及涌现失准（Setting 3）——共识解码方法在保留共享行为（如终端笑话标记）的同时，显著降低了源特定有害行为（如专属前缀、隐藏动物偏好、错误医疗建议）。相比之下，联合训练（π_union）和 LoRA 权重平均（π_merge）虽然保留共享行为，但仍会泄漏有害行为；Kalai 等人的全输出共识采样则通过频繁弃权来保证安全。补充实验验证了 m=8 时 π_min 仍未崩溃（117/128 保留笑话、0/128 泄漏成本），表面形式分歧场景中语义平滑的最小聚合在 128 个样本中恢复了 109 个共享标记且仅产生 1 个源特定前缀。
AI.conclusion: 论文得出结论：当有益行为在多源间重复而有害行为保持源特定时，共聚可以在解码时将二者分离。最小聚合通常保留更多共享行为，基相对最小聚合则更强地抑制源间不一致的改变；法定人数与语义平滑扩展了同一思想以应对不完全一致或不同表面表达的情形。作者也坦率地讨论了若干局限：每次生成需对每个参考模型各做一次前向传播、推理成本较高；语义平滑依赖外部嵌入空间；当有害行为被足够多的源共同支持时则无法区分；基相对最小聚合无法去除基模型自身已有的不良行为；以及防御者知晓的源可能利用否决机制反向抑制有益行为。

title: NeurGO: Learning to Generate Elite Candidates for Meta-Black-Box Expensive Optimization
summary: Expensive black-box optimization is ubiquitous in science and engineering, where function evaluations are costly and the evaluation budget is limited. Traditional evolutionary algorithms and Meta-BlackBox Optimization (MetaBBO) approaches typically consume most evaluations on candidate selection, often wasting precious budget on inferior solutions. Although surrogate-assisted evolution and Bayesian optimization aim to reduce evaluations through surrogate models, constructing an accurate global model from limited data remains challenging, and model bias can easily trap the search in local optima. To overcome these limitations, we propose NeurGO, a generative MetaBBO framework that directly synthesizes elite candidates from historical population states. Specifically, we employ an attention-based encoder to capture the population-level search trend and condition a decoder on this representation to generate high-quality candidates, avoiding the expensive evaluation of large offspring pools. We then design a quality-diversity loss to maintain solution quality and population diversity throughout the search. Through extensive benchmarking on CEC 2008 and the COCO BBOB test suites, our method achieves better optimization performance under the same evaluation budget and exhibits faster convergence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 NeurGO，一种用于昂贵黑盒优化的生成式 Meta-Black-Box Optimization (MetaBBO) 框架。该方法通过注意力编码器直接从种群状态生成少量高质量候选解，避免了传统进化算法和代理模型方法在低预算下大量评估劣质候选或因代理模型偏差陷入局部最优的问题。
AI.motivation: 昂贵黑盒优化（如超参数调优、工程设计）中函数评估代价高昂且预算严格受限。传统进化算法和 MetaBBO 将大部分预算耗费在生成和评估大量子代上，造成浪费；代理辅助进化算法（SAEA）和贝叶斯优化（BO）依赖代理模型，但在有限数据下难以构建准确的全局模型，模型偏差容易导致搜索陷入局部最优。因此需要一种能够跨任务学习可迁移搜索先验、直接生成高价值候选的替代方案。
AI.method: NeurGO 采用端到端的 Transformer 生成架构，包含两个核心模块：(1) Population Context Encoder (PCE)：先按适应度排序作为隐式位置编码，利用基于适应度的注意力（移除标准 Q/K/V 投影）和可训练的秩注意力矩阵，融合 FFN 非线性扰动，通过残差融合生成精细化的种群表征 X^ref；(2) Elite Synthesis Decoder (ESD)：拼接原始种群、归一化适应度和 PCE 特征，经 MLP 生成贡献分数，对种群维度 softmax 得到贡献权重矩阵 P_t，通过加权聚合 X^ref 直接合成 k 个精英候选。训练采用 Quality-Diversity (QD) 损失，包含最优值提升质量项（z-score 归一化）和负成对欧氏距离多样性项，λ 线性衰减以平衡探索与收敛。
AI.result: 在 CEC 2008（F1–F6）和 COCO BBOB（f1–f24）共 30 个函数、维度 D=10、最大评估预算 MaxFE=300 的低预算设置下，与四类基线（EAs: DE/GA/SHADE/CMA-ES；SAEAs: EGO/SACOSO；BO: TurBO/HEBO；MetaBBO: LGA/LES/B2Opt）各独立运行 10 次对比。NeurGO 在 BBOB 上对所有基线胜多负少（最佳 w/l 为 22:2 vs CMA-ES），平均排名 2.0 显著优于第二名 HEBO (2.4)；CEC 上对全部基线 6:0 全胜。收敛曲线显示 NeurGO 在约 100 次评估处出现明显下降并持续改进。消融实验验证 PCE 的种群上下文表征和 ESD 的学习聚合权重均不可或缺；超参敏感性分析表明 lr=0.001 与 k=3 提供最优性能。
AI.conclusion: NeurGO 提出了一种生成式 MetaBBO 范式，直接从种群历史状态合成精英候选，避免了在线代理模型反复拟合和采集函数优化，在低预算昂贵黑盒优化下实现了更高效的预算利用。大量实验证明其在 CEC 和 BBOB 基准上对四类基线均具有优越的性能、更快的收敛和更强的跨任务泛化能力。未来计划拓展到更广泛的任务分布和训练套件，并探索更具挑战性的昂贵优化场景。

title: Separating Capability from Permission: A Governance Framework for Agentic AI Autonomy Levels
summary: As AI systems increasingly exhibit agentic behavior, discussions of autonomy often conflate what systems are technically capable of doing with what they should be permitted to do in practice. This paper introduces a governance framework that explicitly separates Allowed Autonomy Levels (AAL), which define the degree of autonomy an AI agent is authorized to exercise given risk, oversight, and accountability considerations, from Autonomous Capability Levels (ACL), which characterize an agent's inherent technical abilities. We present a structured set of autonomy levels spanning reactive execution, decision support, supervised action, goal-directed autonomy, and delegated operational authority, and describe how control, reversibility, and accountability change as autonomy increases.
