AI.motivation: 长视野具身任务存在延迟信用分配问题：任务成功需在许多依赖动作完成后才可观测。现有LLM驱动的代码即策略进化方法主要在独立生成的变体间进行选择，缺乏顺序局部改进阶段，也未保留已失败修订的记忆。模因算法（memetic algorithms）虽结合了进化变异与局部搜索，但尚未被应用于通过环境回放评估的可执行策略程序。
AI.method: 1) 评估器进化阶段：使用LLM生成候选评估器池，通过LLM多数投票选择最优评估器，并经多代宏变异迭代优化，最终固定为E*，输出标量适应度F(p)和结构化反馈指标M(p)。2) 策略进化阶段：在固定E*下，从单一精英候选状态出发，每代执行三个分支——带拒绝提案记忆ℋ的序列爬山（hill-climbing），从精英出发的宏变异，以及爬山与宏变异最优候选之间的交叉。三分支输出中适应度最高的成为下一代精英。3) 关键机制：拒绝提案记忆记录失败修订的编辑摘要，使后续提案避免重复错误；评估器反馈指标条件化后续代码提案生成。
AI.result: 在Robosuite汉诺塔上：MEMENTO达到0.99±0.02适应度和0.97±0.06成功率，REvolve为0.72±0.08/0.53±0.12，Eureka无成功回放。在AI2-THOR上：MEMENTO达到0.98±0.00/1.00±0.00，REvolve为0.67±0.05/0.40±0.10，Eureka无成功。泛化测试中，MEMENTO在非对称和圆柱体汉诺塔变体上分别保持0.87和0.63成功率，在未见AI2-THOR厨房上保持0.78成功率。消融实验表明零样本生成、未进化评估器和移除搜索分支均使性能显著下降。物理Franka机器人部署10次试验中达到0.90成功率。
AI.conclusion: MEMENTO证实了记忆引导的模因式搜索是改进基于稀疏回放反馈的可执行具身策略的有效机制。评估器进化将长视野成功条件编码为细粒度反馈信号，使代码即策略的连续局部改进与进化变异得以协同工作。值得注意的是，评估器与适应度之间存在强相关性（Pearson r达0.92），表明进化评估器提供了与任务成功对齐的选择信号。物理部署验证了sim-to-real迁移的可行性，为LLM驱动的可执行策略进化在实际机器人系统中的应用提供了前景。

title: Same Predictions, Different Reasons: The Effect of Quantization on Model Explanations
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) has become a practical solution for deploying deep learning models on resource-constrained edge devices by compressing high-precision floating-point weights into low-precision representations without requiring retraining. Past research has demonstrated that quantization largely preserves classification accuracy; however, whether it also preserves the model's internal reasoning remains an open question. This study presents a systematic evaluation on how static PTQ affects the interpretability / explainability of five widely used CNN architectures: VGG19, ResNet18, EfficientNet-B0, DenseNet161, and MobileNetV2 at INT8 and INT4 precision. We employ a dual interpretability framework that combines Grad-CAM for spatial attention analysis with LIME for input-level feature attribution, and systematically compare full-precision and quantized models on two binary classification datasets. Interpretability is evaluated using three complementary metrics: the Pearson correlation coefficient, structural similarity index, and top-20% IoU to capture distributional and structural variations in model explanations, supplemented by deletion/insertion faithfulness analysis. The results show that classification accuracy is not a reliable indicator of interpretability stability under reduced precision. DenseNet161 maintains strong feature consistency across both precision levels, whereas EfficientNet-B0, despite achieving competitive spatial attention and classification accuracy at INT8 precision, exhibits a substantial degradation in input-level feature attribution. These findings have direct implications for the trustworthy deployment of quantized models in applications with high interpretability requirements, demonstrating that architecture selection is as important as the quantization strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了训练后量化(PTQ)对五种CNN架构(VGG19、ResNet18、EfficientNet-B0、DenseNet161、MobileNetV2)在INT8和INT4精度下可解释性的影响。研究采用Grad-CAM与LIME双解释框架，结合PCC、SSIM、Top-20% IoU和删插保真度等指标，发现分类准确率并非可解释性稳定性的可靠指标，不同架构对量化的敏感度差异显著。
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明PTQ基本能保持分类准确率，但其是否同时保持模型的内部推理过程（即特征归因与决策依据的一致性）仍属空白。在医疗、自动驾驶、监管等高可解释性需求场景中，仅凭准确率判断模型可靠性存在风险。因此亟需量化PTQ对模型解释稳定性的影响，并评估不同架构的鲁棒性差异。
AI.method: 1) 选取5种代表性CNN架构（VGG19、ResNet18、EfficientNet-B0、DenseNet161、MobileNetV2）并微调；2) 采用GPFQ方法进行仅权重量化，生成INT8与INT4版本；3) 在Food-101子集（pizza/steak）与Poribohon-BD（bike/bicycle）两个二分类数据集上测试；4) 双重解释框架：Grad-CAM用于空间注意力分析，LIME用于输入级特征归因；5) 评估指标：Pearson相关系数(PCC)、结构相似性指数(SSIM)、Top-20% IoU衡量分布与结构变化，辅以删插保真度分析；6) 采用配对t检验/Wilcoxon符号秩检验与Cohen's d效应量对INT8 vs INT4进行统计验证。
AI.result: 1) 分类准确率无法预测可解释性稳定性；2) DenseNet161在不同精度下保持最强的特征一致性（PCC>0.96，IoU≈0.88），其密集连接模式对量化噪声鲁棒；3) EfficientNet-B0最脆弱，尽管Grad-CAM尚可（PCC≈0.67@INT8），但LIME归因严重退化（PCC=0.228@INT8, 0.109@INT4），复合缩放策略对精度损失极敏感；4) VGG19次稳定，ResNet18在INT8表现良好但INT4退化明显；5) MobileNetV2空间注意力尚可但输入级归因弱；6) INT8统计显著优于INT4（p<0.001），但不同架构效应量差异大（ResNet18 LIME PCC的Cohen's d=3.12，DenseNet161仅0.45）；7) 删插保真度分析显示量化未改变模型真正依赖的特征区域；8) 量化导致误分类时，模型关注区域也发生实质性偏移。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了准确率保持与可解释性保持之间的鸿沟常被低估。DenseNet161是高可解释性部署的最优选择，而EfficientNet-B0应避免在高可解释性场景中使用。架构选择与量化策略同等重要。该研究为资源受限环境中可信部署量化模型提供了实用指导，但存在局限：仅在二分类任务上测试、未涵盖Transformer架构。未来工作应扩展到多分类任务、多样化数据集及Transformer的可解释性-量化交互研究。

title: Efficient Learning of Truncated Boolean Product Distributions: Influence to the Rescue
summary: Learning the natural parameters $z \in \mathbb{R}^n$ of discrete distributions $\mu_z$ from independent samples constrained to a subset $S \subseteq \{0,1\}^n$ is a foundational challenge in high-dimensional statistics. Existing methods for efficiently estimating truncated Boolean product distributions, notably the work of [Fotakis et al' COLT'20, Algorithmica '22], require either strong local connectivity assumptions on $S$ -- a property denoted fatness -- or stringent anti-concentration assumptions and necessitate the total mass of the truncation set to be a constant with respect to $n$. Moreover, the results in [Fotakis et al' COLT'20, Algorithmica '22] suffer from sample complexities that scale as $\Omega(2^n)$ if the mass of $S$ is exponentially small in $n$. In this work, we circumvent these limitations by analyzing the geometry of $S$ under the measure $\mu_z$. We refine the existing parameter estimation guarantees under the fatness assumption, improving the prior sample complexity to $O( \log n / \epsilon^2)$ for $\ell_\infty$-recovery, matching the untruncated minimax rate. We further generalize fatness using the notion of influence utilized in the analysis of Boolean functions and provide sufficient conditions for efficient inference. Notably, unlike previous work, our method does not require sampling at arbitrary parameterizations of the model. Lastly, we establish a theoretical lower bound demonstrating the sample complexity exhibits an intrinsic exponential dependence on the width of the model and the minimum distance between elements in the set.

AI.tldr: 本文研究截断布尔乘积分布（truncated Boolean product distributions）的参数估计问题。通过引入布尔函数分析中的"影响"（influence）概念，作者推广了现有的"fatness"假设，绕过了对生存质量（survival mass）的依赖，在更一般的截断集条件下实现了高效学习，并给出了匹配的下界。
AI.motivation: 从截断样本中学习是统计学中的基础挑战，但现有方法（如Fotakis等人COLT'20/Algorithmica'22的工作）存在三个主要局限：(1) 需要强的局部连通性假设（fatness），使得许多自然截断集（如奇偶集parity set）无法处理；(2) 需要严格的反集中性（anti-concentration）假设，且截断集的总质量必须是n的常数；(3) 当S的质量随n指数级小时，样本复杂度退化为Ω(2^n)。核心问题是：能否设计计算高效的算法，在不依赖生存质量和严格局部连通性条件的情况下学习截断布尔乘积分布？
AI.method: 方法分三部分：(1) **γ-fatness下的改进算法**：对每个坐标i，利用可在该坐标翻转的子样本，通过一维logistic回归（用二分法在导数上搜索）独立估计z_i，证明了ℓ∞恢复的样本复杂度为O(log n/(γε²))。(2) **超越fatness——影响框架**：定义条件影响Inf_I^{μ_{z|S}}（翻转I中所有坐标后样本落在S外的概率），提出有界影响假设（Assumption 4.1，控制最小翻转事件的概率≥γ）和翻转方向假设（Assumption 4.2，符号设计矩阵的最小特征值≥λ_s）。算法通过枚举候选对(I,s)、估计稀疏线性形式w_I^T z、再用加权最小二乘求解z=Wz的逆问题来恢复参数。(3) **下界构造**：将[n]分成B=n/(2k)个块，每块取V={0^{2k}, 1^{2k}, (0^k,1^k), (1^k,0^k)}，构造截断集S=V^B，利用Assouad引理建立信息论下界。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) **Informal Theorem 1**（fatness下学习）：N=O(log(n/δ)/(γε²))样本即可实现ℓ∞-误差ε的p-参数恢复；N=O(e^{2R}log(n/δ)/(γε²))样本实现z-参数恢复，匹配未截断的minimax率。(2) **Informal Theorem 2**（影响框架下学习）：在假设4.1和4.2下，N=O(2^k e^{2kR}/(γλ_s ε²)·(k log(2n)+log(4k/δ)))样本可恢复z。(3) **Informal Theorem 3**（下界）：对于构造的截断集S（不同元素Hamming距离≥k），N≥Ω(n exp(kR/2)/(k²ε²))样本是必要的，展示了样本复杂度对宽度R和块分离参数k的本征指数依赖。此外，方法不需在任意参数化处采样，区别于之前基于投影随机梯度下降的工作。
AI.conclusion: 本文为截断布尔乘积分布的参数估计提供了新框架，突破了生存质量和单比特翻转局部连通性的限制。在fatness假设下改进了样本复杂度（从依赖n提升到依赖log n），并通过影响概念推广到更一般的截断集。匹配的下界表明kR依赖是不可避免的。未来方向包括：(1) 阐明影响与Fisher信息矩阵之间的精确关系；(2) 将技术推广到采样困难的更复杂离散分布（如一般马尔可夫随机场）；(3) 探索截断集未知但属于低影响类别的学习问题。

title: Learning from the Descent Direction: Adaptive Gradient Descent under One-Sided Hölder Regularity
summary: We study adaptive gradient descent for continuously differentiable, possibly nonconvex objectives under one-sided Hölder regularity. Unlike classical Hölder- or Lipschitz-gradient assumptions, which control the full gradient variation, our condition bounds only the directional term appearing in the descent inequality. This can allow less conservative step sizes when large gradient changes are orthogonal to, or favorable along, the update direction. We propose an adaptive scalar-step method based on an estimate of positive one-sided Hölder curvature, combined with a simple sufficient-decrease safeguard. For nonconvex objectives on a convex region containing the accepted update segments, we prove an explicit best-iterate stationarity bound with a rate determined by the Hölder exponent. Unlike predetermined diminishing step-size schemes, the method adapts to the local descent geometry. We evaluate the approach on two full-batch benchmarks designed to separate directional curvature from full gradient variation. On a binary classification problem, the method achieves the lowest final cross-entropy, objective value, and gradient norm, together with the largest classification margin among the compared scalar gradient methods. On a nonconvex Hölder regression problem, it attains the lowest final objective gap and gradient norm. These results indicate that one-sided Hölder curvature is an effective adaptive step-size signal when full-gradient variation is inflated by directions that do not hinder descent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于单边 Hölder 正则性假设的自适应梯度下降方法（OSH），该方法仅沿下降方向估计正向方向曲率而非全梯度变化范数，从而在方向依赖性强的优化问题中获得更宽松的步长。在非凸连续可微目标上证明了显式的最优迭代驻点率 O(K^(-α/(1+α)))，并在两个受控全批量基准（二分类与非凸 Hölder 回归）上验证其优于固定步长 GD、递减步长 GD、全局 Lipschitz/单边 Lipschitz/全局 Hölder 标量基线。
AI.motivation: 经典的 Lipschitz 或 Hölder 梯度连续性条件控制的是全范数意义下的梯度变化 ∥∇F(x)−∇F(y)∥，当大梯度变化正交于下降方向或沿该方向有利时，会导致步长过于保守，从而限制了优化效率。作者指出，对下降步骤真正起作用的只是沿实际更新方向的方向曲率项 ⟨∇F(x)−∇F(y), x−y⟩，因此需要一种更贴合下降几何的自适应步长机制。此外，先前基于预定递减步长的收敛分析依赖衰减指数的人工选择，缺乏对局部曲率的适应能力。
AI.method: 1. **正则性模型**：定义单边 Hölder 曲率条件 ⟨∇F(x)−∇F(y), x−y⟩ ≤ c_α∥x−y∥^(1+α)，α∈(0,1]，该条件弱于全局 Hölder 梯度连续性（反之一般不成立）。2. **方向曲率估计**：在每步沿负梯度方向以探针半径 r_k 做有限差分估计，计算仅取正向部分的方向曲率估计 ĉ_{α,k}，并通过 EMA 与下界进行稳定化。3. **自适应步长公式**：η_k^OSH ∝ c̃_{α,k}^(-1/α) ∥g_k∥^((1−α)/α)，结合 Armijo 充分下降条件进行回溯保护。4. **理论分析**：推导单边 Hölder 下降引理，得到显式驻点率定理；给出带回溯保护的实际可实现收敛保证及全局收敛到孤立临界点的定理；在 PL 不等式与二次增长条件下给出目标函数差距与距离的速率推论。5. **数值实验**：在受控二分类（α=0.7）与非凸 Hölder 回归（α=0.5）两个全批量基准上与 GL/OSL/GH 等标量曲率基线对比。
AI.result: **理论结果**：(i) 最优迭代驻点率 min_k∥∇F(x_k)∥ = O(K^(-α/(1+α)))；(ii) 带 Armijo 回溯保护的算法在估计曲率有界条件下保持相同速率量级；(iii) 在强制与临界点孤立假设下全局收敛到唯一临界点；(iv) PL 条件下 F(x_k)−F_⋆ = O(k^(-2α/(1−α)))，α=1 时为线性收敛。**实验结果**：二分类任务上 OSH 在交叉熵（4.07×10⁻²）、目标值（4.17×10⁻²）、梯度范数（4.91×10⁻²）和分类间隔（3.183）四项指标上均优于所有标量基线方法；非凸 Hölder 回归任务上 OSH 取得最低目标差距（2.52×10⁻¹⁰）和最低最终梯度范数（3.06×10⁻⁴）。
AI.conclusion: 单边 Hölder 方向曲率能够作为有效的自适应步长信号，尤其在全梯度变化被正交或有利方向"膨胀"的情况下；所提 OSH 方法在理论与受控实验层面均验证了其相对于全范数曲率估计的优势。局限在于：实验为受控全批量而非大规模随机优化场景；曲率探针需要额外梯度求值；理论依赖于线搜索段上正则性与估计曲率有界性。未来工作包括随机变体、低成本曲率探针、数据驱动的探针半径选择及更大规模的学习问题。

title: Beyond Directed Acyclic Graphs: Causal Zeros and Causal Differential Equations
summary: Pearl's structural causal model (SCM) framework, built on directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) and the do-calculus, is the dominant formal language for causal reasoning. Yet it carries two structural restrictions: every relationship must be pre-specified as a directed causal edge, and feedback cycles are forbidden. This paper examines two classes of phenomena that strain these restrictions. First, symmetric physical and economic constraints, the ideal gas law being the canonical case, carry no intrinsic causal direction. Direction emerges only under intervention, and which variable is solved for must be specified as part of the intervention. We formalize such constraints as causal zeros within an Extended Causal Model by adding an activation operator, subject to local solvability and graph-admissibility conditions. Second, for the class of finite-propagation state-space systems considered here, we treat apparent instantaneous cycles as artifacts of suppressed time and ground both causal zeros and feedback in Causal Differential Equations (CDEs). In these, the transient regime is a time-unrolled acyclic causal process, and causal zeros arise as the defining functions of attracting equilibrium manifolds; periodic and chaotic attractors define further regimes of the same dynamics, treated through attractor-relative intervention. We give the extended do-calculus, identifiability conditions, counterfactual semantics, and open problems.

AI.tldr: 本文针对Pearl结构因果模型(SCM)的两大结构性局限——必须预先指定有向因果边、禁止反馈环——提出扩展框架。论文将理想气体定律等对称物理/经济约束形式化为"因果零"(causal zeros)，并通过因果微分方程(CDEs)统一处理对称约束与反馈，引入激活算子与吸引子相对干预，扩展了do-calculus、可识别性条件及反事实语义。
AI.motivation: Pearl的SCM框架基于DAG，要求所有关系预先指定为有向因果边且禁止反馈环，无法自然表达两类现象：(1) 理想气体定律PV=nRT这类对称约束无内在因果方向，方向仅在干预下出现；(2) 有限传播速度的态空间系统中看似瞬时的循环实为被压缩的时间过程。现有框架缺乏对对称约束和无环假设的统一处理工具。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) **因果零(causal zeros)**——在扩展因果模型(Extended Causal Model)中通过添加激活算子表达对称约束，需满足局部可解性与图可容许性条件；(2) **因果微分方程(CDEs)**——将瞬时循环视为被抑制的时间的产物，瞬态为时序展开的无环因果过程；(3) **吸引子相对干预(attractor-relative intervention)**——将因果零与吸引子(平衡、周期、混沌)统一为同一动力学的不同状态。配套给出扩展的do-calculus、可识别性条件与反事实语义。
AI.result: 论文提出了一套完整的理论扩展框架：将对无环DAG有严格要求的SCM推广到可处理对称约束与反馈循环；证明了因果零在CDE框架下可作为吸引平衡流形的定义函数；给出了相应的do-calculus推广、可识别性判据以及反事实形式语义。文章同时指出了若干开放问题。
AI.conclusion: 对称物理约束与反馈循环不应被视为因果建模的"违规"，而应纳入统一的扩展因果模型中。CDEs为处理此类现象提供了自然基底，因果零与吸引子相对干预是该扩展的核心机制。该工作拓展了因果推断的形式语言，为涉及物理定律约束和动力学的复杂系统建模提供了新工具。

title: Hidden Boundary Motion in Transformer Optimization: Function-Space Orthogonalization of Affine Weight and Bias Updates
summary:
Weights and biases are normally optimized as separate parameter tensors, yet they do not represent separate functions when the input to an affine layer has nonzero mean. For an affine map $z=Wx+b$ with input mean $\mu$, a weight update contains a sample-independent displacement $\Delta W\mu$ that is functionally indistinguishable from a bias update. We call this hidden contribution \emph{boundary motion} and decompose each update into a centered, sample-varying \emph{shape} component and a shared \emph{boundary} component. On a four-layer Transformer trained from scratch on IMDb, the bias-like term $g_b\mu^	op$ has a median norm equal to 0.664 of the raw weight-gradient norm across affine layers and training checkpoints. More strikingly, the median ratio $
orm{\Delta W\mu}/
orm{\Delta b}$ is 134.7, while $
orm{\Delta W\mu}/
orm{\Delta b+\Delta W\mu}$ is 0.994. Thus, under AdamW, the observed boundary motion is almost entirely realized through the weight matrix rather than the explicit bias. We implement a diagnostic optimizer, Shape--Boundary Orthogonal AdamW (SBO-AdamW), that optimizes $g_W-g_b\mu^	op$ and $g_b$ with independent Adam states and compensates the weight-induced boundary displacement. In a single-seed experiment, SBO-AdamW raises validation accuracy from 81.68\% to 85.81\% and validation-selected test accuracy from 78.73\% to 82.73\%, with the best validation checkpoint occurring at step 800 instead of step 3000. However, the moving-batch-center compensation produces severe bias-coordinate drift and strongly reduces boundary energy. The present evidence therefore supports hidden boundary motion as an important optimization mechanism, but it does not yet establish a final general-purpose optimizer. A stable centered-affine parameterization is identified as the required next step.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了仿射层权重更新中存在的"隐藏边界运动"现象：当输入均值非零时，权重更新 ΔWμ 在功能上与偏置更新不可区分。通过在 IMDb 任务上的四层 Transformer 实验，证明 AdamW 下权重矩阵承担了约 99.4% 的实际边界位移（是显式偏置步长的 134.7 倍），并提出诊断优化器 SBO-AdamW 将形状与边界分量独立优化，使验证准确率提升 4.13 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现代优化器（如 AdamW、Muon）按参数张量类型（W 或 b）施加不同处理，但这一划分假设参数类型与功能角色一致。然而对于 z=Wx+b，当输入均值 μ≠0 时，权重更新天然包含样本无关的位移 ΔWμ，与偏置功能完全重叠。仅报告 ‖ΔW‖ 和 ‖Δb‖ 这类参数空间统计量无法揭示边界位移的真正承担者，可能导致"偏置不重要"的错误结论。
AI.method: 1. 形状-边界分解：在批均值 μ 处将仿射变换分解为 z=W(x-μ)+c，其中 W(x-μ) 为形状项（批内均值为零），c=b+Wμ 为共享边界。证明两者在经验输出空间内积下严格正交。2. 梯度分解：g_W = g_W^shape + g_b μ^T，其中 g_W^shape = g_W - g_b μ^T。3. 诊断指标：R_grad、‖ΔWμ‖/‖Δb‖、‖ΔWμ‖/‖Δb+ΔWμ‖、边界干涉增益等。4. SBO-AdamW 优化器：对 g_W - g_b μ^T 和 g_b 分别维护独立 Adam 状态，并通过补偿 Δb = Δc_intended - ΔWμ 维持功能等价。5. 实验设置：IMDb 数据集、4 层 Transformer 编码器（hidden=256）、17 个仿射模块、301 个检查点、单种子（seed 42）、3000 步。
AI.result: 1. AdamW 下 g_b μ^T 的中位范数比 R_grad=0.664（10–90 分位 [0.319, 0.944]），中位余弦 0.556。2. 边界泄漏比 R_leak,b 中位 134.7（10–90 分位 [45.0, 740.0]），R_leak,c=0.994——即权重路径承担了 99.4% 的实际边界位移。3. SBO-AdamW 验证准确率从 81.68% 提升至 85.81%，测试准确率从 78.73% 提升至 82.73%，最佳验证检查点提前至第 800 步（AdamW 为第 3000 步）。4. 但 SBO 同时大幅抑制了边界能量（步 800 时 E_boundary 从 17.9 降至 5.21e-05），且补偿机制导致偏置范数严重漂移（中位 21.75，最大 673.63，AdamW 分别为 0.766 和 1.96）。
AI.conclusion: 实验充分支持"隐藏边界运动"作为重要的优化机制：权重矩阵中确实存在与偏置功能重叠的隐藏通道，且该通道在 AdamW 下远大于显式偏置步长。SBO-AdamW 原型加速收敛并提升泛化，但当前实现存在两个根本缺陷——移动批均值补偿引起的边界能量抑制和参数坐标漂移。因此本文不宣称其作为通用优化器，而将稳定的"中心化仿射参数化"（直接存储 W 和 c，固定参考中心 μ̄）确定为下一步必要工作。核心启示是：参数优化策略应由功能角色（形状 vs 边界）而非张量形状决定。

title: Distribution-Specific Curvature Control with Finite-Sample Guarantees for Open-Weight Safety
summary: A short fine-tuning run can undo the safety guards of an open-weight model---retraining a refusal-trained assistant to aid weapons development or produce hate speech. Preventing such harmful fine-tuning while retaining benign adaptability remains difficult: the only prior method with an explicit curvature certificate, spectral deformation, inflates curvature globally and thereby obstructs benign adaptation along with harmful adaptation. We propose HarmAlign, which applies function-preserving spectral deformation along a estimated contrastive activation subspace. We derive finite-sample bounds for the estimated subspace energy and the resulting local harmful-distribution curvature lower bound. A stability--progress dichotomy for constant-step gradient descent turns the certified curvature into conditional convergence-rate control. Empirically, within a fixed-architecture, finite-budget first-order threat model, HarmAlign blocks direct fine-tuning and three data- or objective-adaptive attacks across a hazardous-knowledge relearning setting and a harmful-assistance fine-tuning setting, while the protected benign tasks remain trainable. The block persists across the tested first-order optimizer variants over every attack checkpoint, and under out-of-distribution harmful fine-tuning, and it extends to important cases in our threat model: accidental safety degradation and emergent misalignment.

AI.tldr: HarmAlign 是一种针对开源权重模型的新型防御方法，通过在估计的对比激活子空间上进行保函数谱形变，实现分布特异的曲率控制。该方法提供有限样本保证和条件收敛率证书，在 WMDP-bio 重新学习和 BeaverTails 有害微调场景下有效阻止直接微调和三种自适应攻击（包括数据自适应和目标自适应攻击），同时保持良性任务的可训练性。
AI.motivation: 开源权重基础模型面临独特的安全风险：短时间的有害微调可以削弱模型的安全防护。现有的有害微调防御方法（如表征工程、防篡改训练、元学习鲁棒性）已被自适应攻击削弱。先前唯一具有显式曲率证书的方法（谱形变 SpecDef）会全局性地膨胀曲率，阻碍良性适应。这留下了两个空白：全局控制 vs 分布特异控制，以及类级保证 vs 实例保证。研究问题是：能否将曲率控制局部化到有害分布，同时限制其对指定良性分布的影响？
AI.method: 1. 局部化曲率控制：通过有害和良性二阶矩估计对比激活子空间 Π_k，沿该子空间应用谱形变，在初始化时保持表示函数不变；2. 函数保持的谱形变：使用补偿对 (θ', θ_comp) 通过奇异值分解的旋转和缩放实现；3. 对比二阶矩子空间选择：求解 max tr(Π_k^T S_λ Π_k)，其中 S_λ = λM_H - (1-λ)M_B；4. 有限样本保证（定理4.8）：子空间能量估计误差缩放为 O(n^{-1/2} + m^{-1/2})；5. 常步长 GD 的稳定性-进度二分法（定理K.4和K.21）：在二次型模型中精确，在神经网络损失中是条件性证书；6. 前向-only 超参数选择诊断：覆盖率 ℰ_H、良性泄漏 ℰ_B、选择性 ℰ_H/ℰ_B、梯度激励 ρ_g。
AI.result: 主要实验结果：1) WMDP-bio 重新学习（L4.o_proj, k=1, λ=0.05, τ=3×10^5）：四种攻击下 WMDP 准确率 ≤0.24（机会水平 0.25），良性任务 E2E=0.71, DART=0.36, WikiSQL=0.35；2) BeaverTails 有害微调（L28.{q,k,v,o}_proj, k=2, τ=4×10^4）：所有攻击下 coherent-ASR=0.00，良性 E2E=0.75, SamSum=0.51；3) 自适应攻击：SGD+momentum、符号梯度、无梯度裁剪、Adafactor、Muon 等均在 BeaverTails 上被阻止为 0.00；4) OOD 有害泛化：XSTest 和 OR-Bench 上 coherent-ASR=0.00；5) 检查点最大 ASR：每10步检查在 undef 模型达 0.81-0.94，HarmAlign 模型 ≤0.13；6) 案例研究：意外安全降解下 coherent-ASR 保持 0.00（vs undef 的 0.50）；紧急失调从 22.9% 降至 7.6%。有限样本速率与预测的 n^{-1/2} 标度律一致。在 8B 模型上直接测量的块 Hessian 极端特征值遵循 τ^2 律（斜率 2.00-2.01）。
AI.conclusion: HarmAlign 解决了开源权重安全的核心矛盾——防止有害微调的同时不破坏良性适应性——通过将谱曲率膨胀局部化到估计的有害子空间，将表征几何转化为具有有限样本和条件速率保证的选择性优化障碍。该障碍经验性地阻止了直接微调、三种自适应攻击以及优化器类、检查点和 OOD 探测（WMDP-bio ≤0.33；coherent-ASR 0.00），同时良性任务仍可训练。贡献在于：1) 首次通过分布特异激活几何实现曲率膨胀的局部化；2) 将表示几何转化为具有条件速率控制的选择性优化障碍；3) 提供了经验可证伪的固定架构威胁模型。限制包括：良性适应需要低学习率（≤10^{-6}），OOD 良性可训练性具有设置依赖性，部署点测量覆盖率较低（WMDP 处 ℰ_H=0.28）。理论范围：证书是条件性的，依赖于稳定性约束和受控子空间预算假设。

title: Spectral-Aware Analytic Class-Incremental Learning for Long-Tailed Distributions
summary: Analytic Continual Learning (ACL) offers a computationally efficient alternative to gradient-based approaches. Recent ACL methods are based on Recursive Least Squares (RLS) and have achieved the state-of-the-art results compared to other alternatives. However, they falter significantly in Class-Incremental Learning scenarios characterized by Long-Tailed distributions. While the ill-conditioning of the autocorrelation (Gram) matrix is a known limitation of RLS, we demonstrate that class imbalance exacerbates this issue into a distinct spectral pathology: "tail" classes suffer from severe spectral collapse, rendering their subspaces numerically indistinguishable from noise. Standard Ridge Regression ($L_2$) fails to address this effectively as it applies isotropic regularization - a uniform penalty that is insufficient to stabilize the tail without over-shrinking the head. To address this, we propose Geometry-Spectral Rectification (GSR), a theoretically grounded framework that treats long-tailed learning as a spectral regularization problem. Unlike standard isotropic regularization (Ridge) which uniformly penalizes all eigenvalues, GSR acts as an anisotropic spectral filter, selectively inflating the collapsed eigenvalues of tail classes. We construct a structured, data-dependent spectral perturbation matrix $\Delta$ that selectively inflates collapsed tail eigen-directions of the Gram matrix. Theoretical analysis proves that GSR guarantees an improved stable rank for the Gram matrix, ensuring numerical stability. Extensive experiments show that GSR establishes a new state-of-the-art for analytic CIL, offering a superior trade-off between computational efficiency and robust generalization in long-tailed settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Geometry-Spectral Rectification (GSR)框架，针对长尾分布下的类增量学习场景，解决了基于递归最小二乘法(RLS)的解析持续学习方法中尾部类别出现的"谱坍缩"谱病理问题，通过各向异性谱正则化替代传统各向同性Ridge正则化，在长尾类增量学习中取得了新的最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的解析持续学习(ACL)方法基于递归最小二乘法(RLS)，虽然在计算效率上具有优势，但在长尾分布的类增量学习(CIL)场景中表现急剧下降。研究发现类别不平衡加剧了自相关(Gram)矩阵的病态性问题，导致尾部类别出现严重的谱坍缩现象，使其子空间在数值上无法与噪声区分。标准Ridge回归的各向同性正则化无法解决该问题，因为它对所有特征值施加统一惩罚，在稳定尾部的同时会过度压缩头部。
AI.method: 提出Geometry-Spectral Rectification (GSR)框架，将长尾学习视为谱正则化问题。该方法构造一个结构化的、数据相关的谱扰动矩阵Δ，对Gram矩阵中尾部类别坍缩的特征方向进行选择性膨胀。具体而言：(1) 理论分析揭示了长尾分布导致的谱坍缩病理；(2) 设计各向异性谱滤波器，区别对待不同特征值方向；(3) 理论证明GSR能够保证Gram矩阵具有改善的稳定秩(stable rank)，确保数值稳定性。
AI.result: 广泛的实验表明，GSR在解析类增量学习中建立了新的最优性能(state-of-the-art)，在长尾设置下提供了计算效率与鲁棒泛化能力之间的优越平衡。该方法有效克服了尾部类别的谱坍缩问题，同时避免了对头部类别的过度正则化。
AI.conclusion: GSR为解析持续学习中的长尾类增量学习问题提供了一种理论坚实且实践有效的解决方案。通过将传统的各向同性谱正则化(Ridge)推广为各向异性谱滤波，该工作开辟了从谱理论视角处理类别不平衡问题的研究方向，对解析持续学习在真实长尾数据场景中的应用具有重要推进意义。

title: Discrepancy-Rounded Fair Bandits with Static and Time-Varying Exposure Floors
summary: Minimum-exposure constraints arise in recommendation, content curation, and regulated allocation when each provider, arm, or group must receive guaranteed exposure inside a period rather than only in aggregate. We study stochastic bandits with exact exposure floors and show that the right object is a rounding problem: a fractional fair schedule is realized as integral pulls, and the exposure error is exactly a discrepancy vector. The main contribution is a blockwise model with time-varying floors. BDQ-UCB satisfies every block floor deterministically and has fair regret governed by the nonmandatory budget $R$, not the horizon $T$, with high-probability regret $O(\sqrt{KR\log(KT)})$. A MOSS residual variant attains $O(\sqrt{KR})$, and a matching lower bound gives the minimax rate $\Theta(\sqrt{KR})$, even with positive mandatory exposure; a kl-UCB$^{++}$ residual rule adds instance-dependent optimality. The formulation becomes essential for overlapping group floors: per-arm rounding can violate a group constraint by $\Omega(s)$ in the group size, whereas Beck--Fiala null-space rounding meets every group floor within the block budget with violation below the arm degree $t$, and composes with UCB at the same $R$-parametrized regret. For learned group plans, we close disjoint systems at $\widetilde\Theta(\sqrt{KT})$, give a dual-ledger decomposition explaining why naive index rules fail under overlap, and prove a plan-sampling rule that is pathwise feasible under an initial cover-slack condition and attains a conditional $\widetilde O(\sqrt{KT})$ guarantee, leaving the condition-free overlap rate open. Experiments on synthetic floors, MovieLens-100k genre exposure, and deployment stress tests show exact feasibility without penalty tuning and regret competitive with tuned Lagrangian baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将公平性约束老虎机问题重新诠释为"舍入(discrepancy rounding)"问题：分数公平调度被实现为整数拉动，暴露误差恰好是一个差异向量。核心贡献是分块(blockwise)模型和BDQ-UCB算法，可在确定性地满足每个时间段的暴露下界的同时，使遗憾(regret)由非强制预算R而非总时间T决定，minimax率达到Θ(√(KR))。对于重叠组约束，论文使用Beck-Fiala零空间舍入实现组级可行性；学习组计划时，无重叠系统下达到Θ̃(√(KT))，重叠系统则需要额外的下降条件。
AI.motivation: 最小暴露约束广泛存在于推荐系统、内容策展和受监管的资源分配场景中，每个提供者/臂/组必须在特定时间段内获得保证的暴露量，而非仅在总体上。现有方法（如Lagrangian惩罚）需要精细调参且只能保证渐近可行性，而Fair-MAB框架无法处理时变约束。本文的关键洞察是将公平层视为舍入层：分数公平调度到整数拉动的实现过程中产生的暴露差距本质上是一个差异向量，这一视角在组约束重叠时变得不可或缺。
AI.method:
1. 暴露-差异恒等式：将分数调度与整数拉动的差距形式化为差异向量D_T = N(T) - S(T)，证明暴露公平性等价于控制ℓ∞差异，遗憾等价于加权差异。
2. 分块模型：将时间轴划分为B个块，每块有独立的下界向量m_b。
3. BDQ-UCB：先在每块执行确定性下界调度，再对剩余R = Σ(H_b - Σm_{b,i})轮运行UCB；MOSS变体获O(√(KR))，kl-UCB++变体获得实例依赖最优性。
4. 重叠组约束：采用Beck-Fiala零空间舍入，在每个臂至多属于t个组的条件下，将组违反量限制在t以下（与组大小s和组数量无关）。
5. 学习组计划：D-BDQ-UCB（无重叠）通过每组覆盖拉动实现Θ̃(√(KT))；P-BDQ-UCB（重叠）通过每轮重解乐观规划并附加终末覆盖舍入保护，在初始覆盖松弛条件下达到条件性Õ(√(KT))。
6. 理论工具：minimax下界通过KL链式法则和Pinsker不等式构造；实例依赖下界通过Bretagnolle-Huber不等式；双重对偶账本分解解释为何朴素索引规则在重叠时失败。
AI.result: 主要理论结果包括：①BDQ-UCB以1-η的概率实现遗憾≤ K + 4√(2KRL)，其中L = log(2KT/η)，且确定性满足每块下界；②minimax下界Ω(√(KR))在正强制暴露下依然成立；③BDQ-KL以kl-UCB++残差规则匹配实例依赖常数(1+o(1))log R · ΣΔ_i/kl(μ_i, μ_*)；④Group-BDQ-UCB在固定组计划下保持O(√(KR))遗憾并确定性满足组下界；⑤无重叠系统的计划学习代价为Θ̃(√(KT))，由新的下界Ω(B√H)刻画。实验上：6臂12块合成数据中BDQ-UCB块违反=0，遗憾55.7±3.9；MovieLens-100k流派暴露(K=18)中块违反=0，遗憾82.2±1.7；24实例压力测试中BDQ-UCB在全部24例上可行无需调参，而任何有界Lagrangian惩罚最多只能覆盖22/24。重叠组实验证实Beck-Fiala在adversarial半整数计划上最大违反≤1.48(t=2)，而朴素舍入按组大小s线性增长至11.52。
AI.conclusion: 将公平暴露视为差异舍入问题统一了静态和分块时变下界设置，确立了非强制预算R作为正确复杂度参数（minimax意义Θ(√(KR))，实例依赖意义也由R驱动）。Beck-Fiala零空间舍入在组约束重叠时是结构性必要的，朴素逐臂舍入失败的原因是它无法捕捉单次拉动同时满足多个组的多覆盖价值。分块模型严格强于全局终末计数和块无关代理——存在旋转下界族使后两者需要额外Ω(αΔT)遗憾。论文贡献的本质是参数自由的精确可行性，而非更低的遗憾：无需调参即可确定性满足每块下界，遗憾由R参数化；不调参的算法在24实例压力测试中达到所有24例可行，胜于任何有界Lagrangian。重叠组计划学习在无下降条件下的率仍开放，是该差异桥接方法的自然延伸方向。

title: Verbalized Particle Posterior: Bayesian Inference over Natural Language Hypotheses
summary: Verbalized Machine Learning (VML) parameterizes a model as a natural-language prompt that an LLM evaluates as f(x; theta). The framework is interpretable, but it commits to a single hypothesis with no measure of uncertainty, and that hypothesis varies substantially across optimization runs on the same data. We propose the Verbalized Particle Posterior (VPP), which treats verbalized learning as a Bayesian inference problem: maintain a population of natural-language hypotheses as particles, update them with Metropolis-Hastings (VPP-MH) or Sequential Monte Carlo (VPP-SMC), and predict by Bayesian model averaging. Both algorithms treat the LLM as a black box, requiring no access to logits or gradients. A distinctive consequence follows. In classical Bayesian learning, model selection sits outside the posterior; in VPP both model structure and parameters share a single language space, and the posterior ranges over both. We evaluate VPP on regression, classification, and rule-discovery benchmarks. It improves over a single VML run on every benchmark and matches or exceeds an oracle-best ensemble of independent VML runs on most, while eliminating the catastrophic single-run failures that VML occasionally produces. Because each particle is a human-readable hypothesis, the posterior is itself something a reader can inspect, seeing in plain text which explanations the data supported and which it ruled out.

AI.tldr: 提出 Verbalized Particle Posterior (VPP)，将 Verbalized Machine Learning (VML) 重新定义为贝叶斯推断问题，在自然语言假设空间上维护粒子群体，通过 Metropolis-Hastings (VPP-MH) 或 Sequential Monte Carlo (VPP-SMC) 进行后验推断，并以贝叶斯模型平均进行预测，从而为自然语言模型提供不确定性量化、鲁棒性和可解释的后验。
AI.motivation: 1) VML（用自然语言 prompt 作为模型参数，LLM 作为求值器）虽具可解释性，但只输出单一假设，且优化过程方差极大——例如线性回归 15 次独立运行的测试 MSE 跨度达 44.7 倍（1.08 到 48.30），无法区分好坏运行，也无机制标记不可靠输入。2) 经典贝叶斯学习将模型选择置于后验之外，但在 VML 中模型结构与参数共享同一语言空间，需要一种统一的后验框架同时处理模型选择与参数推断。3) 语言空间 Θ_language 离散、变维、无梯度，主流变分推断与 HMC 等方法均不可用，需要黑盒粒子方法来填补此空白。
AI.method: 将后验 p(θ|D)∝p(D|θ)p(θ) 近似为粒子集 {(θ^(k), w_k)}：① 似然由 LLM 预测与真实标签之间的回归高斯似然（τ=1）或分类平滑 0/1 似然（ε=0.05）外部定义；② 先验由 LLM 优化器以不同温度对模型类无关种子 prompt 采样得到（仅采样不逐点评估）；③ VPP-MH：以优化器 LLM 作为信息化提议分布，每步按批似然比 α=min(1, p(D_batch|θ')/p(D_batch|θ)) 接受/拒绝候选，等权重 BMA 预测；④ VPP-SMC：在温度调度 β:10→1 下对粒子重加权，使用滚动评估缓冲 B=40 稳定似然估计，当 ESS<K/2 时系统重采样，并对高/低于中位数的粒子分别用低/高温度的优化器做保守/探索性变异；⑤ 两者均将 LLM 视作黑盒，无需 logits 或梯度访问。
AI.result: 在 7 个基准（3 回归、2 分类、2 模式发现）上用 Llama-3-70B-Instruct 评估：① VPP 在全部 7 个任务上均优于单次 VML；② 在 7 个任务中的 6 个上达到或超过 oracle best-of-5 VML 集成，多项式回归 MSE 降低达 24 倍（74.77→3.10）；③ VPP-SMC 在 two-circles、sum parity、contains-zero 三个任务上每个 seed 均达 100% 准确率，消除 VML 的灾难性单次失败；④ sum parity 上 oracle best-of-5 与 VPP-SMC 均达 100%，但无权重集成仅 67.2%，验证似然重加权的必要性；⑤ 消融显示 accept/reject 步骤是关键（sum parity 提升 22.2pp），K=10 时线性回归 MSE 从 K=1 的 4.53 降至 0.66；⑥ 粒子一致性可作为可解释的不确定性信号；⑦ 计算开销为单次 VML 的 14.7–15.8 倍（K=10 粒子 × 3K 次 LLM 调用/步）。
AI.conclusion: VPP 通过 VPP-MH 与 VPP-SMC 两种黑盒粒子算法，将贝叶斯推断引入自然语言假设空间，在保留 VML 可解释性的同时赋予其不确定性量化与对灾难性失败的鲁棒性；MH 的 accept/reject 步骤是核心机制，每个粒子为人类可读假设使后验本身可被读者直接审阅。局限性：继承了 VML 在精确数值预测上的算术弱点；实验仅在 Llama-3-70B 与小型合成任务上完成；K=10 在更难符号任务上存在轻度粒子退化，建议未来工作采用自适应 K 与温度调度。

title: Learned Interventions in Lean 4 grind
summary: Lean~4's \grind{} tactic combines congruence closure, \ematch{}ing, and case-splitting into a single automated solver, and like any such solver, it relies on hand-tuned heuristics to decide what to instantiate and where to case-split. These heuristics are tempting targets for learning, but there is a catch: because \grind{}'s search is non-monotone, a learned heuristic that helps one proof can break another, and an always-on replacement usually nets out near zero. We avoid this by invoking a learned intervention only after stock \grind{} has already failed: a failure-triggered cascade that, by construction, cannot lose a proof \grind{} already had. We apply it to two of \grind{}'s internal decisions. A cost-aware \ematch{} filter solves slightly more problems and runs about 5\% faster. A lookahead step, proves five theorems it otherwise times out on. We also report the negative result that motivated the design: across four feature-based models, statically predicting the correct case split is no better than random, because whether a split explodes is a runtime property that the features do not capture. Our results suggest that learning within theorem-proving tactics is most effective as a mechanism for deciding when and how to spend bounded search, backed by a reliable symbolic fallback.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何在 Lean 4 的 grind 自动证明策略内部安全地集成机器学习启发式。作者提出"失败触发的级联"（failure-triggered cascade）部署模式——先运行 stock grind，仅在其失败时调用学习到的干预——从而保证不破坏已可证明的目标。文中实现了两个具体干预：成本感知的 e-match 过滤器（小幅提速并多解决 2 个问题）以及有界前瞻分裂策略（在 44 个含可救决策的定理上净增 5 个证明且零回归）。同时报告了负面结果：四种基于静态特征的模型在预测正确分裂上并不优于随机选择，因为分支爆炸本质上是运行时动态属性。
AI.motivation: grind 这类自动化证明策略内部依赖大量手工启发式（e-match 实例过滤、case-split 选择等），是机器学习的高价值切入点。然而 grind 的搜索是非单调的（non-monotone），全局替换的启发式可能在新位置引发 e-graph 爆炸，导致解决一些问题却破坏另一些已解决的问题，净收益接近零。因此需要一种安全的部署模式让学习能在不牺牲基线的前提下提升证明能力。
AI.method: 1) 失败触发的级联（failure-triggered cascade）：将 stock grind 作为默认与回退，仅在其失败时调用学习到的干预，从构造上保证不会丢失 grind 已能证明的目标。2) 成本感知 e-match 过滤器：轻量 MLP（135→64→32→1）预测每个 e-match 实例是否出现在最终证明中（proof-relevance），丢弃低分实例。3) 前瞻分裂策略（lookahead）：在每个分裂决策点对候选进行限时试跑——复制目标、强制某候选、运行 grind 的小预算子搜索——首个关闭的候选被提交。4) 强制选择协议（forced-choice protocol）用于研究：固定其他证明流程，分别强制每个候选并记录结果，以构建 oracle 数据集（含约 16K 强制结果、4120 个多候选决策）。
AI.result: e-match 过滤器在 855 个保留定理上比 stock grind 略多解决 +2 个并提速约 5%。前瞻策略在 44 个含可救分裂决策的定理上：stock grind 解 39 个，always-on 前瞻解 42（救回 5 个但回归 2 个），而级联策略解 44/44，零回归且使用更少分裂（1059 vs 1271）。负面结果：在"可救失败"决策上，stock grind 救援率 0%，GBM 成本模型/生成规则 30–46%，doom/value 与失败感知分类器 46–53%，均匀随机 57%，1 步前瞻（实际执行）100%。四种静态特征模型均无法超越随机，因为分支是否爆炸是动态属性。前瞻在 C=15s 时可救回 90% 可救失败。前提增强实验显示即使真实前提也只能救回约 2% 失败却破坏约 26% 已解决目标，级联同样适用。
AI.conclusion: 在非单调的定理证明策略内部集成机器学习时，应保留符号求解器作为默认与回退，让学习仅用于决定"何时"以及"如何"在失败后开展有界搜索。本文的具体成功案例是轻量 e-match 过滤与有界前瞻分裂的级联部署；具体负面教训是静态特征无法预测分支爆炸（这是动态属性）。未来方向：学习门控模型决定何时运行前瞻，以及候选排序模型以减少平均探测次数；并将该级联模式扩展到前提增强等其它干预面。

title: Bayesian Complete-Pooling in Cross-Subject Classification for Motor Imagery Electroencephalogram
summary: Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) have long sought calibration-free operation, but classifiers are typically benchmarked by discrimination alone, blind to whether predicted probabilities are well calibrated - a meaningful gap given nonstationary electroencephalogram (EEG) signals and the risk of overconfident point-estimate classifiers under distribution shift. We conducted a large-scale study contrasting Bayesian complete-pooling models against frequentist baselines for cross-subject, left-hand versus right-hand motor imagery EEG classification across 20 datasets. Six frequentist pipelines were each paired with an analogous Bayesian pipeline sharing identical feature engineering, fit via Markov chain Monte Carlo posterior sampling. Our primary metric was the Brier score, decomposed into reliability and resolution, alongside AUROC for discrimination and Shannon entropy for sharpness. Each metric was analyzed via random-effects meta-analysis (REML, Knapp-Hartung adjustment), verified by leave-one-out influence analysis. Bayesian complete-pooling produced statistically but not practically significant improvements in reliability and increases in predictive uncertainty (lower sharpness); Brier score, resolution, and discrimination showed no significant differences. Between-study heterogeneity was low across all metrics, though the reliability result was sensitive to leave-one-out removal. We additionally profiled computational cost, finding that Bayesian pipelines consumed roughly thirteen times more energy than their frequentist counterparts, a cost that remains modest relative to common household appliances. These results suggest that Bayesian complete-pooling alone offers limited practical benefit for cross-subject motor imagery classification, and that partial-pooling across subjects and sessions is a more promising direction for future work.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模实验（20个数据集、6组配对管道）对比了贝叶斯完全池化模型与频率派基线在跨被试左右手运动想象EEG分类中的表现。主要发现：贝叶斯完全池化在可靠性和锐度上具有统计显著性但不具有实际显著性；在Brier分数、分辨力和判别力（AUROC）上无显著差异；计算能耗约为频率派基线的13倍。研究表明贝叶斯完全池化对跨被试MI-EEG分类的实际收益有限，未来应探索跨被试与跨会话的部分池化（层次模型）。
AI.motivation: 脑机接口（BCI）长期追求免校准运行，但现有分类器通常仅以判别力（如AUROC）作为评估指标，而忽视了预测概率的校准质量。在EEG信号非平稳且分布偏移的背景下，点估计分类器容易产生过度自信的预测。同时，已有研究表明跨被试与跨会话的部分池化以及贝叶斯层次模型在小型研究中展现出潜力，但缺乏大规模的系统性验证。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 基于Mother of all BCI Benchmarks (MOABB) v1.5，筛选20个符合条件（≥8名被试、非其他数据集子集）的左右手MI-EEG数据集；选取Chevallier等人基准中三大类别（Raw、Riemannian、Deep Learning）排名前列的6个频率派管道作为对照组（TS+LR、TS+SVM、SCNN、CSP+SVM、CSP+LDA、DCNN），每个管道配对相同特征工程的贝叶斯处理管道（BLR、GP、BSCNN、BLDA、BDCNN）；预处理包括筛选感觉运动皮层33通道、统一下采样至128 Hz；评估采用留一被试（LOSO）或10折交叉验证；贝叶斯管道采用NUTS（HMC扩展）后验采样，4条链，1000次预热与采样，目标接受率0.95；主指标为Brier分数（分解为可靠性与分辨力），辅以AUROC（判别力）和Shannon熵（锐度）；统计分析采用随机效应荟萃分析（REML估计量、Knapp-Hartung调整）并进行留一法影响分析；同时对比了训练能耗（Wh）。
AI.result: （1）后验采样收敛性良好，仅少数运行（R̂>1.01或ESS<400）出现在GPC类管道中；（2）荟萃分析：可靠性（p=0.0396）和Shannon熵/锐度（p=0.0195）具有统计显著性，前者改善校准、后者降低锐度（预测更不确定），但效应量未达实际显著性；Brier分数、分辨力、AUROC均无显著差异；（3）研究间异质性低（I²均≤28.61%），分辨率与Shannon熵的预测区间不跨零；（4）可靠性的留一法结果不稳定，11/20迭代中出现无效差异，表明结论敏感性较高；锐度结果稳健（仅1/20迭代无效）；（5）能耗对比：贝叶斯管道几何平均能耗为频率派基线的13.1倍，绝对值仍低于常见家用电器。
AI.conclusion: 贝叶斯完全池化对跨被试MI-EEG分类的实际价值有限——虽在可靠性和锐度上有统计显著的改善，但程度小而无实际意义，且伴随约13倍计算成本。基于点估计与后验平均在判别力上的无差异表现，作者推断群体级参数平均无法有效区分左右手MI-EEG模式。论文建议未来将研究方向转向贝叶斯部分池化（多层次/层次模型），以跨被试和跨会话为分组结构进行建模，有望带来更大的预测性能提升。同时能耗分析表明贝叶斯ML在MI-EEG分类中仍是经济可行的。研究存在的局限包括未进行超参数优化，以及采用了二阶段荟萃分析而非直接对原始数据进行一层多层次模型拟合。

title: Finite-Time Analysis of the Natural Policy Gradient in Finite-Horizon Markov Decision Processes
comment: 33 pages, 3 figures (each with two subfigures), 1 table. Accepted at the Reinforcement Learning Conference (RLC 2026)
summary: Natural Policy Gradient (NPG) is a well-established Reinforcement Learning algorithm that underlies widely used methods such as Trust Region Policy Optimization and Proximal Policy Optimization, both of which have demonstrated strong empirical success. In this paper, we study exact NPG in finite-horizon Markov Decision Processes with known dynamics and horizon-dependent transition kernels. We provide the first finite-time convergence guarantees for this algorithm in this setting, for which we consider both constant and increasing step size regimes. With a constant step size $\eta_t=\eta$, we prove that NPG converges sublinearly with a rate of $\mathcal{O}(H^{2}/t)$ after $t$ iterations, where $H$ is the horizon length. We also extend this constant step size analysis to linear MDPs in an exact population-projection oracle under a full support projection distribution, recovering the same sublinear rate as in the tabular setting. Furthermore, with increasing step sizes, we prove that this algorithm achieves a linear convergence rate of $\mathcal{O}\left(\left(1-\frac{1}{\vartheta_\rho}\right)^t\right)$ for a problem-dependent constant $\vartheta_\rho > 1$, and the horizon-only robust schedule of the form $\eta_t=\eta_0(H/(H-1))^t$ where $\eta_0>0$ and $H \geq 2$, attains this same geometric rate.

AI.tldr: 本文针对有限时域马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中具有已知动力学和时变转移核的精确自然策略梯度（NPG）算法，首次给出了有限时间的收敛性理论保证，分别在常步长与递增步长两种调度下证明了次线性和线性（几何）收敛率，并将结果推广至线性 MDP 设定。
AI.motivation: NPG 是强化学习中广泛使用的基础算法（如 TRPO、PPO 的核心思想均源于此），但其在有限时域、动力学已知且转移核随时间步变化的设定下的有限时间收敛性长期缺乏理论刻画。已有分析多集中于无限时域折扣情形或随机近似设定，对于实际部署中常见的有限视界精确 NPG 缺乏严格的收敛保证，亟需填补这一理论与实践之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 论文在有限时域 MDP（horizon H，转移核可随阶段变化、动力学已知）设定下，对精确 NPG 进行收敛性分析：(1) 在常步长 η_t = η 调度下，分析迭代 t 次后的次线性收敛行为；(2) 将分析扩展到线性 MDP，借助精确总体投影 oracle（population-projection oracle）与全支撑投影分布完成收敛证明；(3) 在递增步长调度下，分析几何收敛率，并给出仅依赖时域 H 的鲁棒步长方案 η_t = η_0(H/(H−1))^t（适用于 H ≥ 2）。
AI.result: (1) 常步长下，NPG 在 t 次迭代后达到次线性收敛率 O(H²/t)，收敛速度依赖于时域长度 H；(2) 在线性 MDP 的精确总体投影 oracle 与全支撑投影分布假设下，恢复与表格 MDP 相同的次线性收敛率 O(H²/t)；(3) 递增步长下，NPG 取得线性（几何）收敛率 O((1 − 1/ϑ_ρ)^t)，其中 ϑ_ρ > 1 为问题相关常数；(4) 给出仅依赖 H 的稳健步长方案 η_t = η_0(H/(H−1))^t，可达到相同的几何收敛率，无需事先估计问题参数 ϑ_ρ。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了精确 NPG 在有限时域 MDP（已知动力学、时变转移核）设定下的有限时间收敛性分析空白，证明了常步长下的次线性收敛 O(H²/t) 与递增步长下的几何收敛 O((1−1/ϑ_ρ)^t)，并将表格情形的结论推广至线性 MDP，同时提供了不依赖问题先验的鲁棒步长调度方案，为 NPG 类算法（含 TRPO、PPO）的理论理解提供了新的有限时域分析框架。

title: Recycling computational processes of dynamic programming for combinatorial optimization problems: a reservoir computing approach
summary: Reusing previously computed results is a long-standing principle for reducing computational cost, but such reuse has largely been confined to a single problem's computation. Sharing computational processes across multiple simultaneously solved problems remains possible in principle, yet designing algorithms that exploit nontrivial cross-task relationships is difficult to do manually. Here, we use machine learning to discover such algorithms automatically. Specifically, based on reservoir computing, we propose a method that uses computation results recorded by dynamic programming for combinatorial optimization problems as features for linear regression, leveraging them to assist other combinatorial optimization computations. We validate the approach on the traveling salesman and subset sum problems. Multiplexing the dynamic programming process improves approximation accuracy over generic features and reduces computation time compared with independent solutions. These results suggest a new form of computation, distinct from conventional computational design, in which multiple processes efficiently share and recycle intermediate results and states.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于储层计算（reservoir computing）的方法，将一个组合优化问题的动态规划（DP）过程作为"储层"，将其DP表作为线性回归的特征来同时求解另一个组合优化问题，实现计算过程在不同问题间的复用与回收。
AI.motivation: 传统的计算复用（如查表、记忆化、动态规划）主要局限于单一问题内部的中间结果共享，而跨问题同时求解时如何共享计算过程难以手动设计。随着摩尔定律放缓，计算资源有限性问题日益突出，需要探索一种能够使多个计算过程有机共享和回收中间结果的新型计算范式。储层计算利用固定动力系统作为非线性特征映射的成功经验启发作者将其思想扩展到算法领域。
AI.method: 1. **核心框架**：选定问题A用DP求解，将其大小为M的DP表 DP(u) = (dp₁(u), ..., dp_M(u)) 作为储层特征向量；通过附加常数1构成增广特征向量 φ(u)。2. **线性读出层**：唯一的可训练参数为权重向量 W，通过岭回归（带L2正则化的最小二乘）训练，输出 ŷ = Wᵀφ(u)，用于近似问题B的目标函数。3. **解的构造**：将目标问题也表述为DP形式，将DP定义的值函数分解为多个函数近似问题 g₁, ..., g_L，每个独立学习，在构造解时按序贪婪生成决策变量。4. **实验验证**：分别在旅行商问题（TSP）和子集和问题（SSP）上验证——TSP中用MAXTSP的DP表作为储层来近似MINTSP；SSP中用公共子问题DECSSP的DP表作为储层同时近似MAXSSP和MINSSP。基线方法包括：原始输入线性回归（INPUT）、极限学习机（ELM）、下一代储层计算（NG-RC）、以及TSP专用方法（√NA、std_RT、最小权匹配MATCHING）和启发式算法（NN、Christofides、Farthest Insertion）。
AI.result: **TSP实验**（n=10）：所提MAXTSP方法预测MINTSP最优值的平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE）为1.61%，达到最优性能，达到NG-RC-DIST相似性能所需特征数仅为其约1/10。MATCHING作为另一种DP储层，性能也优于通用特征但不如MAXTSP储层。**解的构造**（n=14）：MAXTSP方法的路径超出最优解的比例仅为1.03%，优于所有TSP专用启发式算法（NN: 14.3%, CHRIS: 18.8%, INSERT: 1.28%），且计算速度约为独立运行MINTSP DP的9倍。在TSPLIB的burma14实例上（分布外数据）实现了0误差，泛化性能优异。**SSP实验**（U=D=10）：DECSSP储层方法在MAXSSP和MINSSP上的Kappa均最高，性能优于使用10倍以上特征的通用基线。解的构造中，MAXSSP准确率91.8%、MINSSP准确率99.5%，同时计算时间比独立DP方案更短。
AI.conclusion: DP表不仅是求解特定问题的副产品，更是一种可复用的计算资源：通过轻量级的线性读出层，可以将其重新用于解决共享同一输入的其他问题。MAXTSP与MINTSP之间表面上是相反目标但DP过程包含有用信息的发现表明，问题与算法之间的关系本身值得作为研究对象。这种方法可扩展到任何暴露中间计算过程的算法（非仅DP）和更复杂的读出层（非仅线性回归）。该研究奠定了一种新的计算范式基础——多个计算过程有机共享和回收中间结果与状态，类似生物大脑灵活复用神经资源跨任务的方式，有望提高计算资源利用效率。局限性：所提方法对算法与目标问题的组合有要求，二者必须在实质上相关，因为读出层保持轻量化使得目标问题的大部分计算需由原算法承载。

title: Mini-batch Noise Lowers Sharpness via Dominant-Subspace Fluctuations
summary: During SGD training, the gradients often align strongly with the dominant subspace spanned by the top-$k$ eigenvectors of the Hessian of the loss. While this seems to naturally imply that loss reduction mainly occurs within this space, prior work has shown that updates within this dominant subspace make no meaningful progress in reducing the loss. In this work, we argue that the dominant subspace is better understood not as the main space for loss reduction, but as a key subspace for explaining the sharpness dynamics of mini-batch SGD. To explain the role of the dominant subspace in reducing top-$k$ sharpness, we show how the averaged gradient over fluctuations in the dominant directions produces a sharpness correction term, and derive a sharpness correction term induced by mini-batch noise in the dominant directions. Experimental results show that adding the derived correction term to GD brings the sharpness evolution of GD closer to that of SGD.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了小批量SGD中主成分子空间（top-k Hessian特征向量张成的子空间）的真正作用并非损失下降，而是降低top-k sharpness（曲率）。通过Taylor展开和局部递归，推导出由主成分方向上的小批量噪声诱导的"sharpness修正项"，并验证将其加入全批量GD后可使sharpness演化曲线逼近小批量SGD。
AI.motivation: 已有观察指出SGD训练梯度强烈对齐Hessian的主成分子空间，但将SGD更新仅投影到主成分子空间（Dom-SGD）却几乎无法降低损失（Song et al., 2025）。这引出一个矛盾：既然梯度主要在主成分子空间，为何损失下降却发生在bulk子空间？此前工作未能解释主成分子空间在训练中的确切角色，本文聚焦于一个未被充分研究的现象——主成分子空间与top-k sharpness降低之间的关系。
AI.method:
1. **控制扰动实验**：在GD更新上加入主成分子空间或随机子空间的零均值扰动（保持均值等于GD），对比对S_k和损失的影响，发现仅主成分方向上的随机运动可降低sharpness而不影响损失。
2. **Sharpness修正项推导**：对参考点θ_c附近的均值为零的位移δ做Taylor展开并取期望，得到
   E[∇L(θ_c+δ)] = ∇L(θ_c) + ½∇Tr(H(θ_c)C)
   其中C = E[δδ⊤]为位移协方差。当C支撑在主成分子空间时，该项直接降低top-k sharpness。
3. **小批量诱导协方差**：定义局部递推δ_{s+1} = A_c δ_s − ηP_dom ξ_{B_s}，推导其平稳协方差C_mb满足离散Lyapunov方程
   C_mb = A_c C_mb A_c⊤ + η²Σ_dom
   并证明其封闭形式为几何级数。
4. **Corrected GD**：将修正项b_corr = −½∇_ϑ Tr(H(ϑ)C_mb)|_{ϑ=θ}加入GD更新，在MLP/CNN/Transformer三种架构上验证sharpness演化。
AI.result:
1. 在MLP（MNIST-5k）、CNN（CIFAR10-5k）、Transformer（SST2-1k）三种架构上，全批量GD的S_k显著高于小批量SGD，而加入推导的sharpness修正项的corrected GD其S_k曲线与SGD几乎重合。
2. 改变批量大小的实验显示：批量越大，SGD与GD的sharpness差距越小，corrected GD也呈现相同趋势。
3. 反转修正项方向后sharpness反而升高，证明sharpness降低确实依赖于修正项的方向而非其大小。
4. 所有情况下损失曲线几乎不受影响，说明该机制专属于sharpness调节而非损失下降。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了主成分子空间在小批量SGD中的真正角色是作为sharpness调节的通道而非损失下降的方向。核心贡献在于：（1）揭示了主成分方向上的随机波动会通过二阶Hessian变化项产生一个确定性sharpness修正项；（2）严格推导了小批量噪声通过局部递推产生的位移协方差C_mb的封闭形式；（3）通过corrected GD实验验证该修正项能解释SGD相对GD的大部分sharpness降低。该工作将主成分子空间的研究从"损失下降"视角转向"sharpness动力学"视角，与Edge of Stability理论中大步长GD振荡降低sharpness的机制形成互补，但揭示了小批量噪声是另一独立sharpness降低机制。

title: Online Policy Evaluation for MDPs with Dynamic UBSR Measures
summary: Developing efficient function-approximation methods for policy evaluation is a fundamental challenge in risk-aware reinforcement learning. Existing approaches either focus on restrictive classes of risk measures or rely on access to a simulator, limiting their applicability in fully online settings. In this work, we propose computationally efficient online learning algorithms for policy evaluation in Markov decision processes (MDPs) with dynamic utility-based shortfall risk (UBSR) measures under linear function approximation. Specifically, we introduce the UBSR-TD algorithm, establish conditions under which it converges almost surely, and develop several variants designed to accelerate convergence. Our formulation shows that existing policy evaluation algorithms for risk-neutral MDPs can be readily adapted to dynamic UBSR settings by incorporating a loss function into the temporal-difference error. Numerical experiments support our theoretical findings, and an application to a perishable inventory management problem with shelf-life uncertainty demonstrates the practical effectiveness of the proposed methods.

AI.tldr: 本文针对动态效用基损失风险(UBSR)度量下的MDP策略评估问题，提出了首个完全在线的线性函数近似算法UBSR-TD，并证明其几乎处处收敛性。同时提出了UBSR-TD(λ)和UBSR-Newton两种加速变体，并在易腐库存管理问题上验证了方法的实用性。
AI.motivation: 风险感知强化学习中，在动态风险度量下进行函数近似的策略评估是一个基础性挑战。现有方法要么局限于特定类别的风险度量（如ERM或一致性风险度量），要么依赖模拟器访问，无法应用于完全在线场景。特别是对于灵活且具有可推导性的UBSR风险度量，缺少具有收敛性保证的在线函数近似策略评估算法。
AI.method: 方法包括：(1) UBSR-TD算法：将损失函数ℓ融入TD误差，形成θ_{n+1} = θ_n + η_n φ(X_n)ℓ((γφ(X_{n+1})-φ(X_n))^T θ_n + c(X_n))的半梯度更新；(2) 理论分析：将算法表示为马尔可夫噪声下的随机逼近，利用Borkar et al.(2025)的框架证明在γ < ε₁/L₁条件下几乎处处收敛到投影风险感知Bellman算子的不动点；(3) 加速变体：UBSR-TD(λ)使用资格迹，UBSR-Newton利用二阶信息矩阵和Sherman-Morrison递推；(4) 核心洞见：将任意风险中性策略评估算法适配到动态UBSR框架，只需将损失函数作用于TD误差。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) 理论结果：UBSR-TD在适当条件下几乎处处收敛到θ*，其中Φθ*是投影风险感知Bellman算子ΠH的唯一不动点，并提供∥Φθ*-V∥_q ≤ (1/(1-ᾱ))∥ΠV-V∥_q的误差界；(2) 数值验证：在随机MDP上验证了收敛性，UBSR-Newton通常比UBSR-TD更快收敛；(3) 实际应用：在易腐库存管理问题中(m=3,5,8)，UBSR-TD和UBSR-Newton策略迭代的最优性差距低于0.2%-2.16%，显著优于静态(s,S)策略(最高512.31%差距)、短视策略和风险中性基准。UBSR-TD和UBSR-Newton完成60,000次迭代约需200秒，相比精确值迭代在m=8时超过10小时有巨大效率提升。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了首个动态UBSR度量下MDP的完全在线线性函数近似策略评估算法UBSR-TD，证明了其几乎处处收敛性，并引入两种加速变体。理论框架揭示了将风险中性策略评估算法适配到动态UBSR的一般原则。在易腐库存管理中的应用证明了风险感知决策的实际价值。未来研究方向包括非线性函数近似（如神经网络）、放松折扣因子的理论限制，以及为所提算法变体提供理论分析。

title: The Entropic Bound for Transformers: Why Static Rank Fails and Attention-Native Rank Recovers
comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Code and reproduction scripts included as supplementary material
summary: Neural scaling laws describe how loss decreases as models, data, and compute grow, but they do not answer a prior question: for a fixed task, what is the minimum model capacity required to solve it? We study this through the Entropic Bound, a spectral notion of task-intrinsic capacity for Transformers. We first prove that, in a linear attention surrogate, the intrinsic rank $r^*$ of the token-mixing operator is a tight lower bound: any rank-deficient model incurs unavoidable excess risk, and the bound is achievable at $r^*$. We further show that gradient descent recovers this rank under standard low-rank implicit-bias assumptions, confirm all three properties empirically, and show $r^*$ is recoverable from data before training. We then ask whether this transfers to real attention. A naive transfer fails, and a controlled interpolation ladder localizes the cause precisely: it is not softmax and not a rank constraint, but the input-conditioned nature of attention's mixing operator, which a static weight kernel cannot summarize. Motivated by this, we introduce an attention-native intrinsic rank -- the minimum query-key kernel rank realizing the task within the attention class -- and show that under this definition the full Entropic Bound structure (deficiency, achievability, recovery) is restored for both linear and softmax attention, with the energy effective rank as the estimator robust to softmax distortion. Finally, we map the boundary of data-only predictability: $r^*$ is exactly recoverable for linear QK attention, even without the value map at scale, while softmax attention admits only partial pre-training recovery due to nonlinear inversion and kernel-value identifiability effects. Our results reframe the Entropic Bound from a post-hoc descriptor into an attention-native capacity measure with a precisely characterized predictability frontier.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Transformer的任务内在容量下限（Entropic Bound），证明在线性注意力代理中token混合算子的内在秩r*是紧致下界，并将其重新定义为"注意力原生内在秩"（attention-native intrinsic rank），从而在真实注意力机制（包括softmax）中恢复了该容量下界的完整结构（必要性、充分性、可恢复性），同时精确刻画了仅从数据预测r*的可预测性边界。
AI.motivation: 神经缩放定律描述了损失随模型/数据/计算规模下降的轨迹，但未回答一个更根本的问题：对于固定任务，达到目标误差所需的最小模型容量是多少？现有研究缺乏架构无关的"任务内在有效维度"概念，且静态核秩度量在注意力机制中失效，因此需要建立一个紧致、可预测且对注意力原生有效的容量下界。
AI.method: 1. 在线性注意力代理（Y=A*XV*+E）中定义内在秩r*为达到噪声地板的token混合算子最小秩，并证明四组定理（缺陷→超额风险、可达性、紧致性、GD收敛）。2. 构建"插值阶梯"B0→B1→B1c→B2→B3，逐步引入QK分解、softmax、完整block来定位失效环节。3. 在注意力类内部重新定义r*_attn为实现任务的最小QK核秩，教师任务从同一类生成。4. 使用能量有效秩R̃_eff作为softmax鲁棒估计量。5. 在六种真实语料（English、Shakespeare、Python等）上做负向诊断验证。
AI.result: 1. 线性代理中r*=3时呈现锐利相变：r<r*时超额风险显著（r=1时28.5，r=2时8.8），r≥r*时降至噪声地板（≈2×10⁻⁴），MP校正后R_eff=2.97→r*。2. 插值阶梯定位失效点为B1（QK分解），B1c控制组（满秩K）同样失败，排除秩约束解释。3. 注意力原生定义下，T=16/d=32、r*∈{1,2,3,4,6,8}、5种种子下，线性和softmax教师均完整恢复三项结构（缺陷/可达/恢复），CV_seed≤0.003。4. 数据可预测性：线性QK可精确恢复（含V未知设置），softmax仅部分可预测（数值秩饱和17-23，能量秩在两端有偏）。5. 真实语料实验显示预测秩与测量秩呈反相关（r=-0.272），测量秩实际跟踪优化进度而非任务复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 本文将Entropic Bound从一个事后描述符重新定位为注意力原生的容量度量。在固定算子代理中紧致且完全可数据预测；真实注意力的失效被精确定位于输入条件化混合（而非softmax或秩约束）；通过在注意力类内部定义内在秩，完整结构对线性和softmax注意力均恢复，但softmax下仅存在部分预训练可预测性。核心开放问题包括：寻找对所有秩统一的softmax鲁棒预训练估计量、将合成结果桥接到自然语言、以及在训练语言模型上刻画已实现算子有效秩的任务不变性。

title: Self-Boosting Vision-Language Models with Noisy Student On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: Post-training enables vision-language models (VLMs) to understand human instructions and perform various downstream tasks. Current post-training methods usually rely on human-annotated data, distillation from external models, reinforcement learning with human feedback, or verifiable answers. This limits their ability to improve without external supervision. To tackle this, we propose NOPD (Noisy Student On-Policy Self-Distillation), a simple yet effective self-distillation approach that improves VLMs without any external models or ground-truth answers. Our key insight is that prediction discrepancies between clean and corrupted inputs naturally induce a self-supervision signal. In NOPD, the model learns from corrupted inputs while using its own predictions under clean inputs as token-level supervision. We show the effectiveness of NOPD on five visual reasoning tasks; it can match and even outperform reinforcement learning approaches or distillation from external models. Notably, when trained with 2.1K samples from Geometry3K, NOPD improves Qwen2.5-VL-7B by 20 points on its validation set. It also shows generalization on out-of-distribution test sets and achieves 7.4 point gains on MathVista. Furthermore, we demonstrate that NOPD is a general approach to enhance VLMs, achieving improvements across three models on 12 benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NOPD（Noisy Student On-Policy Self-Distillation），一种无需任何外部模型或真实标签的自蒸馏方法，通过让模型在干净输入上的预测作为教师信号、指导其在扰动输入（加噪、下采样、Gamma变换）上的学习，实现视觉语言模型（VLM）的自我提升。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM后训练方法（监督微调、RLVR、知识蒸馏）均依赖人工标注、外部教师模型或可验证答案，限制了模型在不借助外部监督时的自我改进能力。本文旨在探索VLM能否完全依靠自身、通过"自举"方式实现性能提升。
AI.method: 核心思想是利用"非对称输入分布"诱导自监督信号：同一模型π_θ在干净输入(q,x)上的输出作为教师，在扰动图像T(x)+查询q上的输出作为学生，最小化反向KL散度 D_KL(π_θ(y|q,T(x)) ‖ sg[π_θ(y|q,x)])，并对教师分支使用stop-gradient。图像扰动方式包括高斯加噪（σ∈{0.08,...,0.38}）、低分辨率下采样（×2/×4）和Gamma变换（γ~U[0.5,2]）。文中将NOPD梯度解释为"对比策略梯度"——对数比项 log[π_θ(y|q,T(x))/π_θ(y|q,x)] 作为对比奖励。
AI.result: 在5个视觉推理基准上，NOPD可匹配甚至超越RLVR和OPD等依赖外部监督的方法。在Geometry3K的2.1K样本训练后，Qwen2.5-VL-7B在验证集上提升20分、MathVista提升7.4分。同时实现"隐式推理压缩"——MathVista上输出token减少57.9%而准确率提升4.3%。在3个模型（Qwen2.5-VL-7B、Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking、GLM-4.6V-Flash）12个基准（覆盖通用VQA、推理、图表理解）上均取得稳定提升，Qwen2.5-VL-7B在所有基准上均获提升。消融实验验证了反向KL、教师-学生同步更新、全词表计算的重要性，并证明性能增益不来自rollout多样性。
AI.conclusion: NOPD是一种简单有效的VLM自训练方法，无需任何外部监督（教师模型、可验证答案或推理轨迹）即可在多模型、多任务上获得稳定提升。其核心洞察是：让模型在困难/扰动环境下学习，干净输入下的自身输出即可提供密集的token级监督信号。这一方法为VLM的自我改进提供了新范式，但目前局限在于依赖视觉数据增强，仅适用于VLM场景。

title: Diffusion-Guided Search via Exponential Tilting (DiffTilt): An Application to Falsification of Safety-Critical Systems
summary: Discovering rare safety-critical failures in autonomous and cyber-physical systems is a fundamental challenge in verification and validation. Existing falsification approaches rely on conditional sampling strategies that factor the joint distribution over environments and system executions, and therefore suffer from multiplicative rarity effects: the simultaneous scarcity of failure-inducing inputs and failure-inducing traces makes exhaustive search prohibitively expensive. This paper develops DiffTilt, a distributional framework that exponentially tilts a diffusion model-induced joint distribution over environments and executions. We show that diffusion-guided sampling admits an exact interpretation as importance sampling in the joint space, where guidance scores induce a KL-optimal reallocation of probability mass towards failure-relevant behaviors. We further show that tilting provably amplifies failure probability and strictly outperforms conditional sampling, which is limited by multiplicative rarity. In this framework, the joint generative model serves as a reusable prior over scenarios and need not faithfully represent the system under test. Expensive system simulations are instead limited to learning a scoring function that characterizes scenario quality, enabling their selective and adaptive use. We study DiffTilt on ARCH-COMP benchmarks, and we propose an additional tractor-trailer benchmark showing the behavior of several approaches when scenario generation is guided by a well-defined specification rather than a reward. The proposed method achieves competitive or improved falsification performance compared to state-of-the-art approaches, with larger gains when specification definition is not limited to STL formulas.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DiffTilt框架,将自动驾驶与信息物理系统中的安全关键故障发现(伪证,Falsification)重新建模为对扩散模型所诱导的"环境-执行"联合分布的指数倾斜(Exponential Tilting)。理论证明该倾斜在KL意义下最优,且当打分函数对失败场景的排序满足一阶随机支配(FOSD)时,失败概率严格增大并克服条件采样的乘法稀有性瓶颈。在ARCH-COMP和新增的Tractor-Trailer基准上,单次训练的联合先验在多个STL规约下实现了与最先进方法FReaK相当或更优的性能,且在非STL、轨迹级目标和长时域嵌套规约下优势显著。
AI.motivation: 在自动驾驶与复杂信息物理系统的验证中,稀有安全故障的发现是一个根本性挑战。现有伪证方法普遍采用条件采样策略,即先从提议分布 q(x) 抽取输入,再基于条件模型 p_θ(y|x) 生成执行轨迹,从而将联合分布分解。由于需要同时抽到稀有输入(概率 δ≪1)和稀有执行轨迹(概率 ε≪1),失败概率为乘积形式 p(F)=δε,即便条件模型完美无缺,所需样本数仍为 Ω((δε)⁻¹),呈现出"乘法稀有性"瓶颈。同时,传统的稀有事件重要性采样方法依赖理想参考分布或显式似然,在复杂系统测试中难以获得。扩散模型虽能学习高维联合分布,但其引导采样与重要性采样之间的精确联系此前未被严格建立,亟需一个理论基础扎实、可与黑箱仿真对接的解决方案。
AI.method: DiffTilt将伪证任务形式化为对扩散先验 p_θ(x,y) 关于打分函数 S(x,y) 的指数倾斜: p_β(x,y) ∝ p_θ(x,y)·exp(βS(x,y))。核心方法包含: (1)离线训练一个基于JointNet架构的耦合扩散模型(双UNet分支,交叉条件化),学习输入 x 与轨迹 y 的联合分布作为可复用的先验;(2)在线阶段,通过反向扩散过程中加入 surrogate 引导梯度 ∇S_k,在噪声预测层面等价于施加 β_k 的指数倾斜;(3)从倾斜分布中生成 M 个候选场景,按打分加权抽样后仅将 x 送入黑箱仿真器,得到真实轨迹 Φ(x) 并计算真实鲁棒性 R;(4)将仿真数据累积到历史集合 H,持续训练 surrogate 网络 S_k。理论层面,论文证明: ① 倾斜分布是满足期望打分约束下 KL(q∥p_θ) 最小化的唯一解(命题2);② 倾斜提高失败概率当且仅当打分的矩生成函数满足 M_F(β)>M_F̄(β)(命题3);③ 在一阶随机支配假设下,失败概率被严格放大(定理1);④ 在确定性系统中,联合倾斜退化为沿动力学流形的输入空间最优重要性采样(命题4);⑤ 条件采样受限于乘法稀有性而无法将失败概率推到1,而联合倾斜可以(推论2)。该方法的优势在于生成模型与被测系统解耦——先验不必准确代表真实系统,只需提供合理的轨迹基底,昂贵的仿真仅用于训练打分函数。
AI.result: 在三个基准测试集上评估: (1) **Automatic Transmission (AT)**:DiffTilt在AT1(光滑输入插值难)、AT51/AT54(离散齿轮信号导致鲁棒性梯度平坦)等规约上不如FReaK,但在其他规约(AT2、AT52、AT53、AT6a/b/c/abc)上达到10/10的伪证率,在4000点训练下所需仿真数与FReaK相当。 (2) **Chasing Cars (CC)**:在CCx上DiffTilt以10-18次仿真达成10/10,远优于FReaK的110.5次;在长时域嵌套规约(CC4、CC5)中同样具备仿真效率优势,因为不依赖STL的逻辑编码。 (3) **Tractor-Trailer (TT2D,本文新增基准)**:六个场景中DiffTilt在4000点训练下全部达到10/10,而FReaK在S1、S2、S3、S6上仅达到1/10、0/10、3/10、1/10。核心原因是TT2D可使用轨迹级目标代价 R(x,y) 作为引导信号,而FReaK受限于STL公式表达;但在受可行域几何约束的Wide/Narrow Parking(S4/S5)上两者表现相近,FReaK运行更快。整体上,DiffTilt表现出两个关键优势: ① 单一联合先验可跨多个规约复用,无需逐规约重新优化;② 引导信号不限于STL,接受鲁棒性、奖励、专家定义代价等任意可微函数,适用面更广。
AI.conclusion: DiffTilt将伪证问题建立在坚实的概率论基础之上——指数倾斜的KL最优性、重要性采样的精确解释、一阶随机支配下的失败放大保证,以及在确定性系统上向输入空间重要性采样的归约。理论结果克服了条件采样的乘法稀有性瓶颈,且无需生成模型忠实表示被测系统。实证表明,一个跨规约复用的联合扩散先验在ARCH-COMP上具备竞争力,在长时域、非STL目标场景中显著优于FReaK,验证了"分布感知+评分引导"的实用价值。未来工作方向包括: ① 倾斜强度 β 的自适应调度(目前为粗略网格搜索);② 模型失配修正——利用预测轨迹与真实仿真轨迹 Φ(x) 的差距在线回流校正;③ 离散/混合动态下的 surrogate 设计(以解决AT5齿轮规约中梯度消失问题);④ 更快采样器(DDIM等)与更高效的联合架构;⑤ 向随机系统、规划、合成与机器人领域的理论扩展与实际应用。

title: Foundation Models and Fine-Tuning: Toward a New Generation of Models for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Inspired by recent breakthroughs in large language models for natural language processing, foundation models have emerged as a promising paradigm for zero-shot time series forecasting, enabling accurate predictions on datasets never seen during pre-training. Ranging from tens to hundreds of millions of parameters, these models are pre-trained on vast and diverse collections of time series, learning generalizable representations that support both point and probabilistic forecasting. This approach alleviates the need for dataset-specific model design and manual tuning, offering a unified solution across forecasting problems. In this work, we review the main architectures, pre-training strategies, and optimization methods underpinning these models. We further investigate post-pre-training fine-tuning of selected foundation models to enhance their performance on specific datasets. Our empirical results demonstrate that this step consistently improves forecasting accuracy over the zero-shot baseline.

AI.tldr: 该论文综述了时间序列预测的基础模型（Foundation Models），系统梳理了主流架构、预训练策略和优化方法，并通过大规模实验研究了预训练后微调（fine-tuning）对模型性能的影响。实验表明，在多数配置下微调能持续提升零样本（zero-shot）预测的准确性。
AI.motivation: 受大型语言模型成功的启发，时间序列领域出现了基础模型这一新范式，可在未见过训练的数据集上进行零样本预测。然而，预训练后针对特定数据集进行微调这一维度在文献中尚未得到充分探索。作者旨在填补这一空白，系统研究微调策略对时间序列基础模型性能的影响。
AI.method: 论文首先回顾了Chronos、Chronos 2、TimesFM、Moirai、Moirai 2.0、Toto、TiRex、TTM-R3-PT、Timer-S1等代表性基础模型，从架构（Transformer、扩展LSTM、MLP-Mixer）、预训练（语料库、损失函数）和适应策略（全量微调FFT、数据高效微调、参数高效微调LoRA）三个维度进行分类分析。实验部分采用GIFT-Eval基准中的15个单变量和8个多变量数据集（共144,000条时间序列、1.77亿观测值），对Chronos 2和TTM-R3-PT两种公开模型进行零样本、全量微调、LoRA全样本和LoRA少样本（20%数据）四种策略的对比，使用归一化MAPE和MWQL（加权分位数损失）指标，按数据集规模、领域和预测 horizon 三个维度进行分析。
AI.result: 主要发现：（1）微调总体上是有益的——Chronos 2在15个配置中仅5个零样本更优，TTM-R3-PT仅4个更优；（2）微调并非在所有情况下都有益——在小数据集及Nature、Energy等领域，零样本可能优于所有微调策略（特别是Chronos 2）；（3）最佳适应策略取决于模型规模——LoRA-FullShot最适合Chronos 2（120M参数），FFT更适合TTM（1M–36M参数）；（4）LoRA-FewShot在特定场景下具有竞争力，但在数据充足时通常不及LoRA-FullShot；（5）FFT对Chronos 2不稳定，在多数设置下反而降低性能，突显了在大模型上全量更新的过拟合风险。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明了对时间序列基础模型进行预训练后微调能够在多数配置下持续提升预测性能，但最佳策略高度依赖于模型规模和目标数据集特性。文章指出该领域仍面临数据稀缺和理论理解不足等挑战，呼吁未来开展更深入的研究。

title: XGRVFL-MV: Residual-Coupled Graph-Embedded Multi-View Random Vector Functional Link Network with FleXi Guardian Loss
summary: Random Vector Functional Link (RVFL) networks provide an efficient randomized learning framework for classification. Existing multi-view RVFL methods utilize complementary information from multiple views. However, preserving view-specific geometric structure, limiting the influence of large prediction residuals, and modeling relationships between multiple views remain challenging. This paper proposes a Residual-Coupled Graph-Embedded Multi-View RVFL model with fleXi guardian loss (XGRVFL-MV) for multi-view classification. The proposed model constructs RVFL representation for each view, incorporates graph embedding with intrinsic and penalty graphs constructed using the Local Fisher Discriminant Analysis weighting scheme. It also uses the bounded and asymmetric FleXi Guardian (XG) loss for residual learning. A residual-coupling term is introduced to encourage consistency among view-specific prediction residuals while preserving view-specific representations. The resulting optimization problem is solved using an inversion-free first-order optimization procedure based on Nesterov accelerated gradient descent. We evaluate the proposed model on UCI, KEEL, AwA, and Corel5k benchmark datasets. Experimental results, together with statistical analyses and hyperparameter sensitivity analyses, show that XGRVFL-MV achieves competitive classification performance compared with the baseline methods across the evaluated benchmark datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为XGRVFL-MV的多视图分类模型，将随机向量功能链接网络（RVFL）与图嵌入、FleXi Guardian（XG）有界非对称损失以及残差耦合机制统一在一个优化框架中。该方法在UCI、KEEL、AwA和Corel5k基准数据集上取得了竞争性的分类性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的多视图RVFL方法存在三个主要挑战：(1)难以保留各视图特有的几何结构信息；(2) L2损失对大预测残差敏感，易受噪声和异常值影响；(3)现有图嵌入多视图RVFL方法通过残差内积耦合视图，未能显式建模视图间预测残差的一致性。作者旨在通过统一框架同时解决几何结构保留、鲁棒残差学习、跨视图残差一致性建模和无求逆优化等问题。
AI.method: 方法包括四个核心组件：(1)为每个视图构建RVFL表示（直接连接输入层与输出层+随机隐藏层特征）；(2)采用基于局部Fisher判别分析（LFDA）加权方案构建内在图和惩罚图，通过图正则化保留各视图的局部几何结构；(3)使用有界非对称的FleXi Guardian（XG）损失替代L2损失，通过参数a控制非对称性、参数η控制上界，限制大残差的影响；(4)引入残差耦合项(ρ/2)||ξ⁽¹⁾-ξ⁽²⁾||²，惩罚视图间预测残差的差异，鼓励一致性。整体目标函数包含权重正则化、XG损失、图正则化和残差耦合四项，采用基于Nesterov加速梯度下降的无求逆一阶优化方法求解，避免矩阵求逆。
AI.result: 在UCI和KEEL的18个数据集上，XGRVFL-MV的平均AUC为79.530%，平均秩为2.22，均为最优。在AwA数据集（21个分类任务）上，平均AUC为82.680%，平均秩为1.95，优于GRVFL-MV（81.380%/2.24）等基线。在Corel5k数据集（12个分类任务）上，平均AUC为80.555%，平均秩为2.33，同样为最优。Friedman检验（χ²=38.92, F=7.5986）和Wilcoxon符号秩检验显示XGRVFL-MV显著优于RVFLWoDL1/2、RVFL1/2和MvRVFL（p<0.001），但与MV-LDM和GRVFL-MV差异不显著。Win-Tie-Loss分析显示对各基线胜场数均超过损失数。超参数敏感度分析表明ρ和e的影响因数据集而异，需针对特定数据集进行调优。
AI.conclusion: XGRVFL-MV成功地将图嵌入、FleXi Guardian损失和残差耦合机制整合到统一的多视图RVFL框架中，在多个基准数据集上取得了具有竞争力的分类性能，统计检验验证了其相对于大多数基线方法的显著优势。然而，其与MV-LDM和GRVFL-MV的差异在统计上不显著，表明该方法在某些场景下仍有改进空间。未来工作将探索替代图构建策略、其他鲁棒损失函数（如pinball分位数损失）以及向多分类任务的扩展。

title: Wrong Design Intent Is Worse Than None: A Derangement-Control Diagnosis of Header Conditioning in CAD Program Completion
summary: Fine-tuned code LLMs can be conditioned on a lightweight design-intent header to steer parametric CAD generation, but whether the model actually reads the header's content has not been tested under a metric independent of the conditioning itself, nor with a causal control. We study CADCON, a five-feature design-intent header prepended to CadQuery-style sketch-extrude programs during LoRA fine-tuning of Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B, re-scored by executable geometric assertions on the produced B-rep solid, sharing no code with the header-defining regex extractor. Across three seeds and a pre-registered {0%, 40%}-prefix $\times$ {correct, wrong, masked}-header matrix we find: (i) in conditional completion (40% prefix), a semantically wrong header degrades adherence below the no-header baseline (0.43 $\to$ 0.30/0.21 text/token) on design intents the model can render unconditioned -- polygonal and thin geometries; circle and tall intents sit at a baseline generation floor for this checkpoint ($\approx$0 in both compared arms) and are uninformative for this contrast; (ii) a derangement control -- retrained with shuffled ground-truth headers, identical header marginal but destroyed content correlation -- remains competent yet is immune to wrong headers, while the standard model is not (text headers; interaction significant on 3/3 seeds, p $\leq$ $4.2\times10^{-3}$): the harm requires the learned header$\to$program mapping, excluding the marginal/mechanical distribution-shift confound; (iii) the independent metric deflates the apparent benefit of a correct header (token: +0.21 regex $\to$ +0.02 geometry), quantifying metric circularity; (iv) the harm is regime-specific -- at 0% prefix the unconditioned baseline cannot generate valid CAD at all. Wrong intent is not noise: it actively misdirects generation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对参数化CAD程序生成中的"设计意图头"(design-intent header)条件化机制,提出两项诊断工具——独立的几何执行度量与"错位训练"(derangement)因果对照——首次在结构化几何生成中以因果受控方式隔离出"错误条件比无条件更糟"的现象。结果表明:错误头在条件补全(40%前缀)下使几何合规度跌至无头基线之下(0.425→0.305/0.215),该损害需经学习的头→程序映射才成立;同时,正确头的收益被正则度量夸大了约一个数量级(token:+0.21→+0.02)。
AI.motivation: 现有条件化CAD生成工作仅测试"条件是否存在"或"条件有多好",从未考察条件内容错误时的后果;同时也未区分损害源于内容误读还是分布偏移的机械效应,更未评估条件收益是否受度量自指性(metric circularity)虚报。部署风险在于:依赖条件场的模型在条件缺失或错误时会沉默失败或被主动误导。
AI.method: 以DeepCAD数据转译为CadQuery风格程序,在Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B上以QLoRA微调,将五维设计意图头(CIRCLE/NGON/THIN/TALL/MULTI_PART)前置。关键方法论:(1)度量独立——合规度由B-rep实体的可执行几何断言评分,与训练端正则提取器无共享代码;(2)因果对照——训练对照模型R,其头-程序配对经"错位"洗牌(头边际分布与M完全相同,但头↔程序相关被破坏);(3)预注册——{0%,40%}前缀×{正确/错误/遮蔽}头矩阵,3种子,所有决策规则与分析脚本在评分前以SHA-256冻结。
AI.result: 四大结果:(i)在40%前缀条件补全下,语义错误的头使几何合规度降至无头基线之下(0.425→0.305文本/0.215 token),三种子与两种分词下方向一致,token侧显著(p≤8×10⁻⁴);该效应在可执行交集上仍成立,非有效性伪影。(ii)错位对照R虽保持能力(正确头合规度0.355-0.408),但对错误头免疫(Δ≈0),而M显著受损(Δ=0.18-0.29);逐样本交互检验在3/3种子上显著(p≤4.2×10⁻³),排除边际/机械分布偏移的混淆。(iii)独立度量将正确头的token侧收益从正则度量下的+0.21压缩至几何度量下的+0.02,定量化了度量自指性的虚报。(iv)效应仅存在于条件补全机制——0%前缀下无头基线无法生成有效CAD,对比无定义。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次在结构化几何程序生成中以因果受控方式定位"错误条件比无条件更糟"现象,并量化了条件收益的度量自指性放大。核心启示:经训练的条件场是"信任接口",一旦模型学会依赖,上游错误即被路由至生成过程而非被过滤;缓解须置于条件接口本身(训练时优雅退化至无条件行为),而非输入校验层。建议:建造者将条件场视为不可信输入并内置无条件回退;评估者在条件化声明中应回答三问——收益是否经执行级度量独立验证、错误信号是否比无信号更糟、损害是否依赖所学映射。该诊断对偶(独立度量+错位对照)可移植至任何条件信号可洗牌且合规度可独立评分的结构化生成场景。

title: Domain-Prior-Regularized Graph Modeling for Anomaly Detection in Cyber-Physical Systems
comment: 12 pages, ICML 2026 AI for Science Workshop
summary: Anomaly detection on multivariate sensor time series is critical for industrial monitoring of cyber-physical systems (CPS), where even subtle deviations from normal behavior can indicate process disruption. Recent graph-based approaches have made significant progress, but they often struggle in small-scale physical systems with scarce labeled anomalies and limited normal data. In such settings, graph-based models tend to capture spurious correlations and produce unstable sensor topologies. We propose DPR-GM (Domain-Prior-Regularized Graph Modeling), a forecasting-based framework that incorporates system design knowledge into graph construction. DPR-GM leverages a large language model (LLM) to extract directed physical couplings between sensor pairs from system documentation, which are encoded as a binary domain adjacency matrix serving as a structural gate over sensor relations. This gate is then modulated by Pearson correlations estimated from normal training data. The anomaly score is further weighted by sensor-level reliability derived from the coefficient of variation. All graph and weighting components are fixed prior to training and add no learnable parameters. On the SKAB benchmark, DPR-GM outperforms graph-based, statistical, and deep learning baselines across F1, AUROC, and AUPRC, showing that domain-structured graph priors are a practical alternative to fully learned topologies in data-scarce CPS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DPR-GM（Domain-Prior-Regularized Graph Modeling），一种面向数据稀缺的信息物理系统（CPS）的多变量传感器时序异常检测框架。其核心思想是利用大语言模型（LLM）从系统设计文档中自动提取传感器间的有向物理耦合，作为二元领域邻接矩阵对图结构进行结构性门控，再结合Pearson相关调制边权重与变异系数（CV）加权的传感器可靠性评分，实现无学习参数的图先验构建，在SKAB基准上严格逐点评估协议下全面优于图方法、统计方法和深度学习基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于图神经网络的CPS异常检测方法在小规模、数据稀缺的物理系统中面临两大问题：（1）端到端学习的传感器图会吸收虚假相关，导致拓扑不稳定；（2）仅依赖经验相关阈值构建的图会被与物理因果无关的瞬态共变所扰动。然而，CPS的系统设计文档本身就编码了传感器间的物理耦合、子系统归属和因果方向等结构化领域知识，这些先验在当前方法中完全未被利用。如何在数据稀缺场景下构建稳定、可解释且贴合物理因果的传感器图，成为亟待解决的核心问题。
AI.method: DPR-GM采用两阶段框架：(1) 领域先验图构建：使用Claude Sonnet 4.6大语言模型从系统设计文档中提取有向物理耦合（源传感器→目标传感器+物理机制），生成二元领域邻接矩阵D；再以正常训练数据上的Pearson相关系数ρ按公式 A_ij = D_ij·(0.5 + 0.5·ρ_ij) 对允许边的权重进行符号化调制（正相关→1，无关→0.5，负相关→0）。(2) 基于GNN的预测：共享GRU对各传感器通道独立编码，结合可学习传感器嵌入，通过GraphSAGE（默认）在领域先验图上进行消息传递，经k步预测头输出未来预测；异常评分采用变异系数CV_i = σ_i/(|μ_i|+ε)×100 推导的传感器可靠性权重w_i对IQR归一化预测误差进行加权聚合（均值+最大值混合，α=0.2）。所有图结构和可靠性权重在训练前固定，不引入任何可学习参数。
AI.result: 在SKAB基准（水泵测试台，N=8传感器，34个故障场景，37362时间步）严格逐点评估协议下：（1）图方法对比中，GDN与GReLeN因端到端图学习而崩溃（Prac-F1仅0.075/0.116，方差巨大），MTAD-GAT凭借近全召回获得Prac-F1=0.545但AUROC仅0.579（高阈值伪影）；DPR-GM取得最佳Prac-F1=0.556、AUROC=0.726、AUPRC=0.717、BF-F1=0.606，并在valve1/valve2子集上AUROC分别达0.832/0.862。（2）非图方法对比中，DPR-GM在所有指标上均优于T²+Q、T-squared、MSET、ISF、Conv-AE、Vanilla AE、LSTM、MSCRED等基线，MCC达0.213（比Vanilla AE提升+0.050）。（3）骨架消融证实GraphSAGE（边权重感知）最优且最稳定，GCN次之但方差大，GT接近而GAT显著落后。（4）组件消融证实移除符号相关边权重（Edge-W）或CV节点权重（Node-W）均导致性能下降，二者结合提供互补增益。
AI.conclusion: DPR-GM证明了在数据稀缺的CPS异常检测场景中，结构化的领域先验图（由LLM从系统文档自动提取并以二元门控+Pearson调制+CV可靠性加权构建）是完全数据驱动学习的拓扑结构的稳健替代方案。其无学习参数的图先验设计有效避免了有限正常数据下的过拟合问题，同时提供了可解释的物理因果结构。该方法为文档驱动的AI系统在科学时序建模中的广泛应用（包括气候、神经科学、交通、海事等领域）开辟了新方向，未来工作将通过跨LLM验证、提示鲁棒性分析、置信度感知边提取以及更多样化的CPS数据集评估进一步提升LLM先验提取质量。

title: Variance-Preserving Orthogonal Selection (VPOS): Greedy Feature Selection via Orthogonal Deflation in PCA Loading Space
summary: We propose Variance-Preserving Orthogonal Selection (VPOS), a greedy framework for unsupervised feature selection that operates in the weighted PCA loading space. After each selection, VPOS projects out the chosen feature's variance direction via null-space deflation, forcing subsequent selections to cover orthogonal parts of the covariance structure. Each step provably reduces the loading matrix rank by one, and the greedy objective connects to monotone submodular maximization. The single hyperparameter $d$ is selected via a reproducible rule: the value minimising reconstruction MSE in a sensitivity sweep. On eight benchmarks, VPOS achieves the lowest reconstruction MSE on all eight while running 10-140x faster than graph-based methods at scale. Comparing against PCA (no deflation) at matched $d$ confirms deflation as the primary driver, reducing MSE by 10-73%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VPOS（Variance-Preserving Orthogonal Selection），一种在加权PCA加载空间中通过零空间投影进行正交缩减的贪婪式无监督特征选择框架。该方法通过每步选择后投影消除已选特征的方差方向，迫使后续选择覆盖协方差结构的正交部分，从而解决多重共线性下传统静态排序方法陷入"聚类陷阱"（所选特征全部对应同一潜在因子）的问题。在8个基准数据集上均取得最低重建MSE，在大规模场景下比图基方法快10–140倍。
AI.motivation: 无监督特征选择面临结构性困难：当特征间存在强多重共线性时，基于独立评分（边际方差、Laplacian Score、谱评分）的top-k静态选择会使所选特征全部对应同一主导潜在因子，导致信息冗余并遗漏独立但方差较小的信号——即"聚类陷阱"。在基因表达、金融资产、生物标志物等领域，需要离散可解释的原始特征子集（而非稀疏线性组合），且现有图基方法（Laplacian Score、MCFS）在大规模数据集上计算成本高昂。
AI.method: 核心方法包含三个关键设计：(1) 定义加权加载嵌入 B = V_d · Λ_d^(1/2) 作为特征多样性度量的自然几何空间，其中每行的平方范数等于该特征对d维主子空间的方差贡献；(2) 提出加载空间零空间缩减算子 B^(t+1) = B^(t) · P_u^⊥，每次选择后消除已选特征方差方向，并证明每步严格降低B的秩1；(3) 目标函数为增量正交方差（IOV）最大化 i_t = arg max ‖b_j^(t)‖²，与单调子模最大化存在结构性联系。算法每次迭代选择当前范数最大的特征后施加Gram-Schmidt型正交投影。唯一超参数d通过在5–6个候选值上进行敏感度扫描、选取最小重建MSE的值来确定——该规则对d的选择具有可重复性。整体复杂度为O(D²N + D³ + kDd)，当d≪N时远低于样本空间CSSP。
AI.result: 在8个基准数据集（Wine、Breast Cancer、Digits、MNIST、CIFAR-10、Colon Cancer基因芯片、Multi-Sector合成、高维合成）上，VPOS在所有8个数据集上均取得最低重建MSE。在匹配d的PCA（无缩减）对比中，缩减机制使MSE降低10–73%。关键结果包括：Breast Cancer MSE 0.1911（次优0.2323）；MNIST kNN准确率87.8%（PCA无缩减仅81.2%），速度比Laplacian Score快140倍；CIFAR-10 MSE 0.1627（次优0.1742）；Colon Cancer MSE 0.2732，为最佳；在合成的Multi-Sector数据集中，VPOS是唯一覆盖全部3个潜在因子的方法（其他方法仅覆盖1–2个）。d的敏感度分析表明：过小导致压缩过度，过大则引入噪声主导的尾部成分，MNIST上d=238时kNN从90.3%骤降至34.3%。
AI.conclusion: VPOS将贪婪Gram-Schmidt选择与方差加权PCA表示统一为一个原则性的无监督特征选择流程。其核心设计——在压缩的d维加载空间中进行缩减并按λ_k^(1/2)加权——使特征选择既保留原始离散变量的可解释性，又实现正交的方差覆盖。最小MSE的d选择规则提供了对噪声主导成分的自动防护，是流程的必要组成部分。需注意VPOS优化的是方差覆盖（重建保真度），而非分类性能：当判别性结构占据与主导方差不同的子空间时（如Colon Cancer在d=20时kNN 71.0% vs d=15时82.1%；HighDim合成数据kNN 38.0% vs Laplacian Score 54.7%），两者可能背离。未来方向包括核化扩展处理非线性冗余、Ledoit-Wolf正则化协方差以适配小样本场景，以及在更大规模基因表达数据集和深度特征表示上的评估。

title: ParasGB: A Graph Benchmark Suite for Parasitic Estimation on AMS Circuits
comment: Published at ICCAD2026. Full appendix version
summary: As chip manufacturing processes advance to deep submicron nodes, parasitic interconnect effects increasingly dominate the performance of analog and mixed-signal (AMS) circuits and often lead to costly layout iterations. This makes early-stage estimation of parasitic capacitance and resistance important for parasitic-aware design exploration before full physical implementation. However, progress on GNN-based parasitic modeling has been hindered by the lack of public, high-fidelity RC benchmarks that support reproducible evaluation. To address this gap, we introduce ParasGB, the first open-source benchmark suite for pre-layout parasitic parameter prediction on circuit graphs. ParasGB provides large-scale, heterogeneous RC networks extracted with commercial EDA tools from tape-out-proven designs, together with a unified evaluation protocol covering node-level ground capacitance, edge-level resistance, and edge-level coupling capacitance. Within this framework, we benchmark diverse GNN architectures using a standardized training pipeline and expose challenges such as extreme label imbalance, long-tailed parasitic distributions, and strong structural heterogeneity. By establishing a physically grounded and standardized benchmark for early-stage parasitic prediction, ParasGB provides an open platform for reproducible research on circuit graph learning and parasitic-aware model development. All datasets, preprocessing scripts, and configurations are publicly available in our code repository this https URL .

AI.tldr: ParasGB是首个用于电路图上预布局寄生参数预测的开源基准测试套件，基于商业EDA工具从已流片设计中提取的大规模异构RC网络，提供了标准化的评估协议，并揭示了GNN在此任务上面临的标签不平衡、长尾分布和结构异构性等挑战。
AI.motivation: 随着芯片制造工艺进入深亚微米节点，互连寄生效应日益主导模拟与混合信号(AMS)电路的性能，导致昂贵的布局迭代。然而，由于缺乏支持可复现评估的公共高保真RC基准数据集，基于GNN的寄生建模进展受阻。早期阶段的寄生电容和电阻估计对于物理实现前的寄生感知设计探索至关重要。
AI.method: 1. 构建ParasGB开源基准套件：使用商业EDA工具从已流片验证(tape-out-proven)的设计中提取大规模异构RC网络；2. 提供统一评估协议：涵盖节点级对地电容、边级电阻和边级耦合电容三类预测任务；3. 使用标准化训练流程对多种GNN架构进行基准测试；4. 通过分析暴露GNN在此任务上的关键挑战。
AI.result: 1. 发布了首个针对电路图寄生参数预测的开源基准数据集和评估协议；2. 通过实验揭示了GNN在寄生预测中面临的极端标签不平衡、长尾寄生分布和强结构异构性等挑战；3. 为电路图学习和寄生感知模型开发建立了物理基础扎实、标准化的可复现研究平台；4. 所有数据集、预处理脚本和配置均已公开开源。
AI.conclusion: ParasGB为早期寄生预测提供了一个物理基础扎实且标准化的开源基准，推动了电路图学习的可复现研究以及寄生感知模型的发展，有助于在完整物理实现前实现更有效的寄生感知设计探索，减少昂贵的布局迭代成本。

title: From Score Learning to Discretized Sampling: An End-to-End Generalization Analysis of Diffusion Models
summary: Despite the empirical success of score-based diffusion models, a complete theoretical understanding of how finite-sample learning, network parameterization, and numerical discretization jointly dictate generative quality remains underdeveloped. Existing sampling analyses often evaluate the generative performance conditional on an oracle score or a pre-specified error threshold. In this work, we establish a unified convergence and generalization framework for score-based diffusion models parameterized by practical ResNet-type architectures. We analyze the generalization and convergence properties from the practical finite-sample, discrete-time learning problem of the score function to the ideal continuous-time, population-level objective. Based on the generalization result of the learning problem of score function, we analyze the sampling process induced by the learned score function and provide an end-to-end total variation distance estimate for the generated terminal distribution. This estimate explicitly decomposes the overall generative error into four interpretable components: the truncation error of the forward process, the reverse-time discretization error, the generalization error incorporating both finite data and forward-time discretization, and the training optimization gap. Our results quantitatively characterize how the training sample size, temporal discretization grids, and optimization accuracy jointly control the final fidelity of samples generated by diffusion models.

AI.tldr: 本文为基于评分的扩散模型建立了统一的收敛与泛化理论框架，针对实际ResNet类网络架构，从有限样本离散时间评分学习的角度出发，推导了生成末端分布的总变差距离端到端估计，并将总体生成误差分解为四个可解释的组成部分。
AI.motivation: 现有的扩散模型采样分析通常基于oracle评分函数或预设误差阈值，忽略了有限样本学习、网络参数化与数值离散化三者之间的耦合关系，缺乏从评分函数学习到生成分布质量的完整理论刻画。该研究旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 作者为基于评分的扩散模型（采用ResNet类实际架构）建立了统一的收敛与泛化分析框架。具体而言：1）分析评分函数在有限样本、离散时间设定下的学习问题；2）将学习得到的评分函数回代至采样过程；3）推导连续时间、总体层面理想目标下的端到端总变差距离估计。核心工具包括ResNet类网络的泛化分析以及离散-连续时间的误差耦合分析。
AI.result: 得到一个端到端的总变差距离界，将生成误差显式分解为四个可解释的组成部分：1）前向过程的截断误差；2）反向时间的离散化误差；3）包含有限数据与前向离散化影响的泛化误差；4）训练优化误差。该结果定量刻画了训练样本量、时间离散化网格与优化精度对最终生成样本保真度的联合控制作用。
AI.conclusion: 本文工作弥合了扩散模型经验成功与理论理解之间的差距，提供了一个严格的框架来量化样本规模、时间离散化和优化精度对生成质量的影响，对实际扩散模型的设计与训练具有理论指导意义。

title: StageGuard: Physiologically Constrained Sleep Staging
comment: 12 pages. Accepted at KDD 2026 (32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference), AI for Sciences track
summary: Automated sleep staging is increasingly used in large-scale studies to derive sleep-architecture endpoints: total sleep time, REM latency, sleep efficiency, and bout-duration statistics. Deep learning models achieve epoch-level accuracy approaching inter-rater agreement, yet often produce hypnograms that violate physiological invariants, such as rare transitions (e.g., direct Wake -> REM) or excessively fragmented sequences. Such violations can bias downstream sleep metrics, regardless of overall accuracy. We propose StageGuard, a plug-and-play, backbone-agnostic structured-inference framework that wraps any neural sleep-staging backbone with physiology-informed priors. StageGuard combines (1) a differentiable soft transition penalty that discourages physiologically rare transitions during training, and (2) a semi-Markov constrained decoder with a duration-augmented state space that jointly enforces transition penalties and minimum bout durations at inference. Unlike hard-prohibition methods, it admits rare transitions when emission evidence is overwhelming, leaving informative pathological events recoverable rather than blocked. StageGuard constrains staging outputs to satisfy known physiological priors rather than modeling sleep generatively. We quantify the validity gap using transition-violation rate (TVR) and fragmentation index (FI) and demonstrate that, across six backbones and four datasets, StageGuard reduces TVR to physiologically plausible levels and lowers FI by 56-62%, while maintaining or slightly improving classification accuracy. Crucially, improved constraint satisfaction translates into 59-79% lower error on derived sleep-architecture statistics not directly optimized by the method, and recovers the direction and effect size of expert-defined subgroup differences (OSA severity, age) more faithfully than the unconstrained baseline.

AI.tldr: StageGuard 是一个即插即用、与骨干网络无关的结构化推理框架,通过将生理学先验(软转移惩罚 + 持续时间增强的半马尔可夫约束解码器)包装在任意神经睡眠分期骨干网络外,使分期输出满足生理学约束(罕见转移率 TVR 降至 0.1–0.8%,碎片化指数 FI 降低 56–62%),同时在六个骨干网络和四个数据集上保持或提升分类精度,并使下游睡眠结构统计量的误差降低 59–79%。
AI.motivation: 深度学习睡眠分期模型虽在 epoch 级准确率上接近专家水平(约 80–85%),却常产生违反生理不变量的 hypnogram,如罕见的状态转移(例如 Wake→REM, 仅在发作性睡病等病理条件下出现)或过度碎片化的序列。这些违反会系统性地偏倚下游睡眠结构指标(总睡眠时间、REM 潜伏期、睡眠效率、觉醒次数等),无论整体准确率多高。现有方法(独立逐 epoch 分类、弱时序耦合、简单后处理平滑)均无法保证输出符合已知的生理学约束,导致自动化分期在大型科学研究中的可信度存疑。
AI.method: StageGuard 由训练和推理两阶段组成。训练阶段:在交叉熵损失上叠加可微的软转移惩罚项 L_trans(式 4),以相邻 epoch 后验概率乘积近似联合罕见转移概率,鼓励骨干网络学习天然尊重生理约束的表示;总损失 L = L_CE + λL_trans(λ=0.5)。推理阶段:在持续时间增强的扩展状态空间 S̃ = {(s,d)} 上执行半马尔可夫 Viterbi 解码(式 7),对数转移矩阵同时编码经验转移概率 π̂(典型转移)和小的固定惩罚 ε=0.001(罕见转移),并通过 d<D_max 时的自转移、d≥d_min(s) 时才允许状态切换的规则精确强制最小持续时间;翻转振荡(flip-flop)惩罚 γ=2.0 在 k=5 窗口内进一步抑制快速交替;信号质量指数 β_t 将低质量 epoch 的发射概率插值向均匀分布(式 9)。论文明确区分了精确(Viterbi + 静态约束 + 持续时间)、近似(软惩罚)和启发式(翻转振荡)三类组件(表 2)。
AI.result: 在 6 个骨干网络(AccuSleep、DeepSleepNet、SeqSleepNet、AttnSleep、SleepTransformer、U-Sleep)和 4 个数据集(AccuSleep 鼠 EEG/EMG、Sleep-Accel 腕动计、SHHS 心肺信号、SLEEPBRL 生物雷达)上,StageGuard 将 TVR 从无约束基线的 3.6–12.3% 降至 0.1–0.8%(专家基线约 2.1–4%),FI 降低 56–62%,epoch 级准确率保持或略有提升(+0.6 至 +4.8 pp,信噪比最低的生物雷达模态提升最大);下游睡眠结构指标 MAE 降低 59–79%(REM 潜伏期 21.3→8.7 min,觉醒次数 15.1→3.2);在 SHHS 上更忠实地恢复了专家定义的亚组差异(OSA 严重程度、年龄的 Cohen's d 方向与大小);消融研究证实软惩罚、转移约束、持续时间约束三者互补,翻转振荡项仅影响约 3.8% 的记录;推理开销仅 +6.5%(U-Sleep)至 +18%(AccuSleep),训练开销 <1%。
AI.conclusion: StageGuard 将生理学先验编码为可审计、可调节的显式约束(ε、d_min、λ),证明罕见转移应被"强烈抑制"而非"硬性禁止"——这在准确率与科学可靠性之间架起桥梁,既保证了下游睡眠结构分析的可信度,又保留了诊断性罕见事件在证据充分时仍可恢复的能力(默认 λ=0.5 下罕见转移召回率 91%)。但其默认约束配置基于健康成人/小鼠生理学,不适用于以罕见转移本身为诊断目标的队列(发作性睡病、RBD、新生儿/儿科睡眠、严重碎片化综合征),在这些场景下需重新标定 R、d_min 和 λ。作者将其明确定位为"可靠性层"而非睡眠生物学的生成模型,并指出未来工作的核心方向是这些病理性群体验证。

title: AlloBench: Measuring Online Tool Allocation Capability in LLM Agents
summary: Creating a reusable tool is an investment: an agent pays a fixed cost now in exchange for the potential of future reuse. Therefore, a user should prefer an agent that creates a small number of highly reusable tools, rather than many one-offs. We introduce a paired benchmark that tests whether LLM agents exhibit conscious allocation behavior under a fixed budget in two contexts: an abstract text-based formulation and a code-construction task. We find that every frontier model we test---Claude Haiku, Claude Opus, GPT-5.4-mini, and GPT-5.6 Sol---acts near-optimally in the abstract framing but fails to transfer this ability to script-writing. Through further experiments, we identify the particular failure modes for each model. Notably, the first three models fail even when the scripts are not evaluated, while GPT-5.6 Sol stays selective under that weaker manipulation and collapses only at full construction. Furthermore, an open-source Qwen model policy-trained for abstract allocation generalizes this ability across held-out lexical variations, but sees no improvement at script allocation. Together, these results establish online tool allocation as a significant capability boundary, even for modern frontier models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AlloBench基准测试,用于评估LLM代理在固定预算下是否具备"何时创建可复用工具"的在线分配能力。通过抽象(R0)→声明式(R1)→代码必填(R2)→完整脚本构建(R3)四级阶梯设计,发现所有前沿模型(Claude Haiku/Opus、GPT-5.4-mini/Sol)在抽象场景中表现接近最优,但在脚本构建时完全丧失该能力,且RL后训练学到的抽象策略也无法迁移到工具创建场景。
