AI.motivation: 针对德语等非英语语言缺乏高效紧凑型语言模型的问题，以及在资源受限设备上部署大模型的现实需求，亟需一种在保持高性能的同时显著降低参数量和计算成本的德语专用模型。现有模型多为英语设计，未能充分处理德语的形态变化、复合词构成和正字法约定等语言学特性。
AI.method: 1) 采用紧凑的 2.7B 参数架构，专为端侧部署优化；2) 训练在受限的计算预算（55k H100 GPU 小时）内完成，仅使用公开可用数据；3) 开发了德语专用的数据预处理流程，针对形态变化、复合词和正字法约定进行了专门处理（区别于英语导向的方法）；4) 引入了数据质量过滤与改写（rephrasing）步骤，以提升数据的指令质量、改善退火阶段性能并降低总体计算需求。
AI.result: 在 <3B 参数级别模型中，ELMOD 取得了最强的性能表现，其德语能力可与 7B 参数级别的模型相媲美，同时显著降低了参数量和计算成本。归功于架构选择和德语特定的数据处理策略（包括预过滤和提升教育质量的重写步骤）。
AI.conclusion: 通过在模型架构与德语专用数据处理两方面的协同优化，ELMOD 证明在受限计算预算下训练紧凑型语言模型仍可实现与更大模型相竞争的性能，为非英语语言（尤其是德语）的端侧高效部署提供了一个有竞争力的方案，并为类似规模的多语言模型设计提供了借鉴。

title: PIVOT: Efficient Query-Group Indexing for Token-Level Sparse Attention
summary: Token-level sparse attention, as implemented by DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) in production systems, makes the downstream attention efficient but shifts the bottleneck to the indexer that feeds it. To select the top-k tokens for each query, the indexer must still score every preceding token, incurring a cost of O(L^2) per layer for a sequence of length L. We observe that this per-query scan is largely redundant: nearby queries select highly overlapping top-k tokens, and the indexer scores are long-tailed along the key axis. We exploit these properties in PIVOT, Proxy Indexing Via One full-prefix Traversal, a training-free, drop-in replacement for the DSA indexer that shares one prefix scan across a group of nearby queries. PIVOT aggregates a group into a single proxy query, performs one shared full-prefix scan to obtain a candidate set, and then selects a top-k for each query from that set. Two variants trade speed for fidelity: PIVOT-Reuse shares the proxy top-k across the group for maximum speed, whereas PIVOT-Refine re-scores the candidate set with the indexer of each query and then selects an individual top-k, matching the dense indexer at a small additional cost. A single algorithm covers both inference phases, differing only in how groups are formed: fixed-size groups of consecutive queries in prefill, and the queries decoded together in one multi-token prediction (MTP) step in decode. On DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5.1 across LongBench and RULER, PIVOT matches the accuracy of the dense DSA indexer while accelerating it by up to 4x and reducing end-to-end latency by up to 1.6x at long context.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PIVOT，一种无需训练的即插即用索引器替代方案，用于加速 DeepSeek 稀疏注意力 (DSA) 中的 token 级稀疏注意力。通过让一组邻近查询共享一次完整的前缀扫描（使用代理查询），将索引成本从 O(gL) 降低至 O(L) 或 O(L+gc)，在保持与密集 DSA 索引器相同准确性的同时，实现高达 4 倍的索引器加速和 1.6 倍的端到端延迟降低。
AI.motivation: 在长上下文场景下，DSA 虽然将主注意力成本从 O(L²) 降至 O(Lk)，但索引器仍需为每个查询对整个前缀进行评分，产生 O(L²) 的逐层索引成本。在 200K token 时，索引器在 prefill 中占端到端延迟的约 81%，在 decode 中占约 41%，成为新的瓶颈。现有加速方法（HISA、MISA、IndexCache 等）分别在 token、head、layer 维度削减成本，但均未触及 query 维度——索引器仍需对每个查询独立扫描整个前缀。
AI.method: PIVOT 基于三个观察：(O1) 邻近查询的 top-k 集合高度重叠；(O2) 一组 g 个查询的 top-k 并集增长缓慢（约 1.3–1.9k，远低于最坏情况 gk）；(O3) 索引分数沿 key 轴呈长尾分布。基于此，PIVOT 将一组查询聚合为单一代理查询（通过 per-head 均值池化），执行一次共享的完整前缀扫描得到代理分数，再从中选取 top-k。提供两种变体：PIVOT-Reuse 直接将代理的 top-k 共享给整组（成本 O(L)）；PIVOT-Refine 形成大小为 c=2k 的候选集，对每个查询在该候选集上重新评分并选取各自的 top-k（成本 O(L+gc)），可匹配密集索引器准确率。分组策略因推理阶段而异：prefill 使用固定大小连续查询组，decode 利用 MTP 推测解码生成的 d+1 个 token 作为一组（g=4）。同时引入短组保护机制，避免短序列性能回退；并通过局部窗口保证每查询保留其最近 token。
AI.result: 在 DeepSeek-V3.2 和 GLM-5.1 模型上，于 LongBench 和 RULER（4K–128K）基准测试中：PIVOT-Refine 在 RULER 长上下文下准确率与密集 DSA 索引器持平（128K 时差距 ≤0.02 个百分点），PIVOT-Reuse 在中等长度表现良好但在 64K–128K 略有下降。索引器内核在 256K 时实现高达约 4.8 倍加速，端到端延迟在长上下文下降低达 1.6 倍。PIVOT 可与 IndexCache 等其他加速方法正交互补，叠加使用几乎无精度损失。消融实验验证了均值池化、g=4、c=2k 的默认超参数选择。PIVOT-Reuse 全程约 4 倍加速，PIVOT-Refine 随上下文增长从 16K 的 ~1 倍提升至 256K 的 ~3.9 倍。
AI.conclusion: PIVOT 通过沿 query 轴共享一次完整前缀扫描，开辟了加速 token 级稀疏注意力的新维度。它无需训练，保持 DSA 接口与下游 Sparse MLA 不变，与 token/head/layer 维度的现有加速方法正交。一个统一算法可同时服务 prefill 与 decode 阶段，未来工作方向包括将 query 轴与 token、head、layer 轴联合优化以及扩展至更广泛的模型家族。

title: You Talkin to Me?: A Network Analysis of Gendered Speaker-Addressee Patterns in Film Screenplays
summary: Objective: This paper investigates the gendered structure of speaker addressee relationships in film dialogue, asking not merely who speaks, but who is spoken to and how conversational dynamics unfold across gender lines. Methods: Using a manually annotated dataset of 4,600 directed dialogue events from 38 film screenplays, we apply network analysis, chi squared tests, paired statistical comparisons, and participation shift analysis across three studies. Key Findings: Male characters dominate as both speakers and addressees corpus wide, even in scenes with more women; cross gender dialogue is directionally symmetric on average but clustered at the film level; and same gender turns diffuse conversational attention while cross gender turns produce tighter dyadic reciprocation. Conclusion: Gender bias in film dialogue operates through the architecture of conversation itself, through exclusion from interaction and structural positioning as addressees, rather than through speaking time or within conversation directional imbalance alone.

AI.tldr: 本文通过手工标注的38部电影剧本中4600条对话事件，利用网络分析、卡方检验、配对统计比较及参与转移（p-shift）分析，系统考察了电影对话中性别化的"说话者-受话者"关系结构，揭示出性别偏见通过会话架构本身运作——而非仅通过发言时间或对话内方向性失衡。
AI.motivation: 现有电影性别研究多聚焦于角色的银幕时间、出场率或语言框架（如权力与施事性），忽略了叙事中"谁被谁说话"这一核心关系结构维度。本研究认为，识别多角色场景中的特定受话者长期制约着大规模计算分析，因此采用人工标注数据，填补对话结构与性别偏见交叉研究的空白。
AI.method: （1）数据：从IMSDB获取38部最终版/后期制作剧本（1972–2017），由两名本科生标注约4600条有明确受话者的对话事件，评分者一致性>80%；性别通过gender-guesser工具基于名字推断（二元化近似）。三个研究依次采用：（2a）研究1：构建2×2说话者性别×受话者性别列联表，对全部场景与女性主导场景分别进行卡方独立性检验；（2b）研究2：对166个混合性别场景计算场景级M→F占比，配对t检验与Wilcoxon符号秩检验整体对称性，并以0.33/0.67阈值划分方向偏斜类别，结合代表性网络可视化；（2c）研究3：在含4+说话者的场景中，编码连续两轮对话为AB→CD的五类参与转移（继续、回报、说话者重指、第三方进入、平行转移），用卡方检验整体独立性，并对五类转移做FDR校正的双比例z检验。
AI.result: 研究1：全部场景中M→M对话占40.2%，卡方检验显著（χ²=97.70, p<0.001）；即使在女性主导场景中，F→M（44.6%）与M→F（41.2%）仍远超F→F（12.7%），男性始终是主要受话者。研究2：整体M→F占比为0.504，均值0.491，配对t检验与Wilcoxon检验均不显著，跨性别对话在聚合层面方向对称；但64.5%的场景为平衡型，少数场景呈方向偏斜且聚类于影片层面（如Wild Hogs偏向M→F，Cherry Falls偏向F→M）。研究3：χ²=14.16, p=0.007，异质性初始轮更常产生直接回报（AB-BA：66.0% vs. 50.5%, p_BH=0.006），同质性初始轮更常引入第三方（AB-CA：15.9% vs. 7.9%, p_BH=0.028）；3+说话者场景的稳健性检验复制了核心回报效应。
AI.conclusion: 男性角色在语料层面同时主导说话者与受话者位置，跨性别对话平均方向对称但呈现影片级别的方向聚类，同性别（主要为男-男）轮次扩散会话注意力而跨性别轮次形成紧密的二元往复。性别偏见通过会话的架构本身——通过从互动中被排除以及作为受话者的结构性定位——运作，补充了基于内容的既有研究，揭示了独立于"说什么"之外的叙事结构性偏见维度。

title: Who Gets Named: Citation Type Predicts Individual Naming by Grounded Language Models, and a Roster Instrument Captures 0.5% of It
comment: 28 pages, 5 figures. Data: this https URL
summary: Prior work on AI brand visibility measures the firm: does a model recommend a company, and does that track its reputation. This study asks the question one level down, in categories where the buyer picks a person. It issued 2,400 grounded API calls in one two-hour window on 24 July 2026: 120 buyer-intent prompts, four models (GPT-5.6 Sol, Gemini 3.6 Flash, Perplexity Sonar Pro, Grok 4.5), five iterations each, four European markets and five query languages. Every response was coded for whether it named an individual professional, by a rule cascade that never consults a roster and that drops detections resolving to a same-named American city (precision 96.9%, recall 61.7%, so every rate below is a lower bound). All inference corrects for clustering within prompt: intraclass correlation 0.258, effective n 407 against a nominal 2,400. Models named an individual in 25.8% of responses. Category dominates: real estate 35.4% and car dealerships 32.9% against insurance 9.1% (chi-square 159.3, p = 5.8e-8 after correction). Models differ four-fold, from Grok 38.0% to Gemini 9.3%. Citation type predicts naming and citation volume does not: naming responses cite the individual's own site 2.6 points more often (95% CI +1.4 to +3.9) and category portals 4.3 points more often, and cite firm-owned pages at the same rate (44.1% against 45.5%). On nine matched translation pairs, English prompts named an individual in 36.7% of responses against 15.6% for the same question in the local language (OR 3.14, clustered p = 0.074, so the direction is clear and the design cannot close it). A 939-person roster built from public LinkedIn search matched 128 of 27,293 name-shaped mentions (0.47%), 26 of the 939 people were ever named, and the roster-derived rates of 0.0% to 25.4% measure that overlap. Roster-based measurement of individual AI visibility sees a small and unrepresentative slice of what models do.

AI.tldr: 本文通过 2,400 次跨四家欧洲市场、四款主流 grounded LLM 的 API 调用，系统测定了生成式模型在购房购车买保险类"买家意图型"提问中**命名个人专业人士**的比例（25.8%），并揭示出基于花名册（roster）的个体级 AI 可见度测量工具仅能捕捉到 0.47% 的实际命名行为，从根本上质疑了当前业界以"姓名清单匹配"为思路的个人 AI 可见度产品。
AI.motivation: 既有 AI 品牌可见度研究关注的是"公司"，但房地产经纪、汽车销售、保险经纪等大量商业场景中，**买家最终选择的是一个人**。此前没有任何研究在买家意图型商业场景中（且在欧美以外的市场）系统测量过"模型是否会命名某个个体专业人士、什么因素驱动这一行为"，也没有人评估过"以职业人士花名册做匹配"这种业界看似自然的方法究竟能不能测对它本想测的东西。
AI.method: 研究设计为 4 市场（波兰、爱尔兰、荷兰、波海三国）× 3 品类（房产代理、汽车销售、保险经纪）× 4 模型（GPT-5.6 Sol、Gemini 3.6 Flash、Perplexity Sonar Pro、Grok 4.5）× 5 迭代 = **2,400 次 grounded API 调用**，全部在 2026 年 7 月 24 日两小时内完成；提示词为 120 条买家意图型问句（含 9 对严格翻译对照）。结果采用 **双重检测**：(1) 基于 939 人 LinkedIn 花名册的字符串匹配；(2) 不依赖花名册的六级规则级联（精确率 96.9%，召回率 61.7%）。统计上对 prompt 内聚类效应做校正（ICC=0.258，等效样本量 n=407/2400）。同时对 2,182 个被引域重新做 20 类来源分类，并对同名美国城市（如 Warsaw, IN；Dublin, OH）做地理校正。
AI.result: 主要发现包括：(1) 总体命名率 25.8%，**品类主导效应最强**——房产 35.4% 与汽车 32.9% 远高于保险 9.1%（χ²=159.3, p=5.8×10⁻⁸）；(2) **模型差异四倍**：Grok 38.0% vs Gemini 9.3%；(3) **引用类型预测命名行为而非引用数量**：命名响应更多引用个人自建网站（+2.6pp）与品类门户（+4.3pp），而引用雇主官网的比例无差异（44.1% vs 45.5%），**推翻了原研究"雇主网站决定可见度"的机制假说**；(4) 9 对精确翻译对照中，英文提问命名率 36.7% vs 本地语言 15.6%（OR=3.14，clustered p=0.074）；(5) **花名册仅匹配 27,293 个名字形提及中的 128 个（0.47%）、940 人中仅 26 人被命名**，得到的波兰市场率 0.0% 是工具失效的反映而非模型行为（实际为 31.3%）；(6) 存在系统性**地理错位检索**——4.7% 的 Warsaw 引用指向印第安纳州 Warsaw（汽车经销商份额尤高）；(7) 爱尔兰 47.8% 的"人名形"输出实为个人命名公司（eponymous firms）。
AI.conclusion: 类别与模型决定个体命名率，引用溯源机制指向个人自营渠道而非雇主网站；任何个体级 AI 可见度测量若仅依赖花名册匹配、忽略同型公司与跨地理错误检索，将产生**虚假的、随市场规模排序的失真结果**。研究主张：可防御的个体级 AI 可见度度量必须以**文本级检测**而非清单匹配为基础，并同时处理同型公司消歧与地理校正三个问题。

title: MEMOIR: Temporal Behavioral Memory for Recommendation Across the Preference-Drift Spectrum
summary: We propose MEMOIR, a framework that segments user interaction histories into temporal windows, generates semantic behavioral memory for each period using an LLM, and aggregates current state, evolution direction, and predicted future into a single user representation. On the Electronics and Clothing_Shoes_and_Jewelry categories of Amazon Reviews 2023, MEMOIR is statistically tied with UniSRec, the strongest baseline, on aggregate NDCG@10 (0.0643 vs. 0.0641), splitting the four reported metrics 2-2: MEMOIR leads NDCG@10 and MRR, UniSRec leads HR@10 and HR@20. An ablation study finds that no single architectural component - the evolution-preserving contrastive loss, its directional-consistency term, or temporal window segmentation itself - individually explains much of MEMOIR's approximately 18% relative gain over ID-based SASRec; all four ablations land within 2% of the full model on aggregate NDCG@10. Stratifying test performance by a composite preference-drift score instead reveals where the gain concentrates: MEMOIR leads on ranking-quality metrics (NDCG@10, MRR) specifically among users at the high- and low-drift extremes of the distribution, while UniSRec leads the volume-oriented HR@10/HR@20 metrics across all drift strata and edges out MEMOIR on ranking quality in the middle band. We report this drift-stratified pattern, rather than the near-tied aggregate numbers or any single ablated component, as MEMOIR's most substantive and reproducible finding, and surface why it holds as an open question for future work.

AI.tldr: MEMOIR是一个序列推荐框架，将用户交互历史按时间窗口划分，利用LLM为每个时段生成语义行为记忆，并通过演化保留对比损失和演化感知聚合器将当前状态、演化方向和预测未来融合为单一用户表示。该方法在Amazon Reviews 2023上与最强基线UniSRec在NDCG@10上统计性持平（0.0643 vs 0.0641），但按偏好漂移分层后发现：MEMOIR在高漂移和低漂移用户群中于排序质量指标（NDCG@10、MRR）上领先，UniSRec则在中等漂移用户群及命中率指标上全面占优。
AI.motivation: 现有序列推荐模型（如SASRec、BERT4Rec）将用户偏好视为静态摘要或下一个物品预测的副产品，未显式建模偏好随时间如何演化。LLM增强方法（如SRA-CL）虽然引入了语义知识，但LLM仅作为离线预处理或辅助训练信号，在推理时被丢弃。论文观察到偏好演化是普遍现象：在Amazon Reviews 2023上，相邻月份类别分布的平均JSD为0.795，任何窗口中92.2%的物品是用户从未接触过的新品。因此论文主张：推荐应针对用户的演化轨迹而非仅当前状态，LLM应作为一等架构组件而非离线预处理步骤。
AI.method: MEMOIR采用四阶段架构：(1) 时间分段——按日历月将用户交互历史划分为W个窗口，每个窗口序列化为自然语言描述；(2) 记忆编码——使用TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat配合LoRA微调，将每窗口文本编码为256维语义记忆嵌入；(3) 演化保留对比学习——包含两项损失：时序平滑性（InfoNCE，相邻窗口为正样本）和方向一致性（铰链损失，约束连续演化方向向量的余弦相似度）；(4) 演化感知聚合——GRU处理记忆序列预测下一时刻记忆，MLP融合当前状态（近因加权聚合）、演化方向（最后两窗口差值）和预测未来为最终用户表示。此外引入行为一致性损失将用户表示锚定到物品嵌入空间。总损失为推荐损失、演化损失、一致性损失和外推损失的加权和。
AI.result: 在Amazon Reviews 2023的Electronics和Clothing_Shoes_and_Jewelry类目上：MEMOIR与UniSRec在四项指标上2-2平分秋色——MEMOIR领先NDCG@10（0.0643 vs 0.0641）和MRR（0.0617 vs 0.0603），UniSRec领先HR@10（0.1176 vs 0.1084）和HR@20（0.1791 vs 0.1594）；相对SASRec有约18%的相对NDCG@10提升。消融实验揭示反直觉结果：四项消融均在全模型NDCG@10的2%以内，"随机初始化物品嵌入"变体甚至优于全模型，移除时间分段仅损失1.6%，说明单一组件无法解释增益。超参数分析显示对比温度τ=0.03最优，窗口数W≥3后无影响。最核心发现来自偏好漂移分层分析：MEMOIR在高漂移和低漂移用户群中于NDCG@10和MRR上领先（如低漂移：0.0714 vs UniSRec的0.0703），而在中等漂ift用户群（占总用户50%）中UniSRec在全部四项指标上领先。此外，SASRec-Text反而劣于vanilla SASRec，证明预训练语义特征本身并不能提升推荐性能。
AI.conclusion: MEMOIR的核心贡献不在于整体性能的数字优势（与UniSRec基本持平），而在于揭示了一个漂移分层模式：MEMOIR在偏好漂移极端用户群中提供更优的排序质量，UniSRec则在中等漂移用户群和命中率指标上占优。该模式的机制根源仍为开放问题，可能与方向一致性假设更适用于单调漂移用户有关。已识别局限包括：方向一致性假设可能惩罚振荡型偏好用户（可能与中等漂移带表现较弱相关）、稀疏用户（<3窗口）演化信号减弱、以及LLM记忆编码带来的推理延迟开销（牺牲了ID方法的亚毫秒级推理简洁性以换取演化感知表示）。未来工作方向：自适应窗口粒度、多领域扩展、通过增量记忆缓存缩小推理延迟差距。

title: The Fallacy of Sustainable Generative AI: Limitations in EU Environmental Regulation of Data Centres and Paths Forward
summary: In the age of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Large Language Models, Generative AI and larger frontier AI models, data centres create a significant environmental burden on electricity grids and fresh water resources. Requiring data centre operators and Big Tech under the recast Energy Efficiency Directive (recast EED) to quantify, report and disclose the facility-level energy and water impacts seems to be a step into the right direction towards more transparency and accountability. Yet when two recast EED approved benchmarks - the Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) and Water Usage Effectiveness (WUE) - can be skewed to create a false sense on efficiency gains, current EU policy pushing for sustainable hyperscale data centre expansion appears misplaced. This paper argues that current PUE and WUE reporting frameworks illustrate what we term the "efficiency paradox," according to which positive scores require retrofitting larger AI data centres at the expense of energy supply and people's water access. Countering this efficiency paradox requires a new strategy for data centre operators and the EU Commission to demonstrate the ecological gains of optimising for efficiency through individual reporting and additional policy interventions. We make three policy proposals to show how this strategy can be formalised in practice: (i) measures to reveal and certify efficiency improvements, (ii) documentation of trade-offs in PUE and WUE improvements and, (iii) a monitoring framework of their diminishing returns and countereffects over time. Implementing these measures will ensure that the recast EED common rating scheme is fit-for-purpose, balancing sustainability with AI innovation for local communities.

AI.tldr: 本文批评欧盟《能源效率指令》(recast EED) 所采用的 PUE 与 WUE 指标在评估 AI 数据中心可持续性时存在误导性，提出"效率悖论"概念，并提出三项政策建议以完善披露与监管框架。
AI.motivation: 随着 AI、大语言模型与生成式 AI 推动超大规模数据中心快速扩张，其电力消耗与淡水使用对电网及水资源造成巨大压力。欧盟虽在修订版 EED 中引入 PUE 与 WUE 强制披露要求，但作者认为这些指标可被操纵，制造虚假的效率提升假象，因此有必要揭示并纠正这一政策缺陷。
AI.method: 本文采用政策与法规分析方法，对 recast EED 下 PUE 与 WUE 的计算逻辑与披露框架进行批判性审视，结合"效率悖论"概念论证当前指标体系在评估 AI 数据中心可持续性方面的内在缺陷，并据此提出制度化的对策建议。
AI.result: 作者提出"效率悖论"：表面上 PUE/WUE 数值的改善（通过设备升级与回退式改造）实际上是以更高的总能耗、冷却系统的高水耗以及周边社区水资源可及性为代价。文章据此提出三项政策建议：（1）建立能揭示并认证真实效率改进的措施；（2）在 PUE/WUE 改进过程中系统记录权衡取舍（trade-offs）；（3）建立监测框架，跟踪其随时间递减的边际收益及反向效应。
AI.conclusion: 仅依靠 PUE 与 WUE 指标无法真正衡量 AI 数据中心的生态影响。落实上述三项措施可使 recast EED 的统一评级方案具备"适用性"（fit-for-purpose），在推动 AI 创新的同时保障本地社区的供水与能源供应，实现可持续性与创新之间的平衡。

title: Socioeconomic Inference in LLM Medical Triage: Same Symptoms, Different ZIP Code
comment: 8 pages, 4 tables. Code, prompts, and raw results: this https URL
summary: We investigate whether large language models alter medical triage recommendations for identical symptoms when only the patient's socioeconomic status (SES) varies. Using three deployment-tier models (Gemini 3.5 Flash, Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.4-mini), we hold a single neurological symptom profile fixed and vary the SES signal along two channels: explicit (insurance status, occupation, housing) and implicit (a US ZIP code, with no other socioeconomic information). All three models raise their emergency-room (ER) referral rate for lower-SES patients given the explicit signal (spreads of 13-50 percentage points). The effect is in the protective direction: lower-SES patients are sent to the ER more often, not less. The model's stated reasoning stays clinically near-identical across conditions, so the shift is invisible to a reasoning-trace audit. Critically, sensitivity to the implicit ZIP-code signal is model-dependent: Gemini infers SES from geography alone, shifting its ER rate by a pooled 11.4 points across six US ZIP-code pairs (p = 1.4e-7, same direction in 6/6 pairs), while Claude Sonnet 4.6 stays flat (-0.1 points) and GPT-5.4-mini shows only a small difference that is not sign-consistent (2.0 points, predicted direction in just 2 of 6 pairs), neither a reliable ZIP-code effect, despite both responding to the explicit signal. This reveals an explicitness gradient in the signal: every model acts on socioeconomic status when it is stated outright, but only Gemini Flash acts on it when it must be inferred from a proxy as thin as five digits. We read this as a model-specific difference rather than a size or cost effect. A single-sentence system-prompt instruction reduces but does not eliminate the effect (Gemini's gap between low- and high-income ZIPs falls from 11.4 to 5.8 points). We release all code, prompts, and raw results.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLM）在医学分诊中是否会因患者社会经济地位（SES）的不同而改变对相同症状的紧急程度判断。核心发现是：所有测试模型在显式SES信号下均会提高对低收入患者的急诊室（ER）转诊率（13–50个百分点），但仅Gemini 3.5 Flash能从隐式信号（仅ZIP代码）推断SES，Claude和GPT则不能。该偏差在模型的推理过程中不可见，单句提示词干预只能减轻而非消除。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM被广泛应用于症状检查和分诊助手，临床评估中保持社会经济公平成为基本要求——患者的收入、保险状况或居住地不应改变症状的医学危险程度。本研究旨在检验LLM分诊是否在患者社会经济信号变化时保持一致，填补现有研究对SES（而非性别、种族）以及隐式代理信号（如ZIP代码）的研究空白。
AI.method: 采用反事实患者变异法（counterfactual patient variation）：固定单一神经系统症状表现（提示颅内压升高的红旗症状），通过两个通道改变SES信号——（1）显式通道：附加保险状态、职业、住房等描述；（2）隐式通道：仅提供5位US ZIP代码（基于ACS 2024收入中位数配对的6对ZIP）。测试三个部署级模型（Gemini 3.5 Flash、Claude Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5.4-mini），主要指标为ER转诊率的二元结果。显式通道n=30/条件/模型；隐式通道Gemini n=150/ZIP，Claude和GPT n=80/ZIP。另设干预臂加入一句去偏系统提示。统计方法采用双比例z检验、Wilson 95%置信区间和符号一致性检验。
AI.result: （1）显式SES信号：三个模型均对低SES描述提高ER转诊率，方向为保护性（低SES更多被送ER），Gemini跨度50个百分点（好邮编23%→公共住房73%），Claude跨度37个百分点，GPT跨度13个百分点；严重程度评分基本不变（7.8–8.0/10）。（2）隐式ZIP信号：仅Gemini稳健表现，6/6对均同方向，合并差距+11.4个百分点（p=1.4×10⁻⁷）；Claude为-0.1个百分点（0/6），GPT为+2.0个百分点但仅2/6对同方向（不可靠）。（3）推理沉默：2100条ZIP条件下的Gemini响应无一引用收入、费用、位置等，偏差对推理审计不可见。（4）干预效果：Gemini的ZIP差距从11.4降至5.8个百分点（但6对中5对缩小1对扩大），显式跨度50→17；Claude显式跨度37→0完全消除；GPT显式跨度13→7。
AI.conclusion: LLM在显式社会经济信号下普遍存在分诊偏差，呈保护性方向（低SES更多ER转诊），源于模型对患者医疗可及性的先验假设。该偏差在隐式ZIP代理下表现为模型特异性——Gemini能推断，Claude和GPT不能，与模型规模或价格无关。偏差在推理链中沉默且无法通过简单提示消除，因此临床LLM审计必须测试隐式代理、测量行动分布而非解释、且按模型验证缓解措施。

title: Auditing Institutional Heterogeneity for Generative AI in Patient Education: A Large-Scale Study of 102 US Transplant Handbooks
summary: Health systems are rapidly deploying generative AI assistants that answer patient questions from institution-authored education materials, on the premise that grounding in local content yields consistent guidance. Whether it does depends on a question not previously measured at scale: do the underlying documents themselves agree? We use a structured-output large language model judge to audit 5,730,465 pairwise comparisons across 102 patient-education handbooks from 23 US solid-organ transplant centers, paired with 1,115 patient-derived questions (TransplantQA). Four findings bear directly on deployment: (1) institutional editorial voice statistically transcends organ-type boundaries, with same-center handbooks agreeing across organs more than same-organ handbooks across centers (p = 0.0056); (2) information gaps fall disproportionately on topics central to underrepresented subgroups, with reproductive health showing double jeopardy: it is the single most-silent topic (82% absent) and the highest judge-rated clinical significance when present (86% high-significance disagreements); (3) divergence themes cluster into 991 topics, with immunosuppression and pregnancy timing among the highest-stakes themes; and (4) per-pair disagreement is predictable from question framing alone (AUC = 0.77). We discuss implications for deploying patient-facing generative AI in transplant care.

AI.tldr: 本文对来自23家美国实体器官移植中心的102本患者教育手册进行了大规模审计，共生成5,730,465对两两比较。研究发现机构编辑风格横跨器官类型边界，信息缺口的分布偏向代表性不足的亚群体（尤其是生殖健康），且仅凭问题措辞即可预测分歧程度（AUC=0.77）。
AI.motivation: 医疗系统正快速部署基于机构自有患者教育材料的生成式AI助手（RAG架构），但底层假设——这些材料内部一致——从未被大规模测量过。对于跨机构整合的患者教育语料库，健康IT团队面临三个未解决的运营问题：部署前如何审计语料异质性、如何预测哪些问题最易给出不一致回答、以及应采取哪些缓解措施。
AI.method: 采用结构化输出LLM作为评判工具（Qwen3-32B），对102本移植患者手册与1,115个患者问题（TransplantQA）进行审计。使用HERO-QA混合检索策略（BM25 + 密集检索 + 重排序）生成48,056个有据答案，再对非缺失答案对进行5标签分类（Absent/Consistent/Complementary/Divergent/Contradictory），并输出分歧主题与临床显著性评分。运行四条分析流水线：主题聚类（991个主题）、配对分层机构风格Welch t检验、每手册覆盖度z分数、预测模型（HistGradientBoosting）。
AI.result: 四点核心发现：(1) 机构编辑风格统计上横跨器官类型边界——同中心跨器官手册的一致性高于同器官跨中心手册（p=5.6×10⁻³，Welch t检验）；(2) 信息缺口不成比例地落在代表性不足亚群体话题上，生殖健康面临"双重不利"——82%缺失且在已涉及时86%为高临床显著性分歧；(3) 分歧主题聚类形成991个簇，其中妊娠时机与免疫抑制管理属于最高风险类别；(4) 仅凭问题措辞可预测分歧概率（AUC=0.77），"can-I-do-X"型生活方式与旅行问题为最强正向预测因子。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了可复现的语料级异质性测量工具，可用于生成式AI部署前审计。提出四项健康IT部署运营建议：部署前进行审计、利用预测层进行分流（如将高风险问题路由至临床人员审核）、将内容缺口视为公平性风险而非单纯覆盖度指标、要求结构化判断输出以支持部署后安全审查。完整审计在部署规模下成本约1,500美元等值的云GPU小时。

title: The Clinical Trial Pipeline Reveals the Next Wave of Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare: A Multidimensional Analysis of 8,532 Registered Studies
summary: The prospective clinical evaluation of artificial intelligence in medicine has expanded rapidly, but the global AI clinical trial landscape remains incompletely characterized. We systematically identified AI-related trials registered in this http URL using a broad keyword search followed by an LLM-based classifier. Each trial was classified across seven dimensions: clinical function, data modality, specialty, AI integration and autonomy, workflow position, translational maturity, and epistemic role. We identified 8,532 AI clinical trials across 32 specialties, with 80% registered from 2019 onward and 30.5% using a randomized controlled design. Imaging-based AI was the largest modality, with 2,475 trials (29%), while clinical text and NLP trials increased seven-fold between 2018 and 2025. Prognostic AI (4,324 trials) slightly exceeded diagnostic AI (3,828 trials), suggesting a shift from disease detection toward risk stratification and trajectory prediction. Treatment recommendation remained less developed, with 768 trials (9%). Translational maturity remained limited: 3,259 trials (38%) were retrospective validation studies and 1,802 (21%) were silent prospective evaluations, indicating that much of the pipeline still produces algorithmic rather than clinical evidence. Only 184 trials involved Level 4 semi-autonomous or closed-loop AI, 68% of which focused on glucose management. Multimodal AI accounted for 33.6% of trials, mainly combining imaging, omics, physiological signals, and wearable data. These findings indicate that clinical AI has moved from retrospective development to prospective evaluation, but not yet to adequately powered, geographically representative, long-term outcome trials. Future progress will depend on closing gaps in trial scale, specialty coverage, geographic representation, and translational maturity.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地分析了全球AI临床试验的注册现状，识别出2019年以来8532项AI相关临床试验，覆盖32个专科领域，揭示了AI医学从回顾性开发转向前瞻性评估的趋势，但仍存在转化成熟度不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 尽管AI在医学领域的前瞻性临床评估迅速扩展，但全球AI临床试验的整体格局尚未得到充分刻画。研究旨在填补这一空白，全面描绘AI临床试验的规模、分布、特征及转化成熟度。
AI.method: 基于ClinicalTrials.gov注册数据，采用广泛关键词检索结合大语言模型(LLM)分类器进行筛选；从七个维度对每项试验进行分类：临床功能、数据模态、专科、AI集成与自主性、工作流位置、转化成熟度及认知角色。
AI.result: 识别出8,532项AI临床试验，覆盖32个专科；80%试验于2019年后注册，30.5%采用随机对照设计；基于影像的AI为最大模态(2,475项，29%)；临床文本与NLP试验在2018-2025年间增长7倍；预后AI(4,324项)略超诊断AI(3,828项)，治疗推荐仅768项(9%)；转化成熟度有限：38%为回顾性验证，21%为隐性前瞻性评估；仅184项涉及Level 4半自主或闭环AI，其中68%聚焦血糖管理；多模态AI占33.6%。
AI.conclusion: 临床AI已从回顾性开发转向前瞻性评估，但尚未充分发展为足够检验效能、地理代表性充分、关注长期结局的试验。未来进展将依赖于缩小试验规模、专科覆盖、地理代表性与转化成熟度方面的差距。

title: Balancing Bits and Drops: Stress-Adjusted Water Management for Data Centers
summary: Data centers are critical to today's digital economy, but are also among the largest industrial consumers of freshwater. Beyond the sheer volume of water use, the environmental impact of data center water consumption varies significantly across locations and seasons, depending on local and regional water stress. However, prior research has largely focused on reducing total water use, overlooking that the same unit of water can have drastically different environmental consequences depending on when and where it is consumed. In this paper, we introduce a stress-adjusted water framework that quantifies the true sustainability impact of data center water consumption by incorporating both spatial and temporal water stress. Using the AWARE-US model, we capture county-level monthly variations in water availability and extend this framework to account for the off-site water footprint of electricity generation. Based on this stress-aware accounting, we analyze stress-adjusted water-computing strategies spanning both the software and infrastructure layers. Specifically, we study workload scheduling policies that jointly optimize water and carbon efficiency, evaluate the potential of rainwater harvesting as a supplemental water source, and investigate the feasibility of dry cooling as a water-free alternative to evaporative cooling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于水压力（water stress）的"压力调整后用水量"（stress-adjusted water）框架，利用 AWARE-US 模型量化数据中心在地理位置和季节维度上的真实用水可持续性影响，并通过工作负载调度、雨水收集和干式冷却三种策略进行验证，揭示了仅按用水体积优化会误导决策的关键问题。
AI.motivation: 数据中心是淡水消耗大户，但现有研究主要关注总用水量，忽视了水的环境影响因地点和时间的不同而存在数量级差异——同一升水在水资源紧张地区干旱季节的生态和社会代价，远高于水资源丰富地区的丰水期。此外，碳排放影响是全局性的，而水的影响本质上是局部且时间相关的，传统 WUE（用水效率）等体积指标无法反映水资源的真实价值。已有工作（如 SCARF、WaterWise）在区域聚合层面进行水压力调整，未明确区分现场与场外用水路径，也未对电力来源（发电厂位置）进行溯源建模。
AI.method: 1) 基于 AWARE-US 模型（county 级、月度）建立水压力特征因子 CF，将体积用水量加权为压力调整后用水量；2) 将场外（Scope 2）用电追溯到 EPA eGRID 子区域内的具体发电厂，按发电量加权计算各子区域的场外水压力因子，避免使用固定全国平均水强度系数（该方法可能产生最高 10 倍以上的估算误差）；3) 分析了 4,147 个美国数据中心位置；4) 工作负载调度采用离线优化框架（在完美未来信息下求上界），联合最小化碳排放与压力调整后用水量，比较 NoScheduling、CARBON、WATER、STRESS 和 WWS（联合优化）五种策略，针对时间灵活、空间灵活、时空灵活三类工作负载进行评估；5) 雨水收集采用全年逐时降水模拟（Weather Underground），评估不同收集面积和储罐容量下的补水率（cycle-of-concentration=10）；6) 干式冷却通过将 PUE 从 1.2 扫描至 2.0，量化现场用水消除与场外用水/碳排放增加之间的权衡。
AI.result: 1) 约 75% 的美国数据中心每年至少经历一个月的水压力期，30% 经历至少一个月极端压力，12% 全年处于持续压力状态；2) 多个主要市场（如达拉斯、博德曼、拉斯维加斯、哥伦布、塔尔萨）的场外水压力显著高于现场水压力，纯现场评估会低估真实影响；3) WWS 联合调度可同时降低压力调整后用水量最高 25% 和碳排放最高 25%，而仅优化用水体积在空间和时空灵活工作负载下反而可能增加压力调整后用水量；4) 雨水收集在多雨地区可抵消最高 100% 的现场冷却用水（如 100 万加仑储罐+100 万平方英尺收集面积），但在凤凰城、丹佛等干旱地区收益有限；5) 干式冷却在低 PUE（≤1.5）且电网水压力低的地区有效，但高 PUE（≥1.8）时场外用水和碳排放惩罚会抵消甚至逆转节水效益。
AI.conclusion: 可持续的数据中心运营必须超越体积型用水指标，将水压力作为一等可持续性指标进行考量。压力调整后用水框架通过显式建模现场与场外水压力以及电力来源溯源，揭示了仅优化体积用水可能因将负载转移到水压力更高区域而误判节水效果。研究表明，结合工作负载时空调度、雨水收集与情境感知的冷却技术选型，可在不牺牲性能的前提下显著降低真实水环境影响；未来研究应进一步将压力感知水核算与人口公平性分析相结合。

title: How to Catch a GPU: A Taxonomy of Verification and Enforcement Mechanisms for International AI Agreements
comment: 20 pages, 1 figure. Accepted at International Conference on Large-Scale AI Risks 2026 at KU Leuven
summary: Several international agreements have been proposed to regulate frontier AI development in response to catastrophic risks. However, there is no structured way to evaluate whether these proposals are enforceable, to assess where they might fail in practice, or to determine which combination of policies is most effective. We propose a taxonomy based on the principle that wherever sufficient capacity exists to violate an agreement, it must be under a control regime. This decomposes the problem of ensuring compliance with the agreement into preventing uncontrolled resource acquisition, detecting all capacity outside the control regime, and preventing escape from the control regime. Existing proposals consist of individual policies that address one or more of these sub-problems. Because the compute required for dangerous capabilities may decrease over time, more actors can violate an agreement and enforcement of these policies becomes harder. We define the enforcement breaking point as the FLOP-threshold or equivalent metric at which a policy loses its effectiveness in solving the sub-problem, and introduce a set of factors to assess how and why this breakdown occurs. This reveals which of the three sub-problems any given proposal adequately addresses, and where enforceability breaks down first. Applying this taxonomy to existing proposals reveals that more focus is placed on preventing escape from the control regime, while preventing resource acquisition and detecting all capacity outside the control regime receive less attention. By making these gaps explicit, this taxonomy can help researchers and policymakers prioritize future enforcement and verification efforts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套基于"控制体制"原则的分类法，将国际AI协议（特别是针对前沿AI的硬件治理）的验证与执行问题分解为三个子问题：防止资源逃逸、防止不受控资源获取、检测隐藏算力。通过对现有八项提案的政策梳理与各子问题"执行崩溃点"（enforcement breaking point）的分析，作者识别出"检测隐藏算力"是随计算阈值下降最先变得不可行的子问题，从而为研究者和政策制定者指明了关键缺口。
AI.motivation: 前沿AI发展带来的灾难性风险催生了多项国际治理协议提案，但现有文献缺乏系统性框架来评估这些提案是否可执行、在何处会失效，以及哪些政策组合最有效。随着算法和硬件进步，实现危险能力所需的算力持续下降，更多主体可能违反协议，使得执行难度不断上升。因此亟需一个结构化方法来评估不同提案在不同算力阈值下的有效性。
AI.method: 方法包括：(1) 基于"凡存在足够算力之处必受监管"原则，将验证与执行问题分解为三个子问题——防止控制体制内逃逸、防止不受控资源获取、检测隐藏算力；(2) 对文献中八项具体提案（含Al Ramiah、Scher、Miotti、Aguirre、Wasil、Harack、Baker等）进行政策梳理，将各提案中的具体措施映射到三个子问题；(3) 引入"执行崩溃点"（FLOP阈值或等价指标）概念，分析当设施规模从100,000降至100 H100等效算力时，各检测与执行措施的有效性变化。
AI.result: 研究得出以下核心发现：(1) 三个子问题中，"防止逃逸"和"防止不受控资源获取"在算力阈值下降时仍基本可行——前者通过集中监测每片芯片，后者依赖AI芯片供应链的高度集中（TSMC、ASML、SK Hynix、三星、Micron等）；(2) "检测隐藏算力"是最先变得不可行的子问题，约10,000 H100等效算力以下时，卫星监控因冷却塔等外部特征消失而失效，1,000等效时气冷式制冷方案与普通商业建筑无异，100等效时可装入12米集装箱；(3) 主动隐蔽使得10,000–100,000等效规模的隐藏设施也无法被完全排除；(4) 现有提案对"防止逃逸"关注最多，而对"防止资源获取"和"检测隐藏算力"关注不足，存在明显覆盖缺口。
AI.conclusion: Detect hidden capacity（检测隐藏算力）是决定国际AI协议验证成败的关键瓶颈，其难度随算力阈值下降而急剧上升，在约10,000 H100等效规模以下变得基本不可行。相比之下，依赖集中供应链追踪和逐芯片监控的另外两个子问题对阈值下降更具韧性。论文呼吁未来研究应：(1) 开发新的或组合式的检测方法以扩展可检测规模范围；(2) 推进其余两个子问题的具体实施方案；(3) 探索减缓阈值下降速度的政策（如研究禁令）；(4) 研究将技术可行性转化为实际执行的制度设计问题。

title: Who Does Withholding Delay? A Game-Theoretic Model of Open-Weight AI Release Under Asymmetric Proliferation
comment: 21 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Code and data are available at this https URL
summary: Restricting access to a dual-use AI model is precautionary only if it delays harmful actors more than defenders. That condition varies across actors: a state agency or organized criminal group may obtain a substitute through theft, distillation, intermediated access, independent development, or a foreign release, while a small utility or open-source maintainer may have no comparable route. We model a laboratory choosing among controlled access, a defender-first window, safeguarded open weights, and minimally restricted open weights. Access inversion occurs when restriction gives an access advantage to adversaries that obtain effective substitutes faster than defenders. Asymmetric empowerment occurs when immediate release adds the most capability to populations least likely to possess a substitute. The policy ranking also depends on relative usefulness, opportunistic misuse, offense-defense conversion, defensive spillovers, safeguard friction, and nonrecallable losses. A linear benchmark yields a unique adversary-substitution threshold above which broad release overtakes control when the endpoint conditions hold. A defender-first window has value when selected defenders deploy protection before adversaries catch up, and removable safeguards remain useful when they deter enough opportunistic misuse. A nonlinear implementation gives each release tier a nonempty policy region. Three nested 2,048-point deterministic designs assess sensitivity to parameter bounds, and a separate grid examines actor-specific deployment delays after release. Release, cyber-evaluation, and incident-response cases identify the quantities a release review should estimate: actor-specific substitution times, marginal capability gains, deployment rates, defensive reach, newly enabled misuse, and nonrecallable losses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个博弈论模型,用于分析双用途AI模型的开源权重发布决策。核心论点为:限制访问仅在其延迟有害行为者超过防御者时才具有预防意义。论文引入"访问反转"(access inversion)与"非对称赋能"(asymmetric empowerment)两个关键概念,在四类发布策略(受控访问、防御者优先窗口、安全保障的开源权重、最低限制的开源权重)间进行系统比较,并通过解析结果与数值模拟给出可操作的决策框架。
AI.motivation: 当前关于AI模型是否应开放权重的政策辩论,通常假设限制访问能为防御者争取时间。然而该假设不一定成立:国家机构或有组织犯罪集团可通过窃取、蒸馏、API中介访问、独立研发或外国发布等渠道获得替代模型,而资源受限的防御者(如小型公用事业、开源维护者)可能缺乏类似途径。论文提出核心问题:"限制实际上延迟了哪些行为者?",并论证传统的"防御者先发优势"假设在行为者替代速度不对称的条件下可能失效,需要构建形式化模型以指导发布决策。
AI.method: 采用三阶段Stackelberg博弈结构:(1)实验室承诺发布策略;(2)受限制时复杂对手与防御者各自选择代价高昂的替代获取努力;(3)能力扩散并实现下游收益/损害。三类行为者:复杂对手(S)、机会主义对手(O)、分布式防御者(D)。替代获取时间建模为指数分布 T_i ~ Exp(λ_i),合并多种渠道(窃取、泄露、独立开发等)。四种策略对比:受控访问(C)、防御者优先窗口 P(τ)、安全保障开源权重(Og)、最低限制开源权重(O0)。福利函数 W(r) = ∫e^(-ρt)[b_r - H_r(t)]dt - I_r,包含五个命题:①访问反转(A_i = λ_i/ρ(λ_i+ρ));②有限视野非对称赋能(ΔC_i(H) = q_i e^(-λ_iH));③扩散反转阈值 λ_S* = ρθ/(1-θ);④防御网络外部性;⑤可信防御者窗口(收敛到零)。非线性实现采用凸损伤函数 h(Δ) = (κ_h/γ)log(1+e^(γΔ)),通过2,048点Halton低差异设计进行三套嵌套参数框的敏感性分析,并用独立网格检验发布后行为者特定的部署延迟。所有结果均确定性可复现。
AI.result: 主要解析结果:(1)命题1:当λ_S > λ_D时,限制创造正的对手访问优势;(2)命题2:在等效有用性下,λ_S > λ_D意味着释放对防御者增加更多有限视野能力;(3)命题3:线性基准下存在唯一阈值λ_S*,高于此阈值广开放优于控制;(4)命题5:防御者优先窗口的最大化序列在λ_S→∞时收敛到零,日历时长并非先发优势的证据。数值结果:在表3的基线校准下,优化得到的1.72年防御者优先窗口福利最高(-1.067),其次为安全保障开源权重(-1.112)、受控访问(-1.459)、最低限制开源权重(-1.955);2,048点设计中四类策略占比分别为43.8%、32.1%、15.9%、8.2%;每类策略均存在非空参数区域;嵌套框扫描显示策略占比对参数边界敏感。案例证据方面,2025年DeepSeek R1发布、2026年Moonshot Kimi K3、2026年7月Hugging Face事件及OpenAI报告共同说明:①权重公开发布并不消除部署差异;②托管API可能拒绝合法防御工作流;③自托管模型可保持事件制品在防御者边界内。论文识别出六个尚未测量的关键量:复杂行为者替代时间、防御者替代时间、从模型访问到部署保护的分布、低摩擦发布新启用的攻击者质量、增量防御产出、托管控制阻止合法防御工作流的频率。
AI.conclusion: 论文的核心结论是:扣留只有在延迟有害能力超过有用保护时才改善安全。λ_S > λ_D时限制产生正的对手访问优势;在等效有用性或命题2条件下,即时释放为替代较慢的群体增加更多有限视野能力。防御者优先窗口仅在选定防御者能在对手追上之前将早期访问转化为代表性部署保护时才可信;默认安全保障可威慑低能力机会主义误用,但无法约束复杂对手。论文提出"行为者延迟与边际赋能审计"作为发布决策的操作框架,要求明确决策视野、列出受影响的行为者类别、报告各群体在限制与释放下的访问概率、说明转化率背后的证据,并定义重新审议决策的触发条件(如新的外国权重发布、推理成本下降、保障被绕过、承诺缓解未部署等)。对国家安全决策,核心问题为:该限制是否改变了我们关注的那些行为者的有效访问?当国家已持有充足的不受限制替代品时,对焦点国内模型的访问限制既不消除该能力,又可能使防御者失去对等访问。建议为关键基础设施运营商和国家级事件响应者预授权应急模式或经过验证的自托管储备,以在维持常规控制的同时保留有效防御访问。论文亦指出当前证据基础无法识别模型中的福利参数,呼吁建立前瞻性的发布决策、受众覆盖、部署缓解时间、API拒绝率、替代品可用性与保障移除代价的实证记录。

title: Accountable yet Anonymous AI Agents - Split-Knowledge Binding in National Agent-Identity Layer in China
comment: Preprint v1 (pre-launch). The system described launches in Q3 2026; a revised version will add post-launch deployment measurements under the pre-registered protocol in Section 5
summary: The emerging infrastructure for AI-agent identity has converged, in industry practice and research proposals alike, on a single resolution of the tension between accountability and privacy: make every agent identifiable. We document a national system in China -- built as national infrastructure and scheduled for public launch in Q3 2026 -- that occupies a different and underexplored point in the same design space: an agent is associated with a verified legal principal without that principal being disclosed to any business-layer participant. Re-identification is possible only to a legal authority acting through due process, by separately compelling two distinct government agencies, neither of which can re-identify alone. We name the mechanism split-knowledge binding and are candid that it is conditional: the separation is structural and procedural, not cryptographic, and a state empowered to compel both agencies can re-identify. The paper makes five contributions: (1) split-knowledge binding, an institutional rather than cryptographic separation for escrowed accountability; (2) the ex-post attribution thesis, the argued claim that only attribution-based accountability carries legal force for AI agent actions with legal consequences; (3) the accountability surface, a design concept identifying which agent actions leave identity-bearing traces; (4) a proportionality framework for identity escrow, a decision structure selecting among three trust architectures; and (5) the reflexive jurisdiction method, an evaluative standard administered to the paper's own deployment. The system is evidence of feasibility at national scale; the framework is the instrument by which any deployment -- including this one -- should be judged.

AI.tldr: 本文针对AI智能体身份识别中问责制与隐私的张力问题，提出一种区别于完全可识别的替代方案。中国计划于2026年第三季度上线一套国家AI智能体身份基础设施，采用"分离知识绑定"(split-knowledge binding)机制：通过机构性（非密码学）分权，使每个智能体关联到经核验的法律主体，但该主体身份不向业务层任何参与者披露；只有通过法定程序同时强制要求两个独立的政府部门，才能完成重识别。论文提出五项贡献，并强调该机制是有条件的——分权是结构性与程序性的，强制性国家仍可重识别。
AI.motivation: 产业实践与研究界在AI智能体身份问题上普遍倾向于"使每个智能体完全可识别"，以解决问责制与隐私之间的张力，但这一方案在隐私保护方面代价巨大。本文质疑这一共识，探索设计空间中一个被低估的替代点：在不向业务层披露主体身份的前提下，实现可追责的智能体问责机制。同时，论文对自身所处的部署背景（司法管辖区）保持方法论上的自觉性。
AI.method: 方法论核心是一种"机构性分权"设计模式，而非传统密码学方案。具体设计要点包括：(1) 分离知识绑定——智能体与经核验的法律主体关联，但身份通过两个相互独立的政府部门分别保管信息片段，任何单一部门无法独自完成重识别；(2) 通过法律程序需同时强制两个机构方可重识别，构成结构性+程序性分离。论文同时提出五种分析工具：分离知识绑定机制本身、事后归责命题(归责型问责方具法律效力)、问责面(accountability surface)设计概念、身份托管的比例性框架(在三种信任架构间选择)、反身性司法管辖方法(对自身部署的评估标准)。
AI.result: 论文的首要实证贡献是记录并证明一种全国规模智能体身份基础设施的可行性——中国将于2026年Q3公开上线该系统。作为证据，它表明AI智能体在不直接披露法律主体身份的情况下，可实现基于归责的可问责性。理论层面，系统化提出五项概念/命题贡献：(1) 分离知识绑定作为可问责托管的机构性而非密码学分权；(2) 事后归责命题——只有基于归责的问责对具有法律后果的智能体行动具备法律效力；(3) 问责面概念——识别哪些智能体行为留下身份痕迹；(4) 身份托管的比例性决策框架(在三种信任架构间选择)；(5) 反身性司法管辖方法——论文对自身部署进行评估的方法论自觉。
AI.conclusion: 该系统作为全国规模部署的证据证明了可行性路径；所提出的框架（包括反身性司法管辖方法）则是评估任何部署——包括本文所描述的部署本身——的评判工具。论文坦承其方案是有条件的：分权属结构性与程序性保障，而非密码学强保证，拥有强制两个机构权力的国家行为体仍可实现重识别。整体结论是：问责制与隐私的张力存在第三种设计路径，该路径的有效性需通过比例性框架与反身性司法管辖标准联合评判。

title: Constitutional governance for societies of AI agents in the built environment: a research agenda
comment: 23 pages, 2 figures. Supplementary material is included in the same PDF
summary: The built environment is on the cusp of populating itself with autonomous artificial agents. AI systems that advise, control and coordinate are being deployed across retrofit, operation and mobility faster than their collective behaviour is studied. The dominant framing treats each agent as a tool operating on a passive building, governance reduced to single-agent safety, which is inadequate. A building, a street, or a city is more accurately modelled as a society of negotiating agents: occupants, owners, operators, regulators, and the artificial agents increasingly acting on their behalf. Their interactions are strategic, their information asymmetric, and the outcomes that matter are properties of the whole. The paper proposes a research agenda for constitutional multi-agent governance of the built environment, organised around three problems: mechanism design for retrofit under deep uncertainty, treating public subsidy as a mechanism component; physics-informed verification of agents in building operations; and antifragile coordination for urban infrastructure under shocks. Drawing on three decades of multi-agent systems research, the paper sets out conceptual foundations, works one governance event through in detail, identifies twelve open problems, and outlines what the agenda requires in data, computation, disciplinary integration and governance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一项面向"建成环境"的人工智能治理研究议程，主张将建筑、街道或城市建模为由多方利益相关者（使用者、业主、运营方、监管者及其AI代理）构成的"协商主体社会"，围绕三大核心问题展开：深度不确定性下的改造机制设计（含公共补贴作为机制组件）、建筑运营中代理的物理一致性验证、以及城市基础设施在冲击下的反脆弱协调。
AI.motivation: 当前AI系统在建成环境（改造、运营、交通）中的部署速度远超对其集体行为的研究。主流框架仍将每个AI代理视为作用于被动建筑的"工具"，把治理简化为单代理安全问题，这一范式不足以应对战略性互动、信息不对称以及系统整体涌现属性所带来的挑战。
AI.method: 基于三十年多智能体系统（MAS）研究积淀，构建概念基础；以"治理事件"为单位展开一个详细案例推演；将研究议程结构化为三大问题，并进一步分解为十二个开放问题；最后从数据、计算、学科融合与治理制度四个维度提出议程所需支撑条件。
AI.result: 提出"宪制化多智能体治理"框架：①将公共补贴纳入改造机制设计；②在物理一致性约束下验证运营代理行为；③以反脆弱性为目标设计城市基础设施协调机制；并明确列出十二个待解决的开放问题，以及实现该议程在数据基础设施、计算能力、跨学科整合与治理制度方面的具体需求。
AI.conclusion: 建成环境的AI治理必须从"单代理安全"范式转向"多代理宪制治理"范式，把建筑—街道—城市视作策略性互动的社会系统；该研究议程为学界与政策制定者提供了从理论概念到落地路径的系统路线图，亟需数据、算力、跨学科与制度层面的协同投入。

title: Private Again: AI Agents Restore Anonymity---Foreclosing Discrimination and Its Proof
summary: AI agents can transact online on behalf of a human principal---browsing, paying, receiving, and reviewing---without linking a transaction to a principal. That architecture starves algorithmic discrimination of its inputs---identity, purchase history, location history, behavioral traces, and demographic proxies---but also forecloses its proof. Disparate-treatment needs comparators; disparate-impact needs protected-class baselines; and Iqbal-era pleading needs specific factual allegations---doctrinal predicates that anonymous transactions never generate. The effects fall asymmetrically: those most vulnerable to discrimination are least able to afford the shield and, when harms remain, least able to prove them. The challenge for the law shifts from detecting and remedying algorithmic discrimination to governing agent-mediated anonymity as civil rights infrastructure: ensuring access to privacy-preserving agents, regulating abuse without forced identification, and deciding whether retailers may refuse to deal with agents at all.

AI.tldr: 本文提出，AI代理可为人类委托人进行匿名在线交易，这种架构虽消除了算法歧视赖以运作的数据输入（身份、购买历史、位置、行为痕迹等），却同时也摧毁了民权法证明歧视所需的事实基础——差异对待需要可比人、差异影响需要受保护类别基线、Iqbal时代的诉状标准需要具体事实主张。由于保护与证明不可兼得且效应不对称地落在最脆弱群体身上，法律的挑战从"发现并救济算法歧视"转向"将代理介导的匿名性作为公民权利基础设施进行治理"。
AI.motivation: 每次信息技术浪潮都引发对隐私侵蚀的焦虑（印刷机、电报、电话、信用卡）。本文关注一个潜在的"反转"——AI代理可能让用户被看得更少、被记住得更少。但其对民权的意义是双面的：匿名性一方面瓦解算法歧视，另一方面瓦解民权法的检测—证明—救济架构。论文试图揭示这种不对称效应，并探讨法律应如何应对。
AI.method: 采用法律教义学分析（legal-doctrinal analysis）方法。论文分两部分展开：第一部分（Part I）从三个层次追踪AI代理对民权法的结构性影响——A.歧视被剥夺输入数据（移除身份、代理变量、行为痕迹）；B.证明被剥夺证据（差异对待需可比人、差异影响需受保护类别统计基线）；C.诉状被剥夺事实（Iqbal/Twombly诉状标准下的"封闭循环"）。第二部分（Part II）依次提出三个规范问题：(a)是否将代理介导的匿名性视为公民权利基础设施（类比法律援助、EEOC、公共图书馆、普遍服务、Gideon案）；(b)如何在不强制识别的情况下规制滥用（对比KYC/AML、丝绸之路监管、加密通信监管）；(c)零售商是否可以拒绝与代理交易（类比公共住宿法、强制识别制度的历史）。结合教义分析、历史类比（殖民时期通行证法、选民身份证法）与政策推理。
AI.result: 论文揭示了三重"饥饿效应"与一个"教义封闭循环"：(1) AI代理通过充当"空壳"剥夺算法歧视的全部输入，使代理歧视（proxy discrimination）结构性坍塌；(2) 差异对待无法证明（缺乏可比人）、差异影响无法证明（缺乏统计基线）、Iqbal诉状无法通过（缺乏具体事实），形成"原告无法诉说她所不知道的、无法知道她无法发现的、无法在诉状之前发现"的封闭循环；(3) 效应不对称——最易受歧视者最负担不起保护性代理，受害后也最难证明。歧视机器不会消失，只会从针对受保护类别转向针对未能部署"盾牌"的残余可见人群。论文还指出，零售商拒绝与代理交易在功能上等同于要求每位购买者证明身份，与历史上的强制识别制度（通行证法、选民身份证）在结构上类似。
AI.conclusion: 法律的中心任务从检测和救济算法歧视，转向将代理介导的匿名性作为公民权利基础设施加以治理。具体路径包括：(1) 确保隐私保护型代理的可及性（公共提供、补贴或平台义务提供，类比普遍服务、公共图书馆、Gideon案获得律师的权利）；(2) 在交易层面之上（网关处代理提供者的审计义务）和之下（事前保险与分配性补偿）构建监管架构，而非在交易内部强制识别；(3) 直面零售商禁令问题——私人合同自由与反歧视承诺的张力如何解决，是下一代商业监管必须回答的问题。匿名性回归商业既是民权的胜利，也对其证据基础构成威胁，法律的回应将决定这一新基础设施能否持续存在。

title: State-dependent error correlations shape voting thresholds in committees of AI agents
summary: The aggregation benefit of a committee of artificial intelligence (AI) agents comes from complementary information across members. Classical voting guarantees assume independent errors. Language-model errors often co-occur on the same cases. We combine Sah-Stiglitz screening with error dependence that can differ between good and bad cases. In a homogeneous exchangeable Gaussian-copula model, shared errors create a positive asymptotic error floor for majority voting and can change the approval threshold that minimizes expected loss. We estimate a heterogeneous extension from 174,384 votes cast by 28 language models on four binary-screening benchmarks. Parameters estimated from odd-indexed items predicted committee loss on even-indexed items. For the sampled committee composition, the full-matrix dependence model increased identity-line R^2 from 0.840 under independence to 0.967. In a design-balanced analysis, cost-sensitive threshold selection under independence reduced scaled loss from 60.25 for majority to 52.50. Modeling dependence reduced it further to 50.77, an incremental improvement of 1.73 units (95% bootstrap CI, 0.68-2.33). The overall reduction from majority was 15.73% (95% bootstrap CI, 13.41-16.75%).

AI.tldr: 本文将Sah-Stiglitz筛选框架与可状态依赖的误差相关性建模相结合,并基于28个语言模型在4个二元筛选基准上的174,384次投票进行实证验证,证明显式建模误差相关性可显著提升AI委员会投票的损失预测与阈值选择效果。
AI.motivation: 经典投票理论(如Condorcet多数定理、Sah-Stiglitz筛选)建立在误差独立假设之上,但语言模型在同一案例上的错误往往高度共现且依赖案例质量状态(好/坏)。已有研究观察到模型错误存在显著相关性,但将其作为委员会设计的可测输入纳入统一框架尚属空白。理解状态条件相关性如何影响投票阈值选择与错误下界,是构建AI委员会设计规则的关键。
AI.method: (1)理论层面:构建同质可交换Gaussian-copula(Vasicek)模型,将状态相关性ρ_θ引入k-of-n阈值规则的损失函数,得到顺序统计量分解表达式;(2)异质扩展:通过四分相关逆估计每位智能体的状态条件边际概率与配对潜在相关矩阵Σ_G、Σ_B;(3)实证层面:在4个二元筛选基准(事实核查、数学解验证、代码审查、真实性筛查)上收集28个语言模型(20个开源+8个API)在温度0与0.7下的174,384票,以奇数索引项估计参数、偶数项验证损失;(4)设计均衡分析:在20个领域×池类型×规模单元上执行1000次bootstrap复制,使用65536个对偶公共随机数以公平比较完全矩阵依赖模型、独立模型与多数投票。
AI.result: (1)完全矩阵依赖模型将恒等线R²从独立的0.840提升至0.967(RMSE 0.088 vs 0.193);(2)设计均衡分析中,多数投票缩放损失为60.25,成本敏感阈值(独立模型)降至52.50,纳入依赖结构后进一步降至50.77;(3)相对多数投票总损失降低15.73%(95% CI:13.41%-16.75%),其中81.73%来自阈值选择,18.27%来自依赖建模;(4)两模型在40.90%的加权委员会-成本组合中选择不同阈值,表明依赖结构改变了实际最优组织设计;(5)开源跨家族配对平均潜在相关性约为0.58-0.60,意味着多数投票在无限委员会极限下仍保留21%-90%的单智能体错误。
AI.conclusion: 本研究建立了将测量所得的误差相关性作为委员会设计输入的理论与实证桥梁:(1)相关性削弱了极端阈值规则(层级与多元制)的保护功能并在多数投票下产生不可消除的Vasicek错误下界;(2)成本加权的最优阈值严格依赖于状态条件相关结构;(3)在四个二元筛选基准上,纳入状态条件依赖的阈值选择在留出项上一致优于多数投票与独立假设下的阈值选择,为AI委员会的事实核查、代码审查等应用提供了经测量的、状态条件的设计规则。所提出的framework可直接用于量化多元智能体系统、模型即评委评估与模型部署门控中的相关性风险。

title: On Capturing the Narrative: Social Media Manipulation Wargaming for Cyberliteracy
comment: 7 pages, 1 figure. Paper is under review
summary: Misinformation is deeply embedded in online discourse, with nearly one in five posts during global events generated by bots that amplify false content. In recent years, the use of Generative AI has further lowered the barrier to producing convincing misinformation, yet most digital literacy education still relies on static checklists and single-player inoculation games built for an earlier media landscape. This paper describes how we addressed this educational gap through Capture the Narrative, a four-week multi-university competition in which student teams build LLM-powered bots to influence a simulated election. We report on our custom social-media platform, the competition environment and design of its 4,000 AI-driven Non-Player Character (NPC) citizens, and what running Capture the Narrative at scale actually involved. In our first iteration, 108 teams from 18 Australian universities produced 7,068,206 player-bot posts, approximately 60% of all platform content. We surveyed 256 students before and 83 after the competition to understand their perceptions of misinformation and the game itself and found that students did not become more confident at spotting bots, contrary to what inoculation theory predicts. Because engagement was rewarded, most teams prioritised high-volume posting over nuanced influence, mirroring real-world platform dynamics. We close with recommendations for educators considering similar interventions, and propose future improvements, such as including a blue-team defensive phase.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了"Capture the Narrative"（CTN）——一项为期四周的跨校竞赛，学生团队通过构建LLM驱动的社交媒体机器人在模拟选举中争夺话语权。研究部署了自定义社交平台与4000个LLM驱动的NPC公民，108支队伍生成超过706万条帖子，但发现参与者识别机器人的信心未提升，且对传播虚假信息的情绪不适感反而下降。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI大幅降低了制造逼真虚假信息的门槛，但现有数字素养教育仍依赖静态清单和为旧媒体环境设计的单人"接种游戏"，无法应对GenAI驱动的高动态、多代理、大规模自动化影响操作。论文旨在填补这一教育空白。
AI.method: 作者构建了定制社交平台"Legit Social"、虚构的Kingston选举场景和4000个由LLM驱动、具有40维人口统计与态度画像的NPC公民（含7个特殊角色如记者、候选人等），通过有限状态机控制行为与观点更新。108支队伍来自18所澳大利亚大学，每队最多运营41个账户（含40个PC机器人），通过Python API编程操控平台互动。评分系统包含"故事分数"（追踪NPC态度/投票变化）和"互动分数"（点赞、转发、热门推荐）。前后调查比较了256名（前）和83名（后）学生的态度变化，采用Wilcoxon符号秩检验与主题编码分析。
AI.result: 竞赛产出了7,068,206条机器人帖子（约占平台内容60%）。统计检验显示：识别机器人信心、对其频率与影响力的感知均无显著变化（与接种理论预测相反）；参与者情绪不适感（内疚、遗憾、羞耻等）显著衰减（p从9.2×10⁻⁷到1.3×10⁻⁵）；59%的受访者无法区分系统NPC与对手机器人；由于互动分数奖励高产量，部分团队从"微妙影响"策略转向大规模刷帖，与真实平台动态高度相似。
AI.conclusion: CTN虽在大规模部署上成功，但未能实现预期的机器人识别接种效果，反而暴露了参与者在低风险竞争环境中情绪摩擦被侵蚀的问题。文章呼吁超越静态清单式素养培训，建议未来迭代引入蓝队防御阶段、重新设计以影响质量而非产量为核心的评分机制、采用结构化周度复盘，并扩大招募范围以纳入非技术背景参与者，从而同时应对虚假内容识别与制造背后的心理和系统性驱动因素。

title: Beyond Exact Match: How Evaluation Methodology Dominates Model Choice in LLM-Based Product Attribute Extraction
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. Preprint under review. Code available at this https URL
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have become a default choice for structured product attribute extraction in e-commerce pipelines, with practitioners reporting widely varying performance across models, datasets, and prompting strategies. This paper presents a controlled empirical study comparing four prompting strategies -- zero-shot, few-shot, schema-guided, and definition-augmented -- across two production-grade LLMs (GPT-4o-mini and Gemini 2.5 Flash) on the MAVE benchmark. We evaluate 6,400 attribute-level predictions using both exact and fuzzy string matching, and conduct a rigorous noise audit of the ground truth labels. We formally decompose F1 variance across four experimental factors and find that evaluation methodology produces variance approximately 23 times larger than model choice and 5 times larger than prompting strategy choice. We further establish that the MAVE benchmark exhibits a 23.2% ground truth noise rate against modern LLM outputs. Paired permutation tests (B=10,000) confirm that the inter-protocol F1 gap is highly significant (p<0.0001) and Cohen's kappa of 0.769 between protocols indicates substantial agreement. We conclude that for production attribute extraction pipelines, evaluation methodology and data quality dominate the impact of model selection and prompt engineering.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过在 MAVE 基准上对两种成本高效的生产级 LLM（GPT-4o-mini 和 Gemini 2.5 Flash）使用四种提示策略（zero-shot、few-shot、schema-guided、definition-augmented）进行受控实证研究（6,400 条属性级预测），系统性地揭示了**评估方法（精确匹配 vs 模糊匹配）对报告 F1 的影响远大于模型选择或提示策略**——前者产生的方差约为后两者的 23 倍和 5 倍。同时通过对 MAVE 基准进行噪声审计，发现其标注相对现代 LLM 输出存在 23.2% 的噪声率。论文建议将模糊匹配（τ≥80）或 LLM-as-judge 作为 LLM 抽取任务的标准评估协议。
AI.motivation: LLM 已成为电商结构化产品属性抽取的默认方案，但实践中报告的性能差异巨大（如 ExtractGPT 在 GPT-4 上报告 F1≈0.91，而该研究在成本高效模型上得到 F1≈0.50）。这种巨大差距促使作者探究两个方法论问题：(H1) 评估方法是否在性能差异中占据主导地位？(H2) 公开基准的标注对现代 LLM 输出是否存在显著噪声？即究竟应归因于模型能力还是评估方式/数据质量。
AI.method: 1) 在 MAVE 基准上分层采样 N=200 个产品（5 个类别各 40 个），抽取 4 个属性（brand/color/size/material）；2) 使用 2 个 LLM（GPT-4o-mini、Gemini 2.5 Flash）×4 种提示策略（zero-shot/few-shot/schema-guided/definition-augmented），共生成 6,400 条属性级预测；3) 采用两种评估协议：精确匹配（EM）与基于 Levenshtein 部分比率的模糊匹配（FM, τ=80）；4) 形式化噪声率 η=P(语义正确|EM 失败)=|F_EM ∩ S_FM|/|F_EM|；5) 通过 F1 跨度（max−min）分解各因素方差；6) 统计检验包括 B=10,000 次配对置换检验、95% bootstrap 置信区间、Cohen's κ 一致性度量。
AI.result: **核心定量结果**：(1) 评估协议产生的 F1 方差 ΔF1=0.121，约为模型选择（ΔF1=0.005）的 **23 倍**、提示策略（ΔF1=0.024）的 **5 倍**（p<0.0001, κ=0.769）；(2) MAVE 基准噪声率 η=0.232（737/3172），即近 1/4 的精确匹配失败实为语义正确（50 个样本人工核查全部确认）；(3) 两个模型在模糊匹配下 F1 几乎等价（GPT-4o-mini 0.617 vs Gemini 0.622，p=0.047 但 CI 重叠）；(4) 提示策略对 GPT-4o-mini 无影响（p=1.0），但 few-shot 对 Gemini 显著优于 schema-guided（ΔF1=0.024, p=0.003）；(5) 属性层面 Brand F1=1.0，Material 仅约 0.40，属性间差距（ΔF1=0.614）远超可控因素；(6) 类别间 Sports（0.74）与 Electronics（0.46）差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 对于生产环境中的属性抽取流水线，**评估方法和数据质量的主导影响远超模型选择和提示工程**。论文提出实践者决策框架：优先投资评估协议（推荐模糊匹配 τ≥80 或 LLM-as-judge），其次数据质量，最后才是模型与提示优化；同时建议未来基准设计在构造真值标签时应考虑 LLM 输出的格式多样性，并采用模糊匹配或语义相似性作为默认评估协议。研究局限包括：仅覆盖 MAVE 1,257 个类别中的 5 个；仅评估成本高效模型（不适用于 GPT-4 等前沿模型）；单一模糊匹配阈值 τ=80；API 模型可能存在静默更新（实验时间为 2026 年 6 月）。

title: When Does Few-Shot Prompting Help? A Systematic Empirical Study of Shot-Count Effects Across Model Scale, Architecture, and Output Parsing Robustness
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, 8 tables. Code available at this https URL
summary: Few-shot prompting, the practice of prepending a small number of input-output demonstration pairs to a query before presenting it to a large language model (LLM), is among the most widely adopted inference-time techniques in NLP. Yet little systematic work investigates how shot count interacts with model scale, architecture, and output format compliance in determining classification performance. This paper presents a controlled study of five LLMs across six shot-count configurations (k in {0,1,2,3,5,8}) on the AG News four-class benchmark (n=200). Our models span proprietary and open-source families: Gemini Flash Lite, GPT-4o-mini, Llama 3.1 8B, Llama 3.3 70B, and Llama 4 Scout 17B. We report macro-averaged F1 with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals (B=10,000), permutation-test p-values, and Cohen's d effect sizes across all 30 configurations. Our findings reveal four qualitatively distinct behavioral regimes: (1) models already well-calibrated at zero-shot that show modest, statistically insignificant gains (Gemini, GPT-4o-mini); (2) models that undergo catastrophic zero-shot failure but recover dramatically with a single example (Llama 3.1 8B, d=10.98, p<0.0001); (3) models optimal at zero-shot that degrade monotonically with additional examples (Llama 4 Scout); and (4) models exhibiting a U-shaped curve (Llama 3.3 70B: 0-shot F1=0.907, 2-shot F1=0.635, 5-shot F1=0.785 with parser corrected). We additionally identify, diagnose, and correct a systematic parsing artifact that artificially deflated Llama 3.3 70B performance by up to 206%, constituting a methodological contribution to LLM evaluation practice. Our results demonstrate that the relationship between shot count and classification performance is not monotonic, not universal, and not predictable from model scale alone.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究了少样本提示（few-shot prompting）中样本数k对大语言模型分类性能的影响，跨越5个LLM、6个shot数配置、AG News四分类任务（n=200）。研究识别出四种定性不同的行为机制（calibrated performer、format-dependent learner、zero-shot specialist、prior-dominated learner），并发现了一个新现象——Llama 3.3 70B的U型性能曲线，以及一个导致性能评估虚高的解析伪影（parsing artifact，最多虚低206%）。核心结论：shot数与性能的关系是非单调、非通用、不可仅从模型规模预测的。
AI.motivation: 少样本提示虽已被广泛采用，但其经验基础在三个方面理解不足：(1) shot数是否单调改善性能；(2) 该关系是否依赖于模型规模或架构；(3) 输出格式合规性如何与表观少样本性能交互。传统统计学习理论认为增加数据降低估计误差，但in-context learning并非传统意义的学习——权重冻结、示例仅作为分布锚点、格式模板和标签空间说明。作者通过受控实验解决这三个问题。
AI.method: 实验设计：5个LLM × 6个shot数（k∈{0,1,2,3,5,8}）= 30个配置；数据集为AG News四分类，n=200（seed=42）。模型涵盖专有API（Gemini Flash Lite、GPT-4o-mini）与开源（Grok上的Llama 3.1 8B Instant、Llama 3.3 70B Versatile、Llama 4 Scout 17B 16e Instruct）。推理配置：temperature=0（贪心解码），max_tokens=20。统计框架：macro-averaged F1 + 95% bootstrap CI（B=10,000）+ permutation检验（R=10,000）+ Cohen's d效应量。提示模板采用确定性构造以控制排序效应，演示池从训练集分离抽取并按类别排序。关键方法论贡献：识别并修正了substring匹配解析器的系统性伪影，改用正则模糊提取（regex fuzzy extraction），将Llama 3.3 70B在k=5时的PFR从76%降至2%。
AI.result:
识别出四种定性不同的行为机制：
- Regime I（校准型，Gemini、GPT-4o-mini）：零样本已强（>0.84 F1），演示带来微弱不显著增益（Gemini峰值F1=0.9217@k=2，GPT-4o-mini峰值F1=0.8970@k=8）；
- Regime II（格式依赖型，Llama 3.1 8B）：零样本灾难性失败（F1=0.525，接近随机），单样本即恢复至F1=0.8646，2样本达峰F1=0.8664，但8样本崩溃至F1=0.5530（Cohen's d=10.98, p<0.0001）；
- Regime III（零样本专精型，Llama 4 Scout）：零样本最优F1=0.8771，所有非零shot均导致退化，振荡明显（可能与MoE架构的专家路由敏感性有关）；
- Regime IV（先验主导型，Llama 3.3 70B）：U型曲线——0-shot F1=0.9066 → 2-shot F1=0.6351（谷底）→ 5-shot F1=0.785（部分恢复），所有非零shot均显著低于零样本（p<0.0001）。
提出"演示干扰+格式重锚"双力机制解释U型曲线：低shot触发推理介入干扰标签精度，高shot通过格式一致性部分恢复但不能回到零样本水平。解析伪影分析：原始substring parser在Llama 3.3 70B的k=5时PFR达76%，导致虚低F1=0.2563（真实为0.7850），测量伪影幅度（ΔF1≈0.53）超过真实信号幅度（ΔF1≈0.27）。提出按"先验强度×格式破坏敏感性"两轴划分的四分类法（Table VIII）。
AI.conclusion: 核心结论：shot数与分类性能的关系非单调、非通用、不可仅从模型规模预测。最佳实践：(1) 没有单一通用最优k值，k=0到k=8都可成为某模型最优；(2) 必须按模型empirically profile其shot-count曲线，零样本F1>0.85可能属Regime I/IV应避免few-shot，<0.70可能属Regime II需1-2示例；(3) 必须实现稳健正则解析器并报告PFR作为强制性透明度指标；(4) 解析器引入的误差可超过真实现象幅度，评估方法学本身是一类科学关切。Gemini Flash Lite @ k=2综合最优（F1=0.9217, $0.02），免费开源中最优为Llama 3.3 70B @ 0-shot（F1=0.9066，需稳健解析器）。局限：单一数据集、n=200（对小效应统计功效不足，需n≥700检测0.04 F1差异）、固定演示选择、未含微调基线、shot上限k=8。未来工作包括多数据集泛化、注意力机制分析、MoE路由分析、扩展shot范围、解析器系统性比较。

title: EGR: Embedding-Native Generative Retrieval with a Shared LLM
summary: Generative retrieval is increasingly popular in large-scale recommendation and advertising systems, yet current methods introduce practical complications. Semantic-ID methods rely on quantization, mutable identifier vocabularies, and token-to-item grounding; embedding-based pipelines train the item encoder separately from the query generator, which limits user-item alignment. We propose EGR, an Embedding-Native Generative Retrieval framework for recommendation and advertising. EGR uses a single shared LLM to learn item representations from item metadata and user representations from interaction histories in one embedding space. Items are indexed directly as dense vectors, and user histories are encoded as dense retrieval queries. Joint contrastive training groups related items and aligns queries with their target items. We evaluate EGR on public benchmarks, industrial data, and live deployment. EGR outperforms published baselines on Amazon Reviews; on Snap DPA, it scales with data, handles cold-start items, and benefits from multimodal input. In production, EGR delivers a +2.91% conversion-rate lift, simplifying system design while improving retrieval quality and ad performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EGR（Embedding-Native Generative Retrieval）框架，使用单一共享 LLM 联合学习商品嵌入和用户查询嵌入，绕过语义 ID 量化和独立编码器训练，在 Amazon Reviews 和 Snap DPA 工业场景中均取得最优效果，并在线 A/B 测试中实现 +2.91% 的转化率提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的生成式检索方法存在两大问题：（1）基于语义 ID（SID）的方法依赖量化、可变的标识符词表以及 token-to-item 的 grounding 机制，系统复杂且难以处理新商品；（2）基于嵌入的方法将商品编码器和查询生成器分开训练，导致商品索引空间在查询侧训练前就已固定，用户-商品对齐成为后验问题。论文旨在通过共享 LLM 联合学习商品与用户表征，消除这两类缺陷。
AI.method: EGR 采用单一共享 LLM（Qwen3-VL-Embedding 2B + LoRA + 两层 MLP 投影头）作为双路径骨干网络：（1）商品路径——将商品元数据（标题、品牌、类别、图像）编码为 L2 归一化的 512 维向量直接写入 ANN 索引；（2）用户历史路径——将按时间排序的交互序列（含 view/add_to_cart/purchase 转换类型 token）编码为查询向量。训练采用两个对比损失的联合优化：IRL（同用户共交互商品对的对称 InfoNCE，用于塑造商品空间）和 NIP（从用户历史到目标商品嵌入的 InfoNCE，并在目标端施加 stop-gradient 以稳定索引空间）。训练策略采用前 10% 步仅用 IRL 预热，之后 NIP 权重 λt 从 0.1 线性升至 1.0 的两阶段调度。推理时通过最大内积 ANN 检索。
AI.result: （1）在 Amazon Reviews 的 Beauty、Sports、Toys 三个类目上，EGR 在 Recall@10 上均优于 BERT4Rec、SASRec、TIGER、HSTU 等基线，尤其在 Toys 上以 0.0807 大幅超越次优基线 0.0626；（2）在 Snap DPA 工业数据上，R@10 随训练用户量从 10K 增至 10M 呈单调上升（+27%），无饱和迹象；（3）冷启动商品（训练中从未出现）的 R@10 仅比头部频次桶低 5.1%，且多模态（文本+图像）输入相对纯文本带来 +6.9% 提升；（4）消融实验验证了 IRL+NIP 联合训练（100%）、移除 stop-gradient（95.3%）、仅 NIP（93.7%）、仅 IRL（26.6%）、双模型分离训练（86.2%）的相对效果差异，证实联合训练与 stop-gradient 的必要性；（5）损失调度消融显示 Joint 调度（100%）优于 Balanced（97.9%）和 Sequential（74.4%）；（6）为期两周、10%/10% 流量的线上 A/B 测试中，EGR 带来曝光 +0.15%、CTR +0.23%、CVR +2.91% 的提升，最终已全量上线服务 100% 用户。
AI.conclusion: EGR 证明了"嵌入原生"生成式检索的可行性——通过共享 LLM 联合优化商品索引空间和用户查询空间，无需语义 ID 量化或分离编码器，即可同时获得系统简洁性和检索质量提升。该框架在公开基准、工业数据和在线部署中均表现优异，展示了 LLM 预训练先验对多模态泛化和冷启动鲁棒性的价值，并为大规模推荐/广告系统的生成式检索提供了一条更简洁且高效的实践路径。

title: Towards a Relevance Posterior in Neural Information Access
summary: Modern information retrieval systems typically operationalise relevance as a query-conditional score computed at inference time. This design choice has become dominant such that alternative decompositions of relevance are rarely discussed, despite the long history of document and query priors in probabilistic retrieval and large-scale search. As neural ranking models grow more computationally expensive and retrieval pipelines expand to include multi-stage ranking, recommendation, and retrieval-augmented generation, this monolithic view of query-time scoring becomes increasingly limiting. We argue that modern information access systems are more naturally understood as performing approximate posterior inference, in which relevance is refined through a staged combination of query-dependent likelihoods and query-independent priors. We extend classical probabilistic retrieval formalisms to contemporary learned systems and show how explicit likelihood-prior decomposition exposes new opportunities to shift computation offline while disentangling document-level and interaction-level beliefs. We present empirical evidence that incorporating query-independent document utility can complement existing rankers and improve effectiveness with minimal query-time computation (solely score fusion). Concretely, a learned prior improves first-stage retrieval through rank fusion (up to 0.046 nDCG@10 on TREC DL-2019 and 0.029 nDCG@10 on TREC DL-2020) and also improves downstream re-ranking, with the largest gains observed for the LLM re-ranker RankZephyr (up to 0.054 nDCG@10 on TREC DL-2020). Finally, we discuss how this decomposition connects to broader information access and outline research directions for designing retrieval systems that explicitly allocate modelling capacity between offline priors and online interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文主张将现代信息检索系统重新理解为对相关性后验的近似推断，提出显式的"先验-似然"分解框架，将查询无关的文档效用（prior）与查询条件下的交互证据（likelihood）解耦，通过离线缓存的文档先验改善检索效率与效果，并桥接经典概率检索与神经检索、推荐系统等更广泛的信息访问场景。
AI.motivation: 现代神经检索系统通常将相关性建模为查询时计算的单标量分数，将几乎所有不确定性置于严格的延迟约束下解决。但许多文档侧的信念（如质量、权威、可读性）在查询间是稳定的，可离线估计并跨查询复用。端到端联合优化将这些稳定的文档侧规律与查询意图信号纠缠在同一参数中，造成在线计算的重复浪费。需要一个形式化框架来明确区分哪些证据应离线摊销、哪些必须在线计算。
AI.method: 1) 理论：将检索形式化为基于相关性后验 p(d|q) 的近似推断，沿用经典查询似然分解 p(d|q) ∝ p(q|d)p(d)，并将多阶段检索视为消息传递式的后验逐步细化 p^{(i)}(d|q) ∝ p^{(i-1)}(d|q) · ℓ_i(d;q)；2) 实证：采用 Chang et al. (2024) 预训练的 QualT5 系列（Tiny/Small/Base，T5 编解码器架构）作为查询无关的文档效用打分器 u_φ(d) ≈ log p̃_φ(d)；在 MSMARCO Passage 上对 TREC DL-2019 和 DL-2020 进行评估；以 BM25 和 SPLADE 作为第一阶段检索器，通过对数空间加性融合 S_add(q,d) = s_θ(q,d) + γ·u_φ(d)（固定 γ=1.0，非校准设置）注入先验；下游采用 MonoELECTRA 交叉编码器和 RankZephyr（基于 Zephyr 的列表式 LLM 重排器，窗口 20、步长 10）进行重排；与索引剪枝（剔除底部 20 百分位）对比；3) 分类法：建立表 1，将词汇/稠密/多阶段/RAG 检索统一表征为先验-似然-近似算子三元组。
AI.result: BM25 融合下，所有 QualT5 变体在第一阶段均显著提升：DL-2019 上 nDCG@10 从 0.4737 提升至最高 0.5195（+0.046，QualT5-Small），DL-2020 从 0.4712 提升至最高 0.5002（+0.029，QualT5-Small）；SPLADE 融合则在第一阶段有显著退化（如 DL-2020 从 0.7204 降至 0.6502），但重排后 RankZephyr 仍获得最大增益（DL-2020 上 nDCG@10 +0.054，从 0.6233 至 0.6774）；MAP 和 R@1000 分析显示融合保留学段池而非缩减；定性分析表明先验对导航式/定义式查询增益更显著，对开放式探索查询偶有轻微退化；融合在几乎所有重排设置中均优于索引剪枝。
AI.conclusion: 显式的先验-似然分解为现代神经信息访问系统提供了模块化设计语言，使离线摊销与在线推理之间的建模容量分配成为显式设计变量。离线学习的查询无关文档效用可在零边际查询成本下作为一阶模块化组件补充现有排序器，对基于 LLM 的重排器和 RAG 系统尤为有益；推荐系统与检索可纳入统一的后验框架（p(d|q,u) ∝ p(q|d)p(d|u)p(d)）；未来研究方向包括先验容量与下游成本的最优配比、候选集与重排深度的联合优化、语料漂移下的独立更新、跨语料先验迁移、控制面（多样性、安全、个性化）的表达与审计等。

title: Melo: A Production LLM-Powered Music Recommendation Agent
summary: We describe Melo, an LLM-powered music recommendation agent deployed on NetEase Cloud Music. Melo is structured as a deterministic five-node state graph over heterogeneous tools, with a prompt- and state-machine-driven orchestration policy rather than a fine-tuned controller. At industrial scale, the bottleneck is not how smart the brain is but how the system detects and recovers from the mistakes that brain makes. Two production failure modes drove the design: entity hallucination, where the agent commits to interpretations unsupported by the live catalog or user-behavior index, and long-tail degradation, where over-constrained requests collapse to generic popular fallbacks. We address them with two complementary mechanisms. Inference-time entity grounding repurposes the production search index as a verification primitive that gates entity decisions before they propagate downstream. Reflective retry verbalizes failure reasons from a broken tool chain and feeds them into the next planning step, so the system can relax or revise constraints rather than fall back blindly. A one-month online A/B test across NetEase Cloud Music's playlist surfaces reports an over 2 pp lift in a primary playlist retention metric and a lift of over one minute in a core playlist engagement metric. Offline ablation isolates a 7.8 pp reduction in entity misidentification from the three-layer grounding stack on our evaluation set, and a triggered-session analysis on our evaluation set shows reflective retry firing on 5.8% of sessions with 59% process-level recovery. Our deployment experience suggests that progress on LLM-powered music recommendation at this scale depends as much on the named, ablatable runtime machinery that catches and corrects the brain's mistakes as on the brain itself: a hypothesis we offer for the community to test.

AI.tldr: Melo是部署于网易云音乐的生产级LLM音乐推荐Agent，采用确定性的五节点状态图（UNDERSTAND→PLAN→EXECUTE→REFLECT→SYNTHESIZE）编排异构推荐工具，并通过两个可消融的失败处理机制——推理时实体接地（将生产搜索索引用作验证原语）与反思重试（将失败原因语言化并反馈给规划步骤）——应对实体幻觉与长尾退化两大生产故障模式。核心贡献在于提出"在大规模工业部署中，决定LLM Agent上限的不是更强的'大脑'，而是围绕它的命名节点化、可消融的运行时纠错机制"。
AI.motivation: 在亿级用户音乐平台上，自然语言推荐已从研究走向产品，但"演示可用"到"生产稳定"存在本质工程鸿沟。两条高频生产故障路径尤其致命：(1) 实体幻觉——Agent承诺一个目录或用户行为索引无法支持的实体解读（如将"Africa"误解为非洲大陆而非Toto歌曲）；(2) 长尾退化——过度约束的请求使召回通道稀疏，常规回退策略静默丢弃用户核心意图、塌缩为热门泛化结果。已有音乐推荐文献多未将这些故障视为带命名、可消融防御的运行时问题；Spotify Parallel Fusion Router缺乏显式反思修复阶段，Amazon Music等仅将LLM用于查询扩展。因此需要一种将失败检测与纠正视为一等运行时机制、并能在生产延迟预算下端到端工作的架构。
AI.method: 系统分两层。编排层是确定性五节点状态图，LLM调用仅限四个推理节点（UNDERSTAND解析意图、PLAN选工具与参数、EXECUTE并行执行并合并候选、REFLECT检查合并集并可回退到PLAN、SYNTHESIZE生成最终歌单与解释），由提示与状态机驱动而非微调控制器。工具层混合现有生产服务（目录搜索、实体接地、画像/行为、候选生成、相似检索、个性化排序）与自研生成式召回器Climber-Think（基于Semantic-ID映射自然语言请求到可播放目录曲目）。两个失败处理机制作为命名节点防御附加：(1) 三层推理时实体接地——L1目录反查提供支持信号、L2提示消费规则指示如何权衡证据、L3规划期守卫拦截失败模式结构（显式否定、动词前缀伪匹配、未核实艺人ID）；(2) 反思重试——REFLECT施加最小规模与覆盖率两道门控，触发proceed/retry_rewrite/retry_relaxed/fallback四种动作，将诊断原因与修订建议回灌给PLAN，至多两轮。实现上还采用按需工具描述加载降低PLAN提示开销、SYNTHESIZE通过SSE流式输出提升感知延迟。
AI.result: 生产A/B测试（2026/4/2–5/10，约100万用户）：主歌单留存指标>+2pp，核心歌单参与度指标>+1分钟，跨所有歌单面板聚合读为扩展而非蚕食。离线消融：(1) 三层实体接地使实体误识别率从17.4%降至9.6%（-7.8pp），三层缺一不可（L3单独贡献+1.2pp、L2追加+2.6pp最大），代价为UNDERSTAND P50 +2.5s、PLAN P50 +1.8s；(2) 反思重试触发率5.8%，整体过程级恢复率59.1%（retry_relaxed 63%、retry_rewrite 56%），约束保持率77%（intent-preserving恢复约46%），触发会话P50 +15.9s、P99 +29.2s，全流量摊销P50仅+4.1s。节点级延迟显示LLM推理（UNDERSTAND/PLAN/SYNTHESIZE）占中位数26s几乎全部预算，EXECUTE/REFLECT低于100ms，与并行执行设计一致。
AI.conclusion: 在亿级用户平台上，LLM驱动音乐推荐Agent的提升空间不再主要来自更强的"大脑"，而来自围绕它的命名节点化、可消融的运行时机制——能够拦截、诊断并将"大脑"错误转化为可恢复信号。确定性的五节点底盘设计使失败可归因到具体节点、防御可在不重写控制器的前提下替换或叠加；这与ReAct式自由循环相比牺牲灵活性换取可观测性与生产可控性。工程启示：将可确定性化逻辑（计划期守卫、结构化输出校验、四动作REFLECT枚举）下放到代码而非反复委托给LLM；将工具调度与模型更新解耦以支持提示与模型独立热更新。通用性边界：实体接地的阈值、反思重试的预算与延迟算式均与SSE流式播放列表生成场景耦合，跨目录、跨市场验证仍是开放问题；Melo的恢复声明是覆盖率恢复而非多样性/新颖性优化。

title: Breaking the Loop: An Empirical Comparison of Strategies for Novelty and Freshness in YouTube Music
comment: Accepted at 20th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems, September 27-October 02, 2026, Minneapolis, MN, USA. 8 pages
summary: Continuously trained ranking models in music recommenders fall into feedback loops where previously consumed items dominate recommendations. This suppresses two distinct content classes: new releases (temporal freshness) and unlistened catalog items (novelty). Industry practitioners have a wide menu of interventions available, ranging from serving-time heuristics, training-data reweighting, architectural debiasing, to uncertainty-driven exploration, each of which are well understood in academic settings. But live systems offer challenges with continuously ingested content, interconnected components, and practical limitations that counteract the findings from academic research. We report results from off-policy online A/B tests for six interventions and a combination experiment across four conceptual layers (serving, training, architecture, exploration) on the YouTube Music homepage. All interventions modify the ranking model or the serving layer that consumes its scores; candidate generation and other upstream components are held fixed. We discuss key takeaways from our results: first, serving-time interventions on continuously trained systems are neutralized by the learning loop. Second, architectural debiasing reduces popularity dominance and improves diversity but does not create discovery, while carrying hidden integration costs. Finally, uncertainty-driven exploration interventions with a Spectral-normalized Neural Gaussian Process (SNGP) head produce the largest new-release lift, though they come with a measurable engagement or diversity tradeoff. We close with recommendations on which layer to intervene at, and the hidden costs of each choice.

AI.tldr: 该论文在 YouTube Music 主页上对六种打破推荐反馈循环的干预措施进行了线上 A/B 测试，按四个层次（服务层、训练数据层、架构层、探索层）组织。核心发现：服务层启发式策略因持续学习循环被中和；架构去偏（如位置偏置塔）能降低热门主导但无法提升新内容曝光；基于 SNGP 不确定性的探索策略带来最大的新发布内容提升，但有参与度或多样性的权衡。
AI.motivation: 持续训练的排序模型会陷入反馈循环——已被消费的内容主导推荐，抑制新发布（时间新鲜度）和未听过目录项（新颖性）。虽然学术界对各类干预措施有充分研究，但工业级实时系统面临持续内容摄入、组件互联和实际工程限制等挑战，使学术结论难以直接迁移。该研究旨在通过生产环境实证，明确不同层次干预的实际效果与隐藏成本。
AI.method: 提出"分层框架"，按干预在排序栈中的位置将其分为四类：服务层（启发式时效性加成、按发布龄多样化）、训练数据层（近期数据上采样；IPS 因训练不稳定未上线）、架构层（类似 PAL/WatchNext 的浅层位置偏置塔）、探索层（基于 SNGP 谱归一化高斯过程头提供不确定性估计，在服务时加成或训练时上加权损失）。在 YouTube Music 主页进行七组对照 A/B 实验（6 个单干预 + 1 个组合），候选生成等上游组件固定。
AI.result: 1) 服务层时效加成在首日提升新发布曝光，但 2-3 天内被其他排序组件和再训练模型中和；2) 偏置塔使 top-1% 集中度大幅下降，bottom-20% 曝光+9.2%，新颖音乐参与+4.70%，艺术家多样性提升，但 7 天新发布参与度反而下降 3.39%（因新发布本就缺乏历史信号，去偏无法提供该信号）；3) SNGP 不确定性服务时加成带来最大新发布提升（1 天+7.75%，7 天+3.30%），但艺术家多样性下降；不确定性训练损失加权带来 1 天+4.33% 提升但牺牲首页参与和多样性；4) 偏置塔+不确定性损失组合在去偏维度上叠加但消解了新发布提升。额外发现：仅添加 SNGP 头但不使用其输出即获得+5.32% 1 天新发布提升，原因未明。
AI.conclusion: 干预"层次"本身是设计选择，决定了反馈循环症状的哪个方面被解决、产生哪些代价。服务层干预效果短暂且不可预测；架构去偏适合解决热门主导问题但不适于新鲜度；不确定性驱动探索是提升新发布曝光的最有效手段，但需权衡参与度或多样性。论文强调"去偏≠新鲜度"——去偏移除偏差但不添加新内容信号，启发式可提升新发布但无校正偏差作用。实践者应按最关心的症状（热门主导/新鲜度/发现）选择层次，并预算对应层次的集成成本。

title: ClawRec: A Claw-Native Recommender System
summary: Recommender systems have become integral to navigating the modern digital ecosystem. Yet most deployed systems remain confined within single-platform boundaries, observing localized interaction traces and ranking items from isolated candidate spaces. This design is poorly suited to real-world tasks that unfold through searches, content consumption, and comparisons across multiple information sources. Claw-style personal agents, with persistent access to authorized cross-platform context, create an opportunity for recommendation to operate around the user rather than any single platform. In this paper, we introduce Claw-native recommender systems, a new paradigm that moves beyond platform-local ranking to produce unified, complementary recommendation slates spanning diverse sources and content forms. To instantiate this paradigm, we present ClawRec, the first recommender system designed to operate natively in this environment. ClawRec maintains an evidence-linked, temporally structured user state that connects cross-platform behaviors with cross-source recommendations. It organizes retrieval around functional source roles and selects candidates according to their marginal utility, producing non-redundant slates aligned with the user's active task. To enable rigorous evaluation, we introduce ClawRec-SimBench, a benchmark constructed from sequences of concrete life events and cross-platform behavior trajectories. Experiments show that ClawRec outperforms the strongest baselines, achieving an NDCG@20 of 0.6134 (+0.1126) and a Hit@20 of 0.6944 (+0.0854), while also improving user state quality and temporal alignment. Our code and dataset are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出Claw-native推荐系统新范式，将推荐从单平台局部排序转向以用户当前任务为中心的跨平台统一推荐。作者实现了首个此类系统ClawRec，它通过证据链接的时序用户状态、角色感知规划和边际效用策展来生成互补的非冗余推荐列表，并构建了ClawRec-SimBench基准进行评估。
AI.motivation: 传统推荐系统局限于单一平台边界内，仅观察到局部交互痕迹，无法应对用户在搜索、内容消费和跨信息源比较中的真实任务需求。现有方法（多行为推荐、跨域推荐、LLM/智能体方法）虽然在整合碎片化证据方面有所进展，但仍受限于预定义的平台/域/数据接口边界，未能将用户整体数字环境作为推荐的运行作用域。Claw-style个人智能体（具有跨平台授权上下文访问能力）的出现为突破此边界提供了技术契机。
AI.method: ClawRec系统包含五大核心机制：(1) 统一事件构建——将多源交互痕迹标准化为带溯源的统一事件，记录溯源、语义和治理信息；(2) 用户状态推理——通过证据引用补丁维护任务槽、偏好槽和源角色记录，支持active→cooling→expired的时态生命周期及抑制机制；(3) 规划与源扩展——将活跃任务分解为支持目标，基于功能角色选择合适信息源，支持行为自适应的源扩展；(4) 内容获取与边际策展——通过源适配器执行检索，按边际效用进行多样性感知选择，生成互补列表；(5) 反馈溯源——闭环更新状态证据。基准ClawRec-SimBench基于109个模拟用户、545个生活事件序列，通过潜在画像-生活事件-意图生成-平台条件重排序-GUI代理执行的流程构建行为轨迹，采用留一法（最后行为隐藏）评估协议。
AI.result: ClawRec在ClawRec-SimBench上取得NDCG@20为0.6134（提升+0.1126）、Hit@20为0.6944（提升+0.0854），均显著优于非LLM方法（Popular/Trending、Last-query Retrieval、History-QE+BM25）、直接LLM推理（LLM Planner+LLMRank）和智能体方法（Persona2Web-style、MARS-style、OpenClaw w/o ClawRec）。在用户状态质量方面，Current Need(4.57)、Temporal Alignment(4.29)、Calibration(3.65)均最佳，Preference(3.98)接近最优。消融实验验证了统一事件构建（影响Need和Temp最大）、时序遗忘（主要提升Temporal Alignment）、源扩展（主要提升Hit@20）和边际策展（主要提升NDCG@20）四个机制的独立贡献。冷启动（首个事件）和跨事件自演化分析均显示ClawRec优势显著，源角色感知检索分析显示在observed-source和unobserved-source案例上均最优。质量验证得分：Trajectory Coherence 4.52、Query Naturalness 4.04、Source-Role Plausibility 4.88、Target Plausibility 4.53。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功将推荐系统从平台局部排序扩展到以用户任务为中心的代理可访问数字环境，通过统一事件构建、时序用户状态、角色感知规划和边际策展解决了跨平台异构行为整合的三个关键挑战（信号异质性、源功能多样性、列表互补性）。ClawRec-SimBench基准为评估此类系统提供了基于生活事件的留一法协议。未来工作应扩展到纵向用户研究、多语言多模态环境和更丰富的反馈循环，同时保持证据基础、隐私过滤和可审计性。

title: Mosaic: A Fleet of User Embedding Specialists for Recommendation at Meta
comment: Accepted in the 20th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems (RecSys '26),
summary: User representation is one of the highest-leverage modeling problems in industrial recommendation systems: a single advancement in how users are encoded can propagate across retrieval, ranking, and integrity tasks at platform scale. Prior industrial user representation work builds either a single user model that emits one or more embedding vectors or a shared backbone with task-specific adaptation. In this paper, we present Mosaic, a foundational user modeling platform that employs a fleet of specialists to learn user embeddings. The fleet comprises four architecturally diverse model families - memorization-driven, dense-heavy, sequential-based, and CoTrain models - each focusing on a distinct facet of user behavior. We developed MRM (Multi-task Relations Mining) and CRL (Cosine Redundancy Loss) techniques to maximize the marginal information contribution of each new specialist. We also introduce CoEval and User Tower Zero-Out, new logging-free embedding evaluation framework that improves development velocity while preserving downstream-aligned accuracy. Our hybrid CPU/GPU, online-and-offline serving stack allows each specialist to choose the adequate serving strategy to meet the freshness, latency, and computational requirements. Mosaic delivers consistent and significant offline NE improvements in addition to online gains.

AI.tldr: Mosaic是Meta提出的工业级用户建模平台,采用"专家舰队"架构,由四种架构异构的专用模型组成(记忆驱动、密集型、序列型、CoTrain),分别捕捉用户行为的不同侧面;并通过MRM、余弦冗余损失等技术最大化每个专家的边际信息贡献,配合免日志的CoEval评估框架与混合CPU/GPU服务栈,实现跨多场景的下游推荐任务NE和在线指标的稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 工业推荐系统中,用户表征是杠杆最高的问题之一,单一架构(单模型或多向量、共享骨干+任务适配)难以充分捕捉稀疏特征、密集计数器、序列行为与下游特定目标等异质信号;且随着专家逐步增加,新嵌入对下游的边际增益因表征冗余而递减;同时,标准特征日志评估流程迭代周期长(数天),严重拖慢开发节奏,亟需更快速且下游对齐的评估信号。
AI.method: 1) 舰队的四类专家:(a) 记忆驱动专家使用大哈希表+TBE分片与INT4量化;(b) 密集型专家使用MHTA/SEDot/Wukong等架构处理多窗口聚合计数器;(c) 序列型专家基于HSTU+MoE,加入上下文前缀、UIH交错、分层注意力与随机长度训练;(d) CoTrain专家共享user tower,同时接收下游排序器的端到端梯度以对齐目标。2) 抗冗余训练:MRM通过Spearman相关挖掘高相关任务簇并构造笛卡尔积复合标签;CRL对新增嵌入与已部署嵌入施加余弦冗余惩罚并warm-up调度;另辅以特征-任务对齐与已有嵌入条件化。3) 服务栈:CPU在线、GPU在线(含AOTI编译、模型拆分、memcache 2h TTL)+GPU离线批量三路径混合;评估侧采用CoEval(冻结user tower内联到下游ranker中)与User Tower Zero-Out,实现免日志、3-5×加速的迭代。
AI.result: 在多个下游Surface的离线NE评估中持续显著下降(典型ΔNE在-0.05%到-0.38%区间,Surface 1任务A/B/C分别-0.21%/-0.30%/-0.16%等);FI分析显示Mosaic嵌入稳定位列下游ranker 2万+特征的前2%;专家消融中dense-heavy(20个嵌入)贡献最大(-0.22%),CoTrain(-0.15%)与序列(-0.12%)次之;序列专家在长度/MoE/维度上展现可预期的NE-QPS权衡(2048长度提升0.45%NE但QPS降33%);在线A/B在Surface 1/2/3分别取得+0.10%/+0.15%/+0.28%的topline提升;GPU在线服务经AOTI+模型拆分+memcache累计节省79%算力,首条延迟再降0.14%。
AI.conclusion: Mosaic证明"异构专家舰队"比单一通用模型更适合工业用户表征的规模化扩展:不同信号族需要不同的归纳偏置,舰队设计兼具开发解耦、故障隔离与跨Surface复用优势;MRM+CRL缓解了舰队增长带来的表征冗余问题,使新增专家能持续贡献独立信息;CoEval/Zero-Out将评估周期压缩至原流程一半以下,显著提升迭代速度;混合CPU/GPU服务栈在新鲜度、延迟、算力之间提供灵活折中。该工作为大规模推荐系统跨多下游消费者扩展用户表征提供了可复用的工程蓝图。

title: ConAlign: Conditional Alignment Framework for Balancing Biased and Unbiased Recommendation
summary: Industry recommender systems trained on observational data suffer from various biases that create filter bubbles, causing user interests to collapse into narrow categories and severely degrading long-term engagement. While utilizing unbiased uniform data for debiasing has shown promise, existing methods remain impractical for industrial deployment due to limitations such as neglect of factual (biased) recommendation performance and the substantial computational overhead. To overcome these limitations, we propose ConAlign (Conditional Alignment Framework), a conditional debiasing approach for industrial deployment. The key innovation of ConAlign lies in a discrete gating-based conditional alignment mechanism that selectively transfers knowledge from the biased tower to the unbiased tower. Following a selective intervention paradigm rather than universal correction, it seamlessly balances factual accuracy and unbiased preference estimation while supporting real-time streaming adaptation. To the best of our knowledge, ConAlign is the first streaming debiasing recommendation framework successfully deployed in a large-scale industrial recommendation system that utilizes a small fraction of unbiased random traffic for debiasing. Extensive offline experiments on three real-world datasets rigorously validate the effectiveness of our proposed framework. Furthermore, large-scale online A/B testing on Kuaishou demonstrates significant improvements in long-term user engagement and interest diversity, with negligible latency overhead.

AI.tldr: ConAlign提出了一种面向工业部署的条件对齐去偏框架,采用双塔架构(偏置塔+无偏塔),通过离散门控机制从偏置塔选择性传递知识到无偏塔,在保持在线推荐准确性的同时提升无偏环境下的偏好估计,首次实现在大规模工业推荐系统(Kuaishou)中的流式去偏部署。
AI.motivation: 工业推荐系统基于观察性日志训练,存在曝光偏差、选择偏差、流行度偏差和位置偏差等多种偏差,导致用户兴趣坍缩为狭窄类别,形成过滤气泡(filter bubble),严重损害长期用户参与度。尽管利用少量无偏均匀数据进行去偏已显示出潜力,但现有方法存在两个关键缺陷:(1)过度优化无偏评估指标而忽视事实性(偏置)环境的推荐质量,导致过度去偏反而损害线上业务;(2)计算开销巨大(如InterD依赖AutoDebias元学习和笛卡尔积蒸馏),难以适配大规模工业流式训练。Kuaishou真实数据表明,用户兴趣多样性与LT7(7日长期留存)正相关,凸显了打破过滤气泡的重要性。
AI.method: 1. **双塔架构**:偏置塔基于大规模偏置交互数据训练(输入为记忆特征E(F_m)与泛化特征E(F_g)的拼接);无偏塔基于少量无偏数据训练。2. **跨塔表示传递**:提取偏置塔的倒数第二层隐藏表示h_b^(L-1)作为潜在偏置表示(LBR),与泛化特征拼接后作为无偏塔输入x^(d),且通过stop-gradient防止梯度回传干扰偏置塔。3. **条件对齐损失**(核心创新):在隐表示层级(非最终预测分数)进行对齐,引入离散门控指示器𝕀_cond,仅当偏置塔在某样本上的损失ℓ_b^(i) < 无偏塔损失ℓ_d^(i)时才激活对齐项,实现选择性干预而非全局纠正。总目标为ℒ_u = ℒ_d + λ·ℒ_align。4. **在线流式训练**:通过小概率随机干预(均匀采样候选池中的视频并随机插入)持续收集满足MAR条件的无偏流,与偏置流并行训练,每批次独立采样并实时评估门控条件。5. **在线推理**:仅使用无偏塔预测分数R̂_d,因对齐机制确保无偏塔在偏置环境中保持竞争力。
AI.result: **离线实验**(Coat、Yahoo! R3、KuaiRand-Pure三个真实数据集):在所有数据集的无偏测试环境下,ConAlign的UAUC和NDCG@5均优于所有基线(MF、MF-IPS、MF-DR、CausE、KD-label、AutoDebias、InterD、KD-Debias);在偏置环境下与SOTA方法InterD表现相当甚至更优;训练延迟(122.7秒)显著低于AutoDebias(4560.7秒)和InterD(10592.1秒)。**消融实验**(Yahoo! R3)验证了偏置塔、对齐损失、自适应门控条件、隐表示层级对齐四个组件的必要性。**超参分析**表明对齐权重λ平衡偏置与无偏性能的权衡。**在线A/B测试**(Kuaishou生产平台,10%流量分流):DAU +0.069%、LT7 +0.029%、有效兴趣数(VIN) +0.097%、类别集中度(CC) -0.083%、完播率 +0.277%、有效播放 +0.184%,且排序CPU成本 -0.169%,所有核心指标统计显著,验证了长期留存、多样性与即时体验的同步提升。
AI.conclusion: ConAlign通过条件对齐机制成功解决了工业推荐系统中去偏与事实准确性之间的权衡难题,证明了选择性干预(而非全局纠正)在双环境优化中的有效性。该框架首次实现了大规模工业推荐系统中的流式去偏部署,在Kuaishou生产环境中持续提升长期留存、兴趣多样性与即时参与度,同时引入可忽略的延迟开销,为工业级去偏推荐提供了可扩展、可落地的实践方案。

title: Strategy-Aware Parameter-Efficient Adaptation for LLM-based Auto-Bidding
summary: Advertising bidding has evolved from manual strategies to auto-bidding systems better adapted for large-scale, dynamic auction environments. While recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) offer strong reasoning for auto-bidding, existing methods suffer from shallow trajectory-text interactions and require costly fine-tuning, hindering the efficient use of pretrained knowledge under diverse constraints. To address these challenges, we propose SAGE, a novel Strategy-aware Auto-bidding framework Guided by LLMs for Efficient bidding. SAGE introduces a parameter-efficient multi-modal alignment framework for constrained auto-bidding with LLMs. Specifically, SAGE comprises three key components: (i) the position augmentation module adopts temporal-semantic positional embeddings to effectively capture the intrinsic dynamics and semantic structures; (ii) the text alignment module leverages gated cross-attention to align the embedding spaces of trajectory and text modalities, enabling effective multi-modal fusion while alleviating the computational overhead caused by long trajectories; (iii) the constraint-gated LoRA module employs constraints as routing signals, activating only a small subset of experts to adapt the behavior of a frozen LLM efficiently. Extensive experiments on large-scale auto-bidding benchmark demonstrate that SAGE consistently achieves superior performance while tuning less than 10% of the trainable parameters required by full fine-tuning. Ablation studies further validate the critical contribution of each component to the framework's overall performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SAGE（Strategy-aware Auto-bidding framework Guided by LLMs for Efficient bidding），一种基于LLM的策略感知、参数高效的自动竞价框架。该框架通过位置增强模块、文本对齐模块和约束门控LoRA模块三个核心组件，分别解决了现有LLM自动竞价方法中轨迹表示语义信息不足、多模态融合粗糙以及全参数微调成本高昂三大问题，仅需不到10%的可训练参数即可在大规模竞价基准AuctionNet上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的自动竞价方法存在三大核心局限：1）轨迹表示层面，简单可学习的时序位置嵌入忽略了RTG、状态、动作等token之间的语义差异，难以建模竞价轨迹的层次结构；2）多模态融合层面，直接拼接轨迹和文本嵌入忽视了模态间的嵌入空间差异，导致跨模态对齐不足且输入序列过长带来计算开销；3）模型适配层面，全参数微调策略成本高且会稀释LLM的预训练先验知识，限制模型在新场景和约束条件下的迁移能力。论文致力于解决如何在保留结构保真度、跨模态对齐和预训练知识的前提下，实现LLM在自动竞价任务中的策略感知和参数高效适配这一核心研究问题。
